title: Join an Established, Growing Dermatology Practice with a Strong APP Team
description:
We are seeking a board-certified or board-eligible Dermatologist who is:

  • Passionate about providing high-quality, comprehensive dermatologic care
  • Comfortable treating a broad range of medical dermatology conditions
  • Collaborative and team-oriented
  • Interested in mentoring and developing APPs
  • Comfortable providing clinical supervision and guidance to experienced PAs
  • Interested in building long-term relationships with patients and colleagues
  • Entrepreneurial and growth-minded while valuing the benefits of an established practice
  • Interested in aesthetic dermatology and willing to incorporate cosmetic services, preferred but not required

A Strong Existing Clinical Foundation

Westminster Dermatology has a strong focus on medical dermatology, with care encompassing skin cancer, moles, skin growths, rashes, psoriasis, eczema, acne, rosacea, and other common dermatologic conditions. The practice describes its approach as compassionate, personalized, and focused on expert dermatologic care.

The practice's existing provider team includes one Dermatologist and four PAs, creating an established clinical infrastructure for the incoming physician to step into a meaningful leadership and mentorship role.

We offer a generous compensation and benefits package which includes:

  • Guaranteed Base Salary + % of Collections
  • Uncapped income
  • Start Bonus
  • Relocation Assistance
  • Paid vacation and continued education time-off
  • Continued education reimbursement
  • Paid malpractice insurance
  • Paid health insurance
  • Retirement benefits
  • and Professional training opportunities
  • MD or DO degree from an accredited medical school.
  • Board-certified or board-eligible in Dermatology.
  • Eligible for medical licensure in the Maryland.
  • Strong clinical judgment and commitment to evidence-based, patient-centered care.
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented approach.
  • Interest or experience in estestic dermatology is a plus, but not required.

Why Integrated Dermatology?

Westminster Dermatology is affiliated with Integrated Dermatology, giving providers the advantages of an established private-practice environment while having access to the operational resources and infrastructure of a larger dermatology organization.

This model is designed to allow physicians to remain focused on what they do best—patient care, clinical decision-making, and developing their teams—while receiving support with many of the administrative and operational functions of running a modern medical practice.

For a physician who values the culture and relationships of community-based private practice but also appreciates the resources and support of a larger organization, this can offer an attractive balance.

Why Westminster, Maryland?

Westminster offers an appealing combination of community, accessibility, and quality of life.

Located in Carroll County, Westminster provides a more relaxed community setting while remaining within reach of the Baltimore and Washington, D.C. metropolitan areas. Carroll County identifies Westminster as one of its best-connected municipalities, with access toward the surrounding metropolitan areas.

For physicians looking to establish roots outside of a major metropolitan center, the area offers:

  • A welcoming community environment
  • Access to outdoor recreation, parks, and trails
  • Excellent opportunities for hiking, biking, paddling, and other outdoor activities
  • Family-friendly communities and neighborhoods
  • Proximity to Baltimore and the broader Mid-Atlantic region
  • A balance between professional opportunity and a more relaxed lifestyle

Carroll County manages more than 4,800 acres of parkland across more than 30 parks, including opportunities for hiking, paddling, nature activities, sports, and other outdoor recreation.

Westminster also provides convenient access to a variety of local recreational destinations, including Piney Run Park, Hashawha Environmental Center, Union Mills Homestead, and numerous community parks and trails.

Build the Practice—and the Team

This is more than an opportunity to take over an existing patient schedule.

The ideal physician will become an important clinical leader within the practice, helping mentor four APPs while developing their own patient population and contributing to the continued growth of Westminster Dermatology.

If you are a dermatologist looking for an established practice, a collaborative team, meaningful APP leadership opportunities, and the ability to build a rewarding long-term career in a community with an excellent quality of life, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

We are a high performing front-office development team working on delivery of new strategic EFX pricing and auto-hedging capabilities for FICC E-Trading for 2026.

In a typical day you can expect to develop Java code, review code written by your colleagues, attend Agile ceremonies, refine requirements with users (Quantitative Strategies Group and Traders) and liaise with sibling teams in EFX (market access, dashboard, price distribution etc). There will be occasional L3 support.

You will have the opportunity to work with leading edge ultra-low-latency technologies like zero-GC JVMs, kernel bypass networking, core pinning and market data technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Have prior pricing or algo-trading experience in any asset class.

title: Data Platform Engineer - Middelfart eller Århus
description:
Data Platform Engineer - Middelfart eller Århus

Vil du være med til at opbygge skalerbare, cloud-baserede platformskapabiliteter, der driver datadrevet beslutningstagning i en global organisation? Trives du i et moderne, cloud-first engineering miljø, hvor samarbejde, automation og innovation er i fokus? Så kunne dette være rollen for dig.

Om rollen og teamet

Som Data Platform Engineer bliver du en del af Unit IT, hvor du arbejder i et konsulentdrevet setup, der leverer high-value services på tværs af USTC Group.

Til at starte med vil du indgå i et dedikeret team med fokus på at opbygge en Unified Data Platform for Bunker Holding Group. Her får du en central rolle i at etablere de centrale platformskapabiliteter, der muliggør stabile, sikre og skalerbare dataløsninger på tværs af systemer og forretningsdomæner.

Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med platform leads, architects, data engineers og stakeholders på tværs af organisationen og bidrage til det fælles mål om at opbygge et stærkt og fremtidssikret datafundament.

Dine ansvarsområder

Du vil have en aktiv rolle i at designe, udvikle og drive den tekniske platform for den Unified Data Platform.

I rollen arbejder du hands-on med platform engineering og sikrer, at platformen understøtter stabile, sikre og skalerbare datakapabiliteter i hele organisationen, samtidig med at du muliggør et moderne og effektivt setup. Du samarbejder tæt med engineers, architects og stakeholders for at etablere stærke platform patterns og understøtte et robust datafundament.

  • Opbygning og vedligeholdelse af skalerbare platform components og datainfrastruktur på tværs af Databricks og Microsoft Fabric
  • Udvikling af Infrastructure as Code ved brug af Terraform for at sikre konsistent, automatiseret og sikker platform provisioning
  • Understøttelse af ingestion, transformation, orkestrering og serving capabilities på tværs af platformen
  • Implementering af CI/CD pipelines og automation for at forbedre deployment kvalitet og operationel effektivitet
  • Tæt samarbejde med data engineers, architects og platform leads for at implementere platform standards og best practices
  • Sikring af observability, monitoring, logging og alerting på tværs af platform services og pipelines

Du vil også arbejde med platform security, access management og compliance, bidrage til løbende forbedring af platformens reliability, skalerbarhed og performance samt være med til at etablere reusable templates, moduler og engineering patterns, der understøtter self-service capabilities på tværs af teams. Derudover vil du deltage i troubleshooting og root cause analysis samt løbende holde dig opdateret på moderne platform engineering, cloud og AI-understøttede development practices.

I praksis er dette en rolle, hvor du kombinerer engineering excellence, automation og samarbejde for at opbygge en moderne og skalerbar enterprise data platform.

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi forventer, at du er en teknisk stærk og samarbejdsorienteret engineer, som trives med at løse komplekse platform- og infrastrukturudfordringer.

Du har sandsynligvis erfaring med:

  • Moderne cloud-baserede dataplatforme og platform engineering practices
  • Hands-on arbejde med Databricks og/eller Microsoft Fabric
  • CI/CD pipelines og deployment automation
  • Cloud-native services og distribuerede datasystemer
  • DevOps og platform engineering principper

Du arbejder struktureret og kvalitetsbevidst, tager ejerskab for dine leverancer og samarbejder effektivt med både engineers og forretningsmæssige stakeholders.

  • Erfaring med Microsoft Azure services og cloud governance
  • Erfaring med streaming, event-driven arkitekturer eller real-time data processing
  • Kendskab til DataOps practices
  • Erfaring fra enterprise-scale platform miljøer

Hvad du kan forvente

  • En central rolle i opbygningen af en moderne, enterprise-grade Unified Data Platform
  • Høj grad af ejerskab og indflydelse på platform engineering standards og løsninger
  • Tæt samarbejde på tværs af Unit IT og resten af USTC Group
  • Mulighed for at arbejde med nye teknologier inden for data, AI og platform engineering
  • Et samarbejdssetup, hvor interne og eksterne kollegaer arbejder som ét samlet team

Bliv en del af teamet

Vi ønsker at besætte stillingen hurtigst muligt, så hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen, ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning snarest muligt.

Vi behandler ansøgninger og CV’er løbende. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Unit Director, Data Kristian Brendstrup på +45 60 37 67 49.

Om Unit IT

Hos Unit IT bliver du en del af en familieejet virksomhed med en stærk kultur og et samarbejdsorienteret miljø, hvor vi deler viden, hjælper hinanden og skaber værdi sammen. Vores kerneværdier – WE DARE, WE CARE, WE ARE UNITED – er fundamentet for alt, hvad vi gør.

I dag har Unit IT seks lokationer i Danmark med hovedkontor i Middelfart samt et kontor i Prag, Tjekkiet. Unit IT leverer en bred vifte af avancerede services inden for infrastruktur samt private og public cloud løsninger samt specialistviden inden for Cloud, Business Intelligence, Data Platform og Cyber Security.

Unit IT er en del af den danske, familieejede koncern United Shipping & Trading Company (USTC). USTC’s portefølje omfatter aktiviteter inden for oil & energy, shipping, door-to-door logistics, risk management, automotive, IT og sustainable energy og er repræsenteret i 38 lande med mere end 4.500 medarbejdere.

U.S. Bank is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, and other factors protected under applicable law.

U.S. Bank will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment. Over the past year, we have been driving an ambitious phase in our journey under the impulse of our new shareholder Bridgepoint, aimed at propelling us to become the clear leader in our market and shine worldwide in our industry. If these core values sound like you: "be bold, do amazing things", "say what you mean, do what you say", "one team, same mission", "always be evolving": apply now!


*Team*

We are looking for a strategic, high-energy Global Director of Brand & Communications to lead, shape, and scale the LumApps brand worldwide. In this global leadership role, you will be responsible for defining our international market positioning, visual and verbal identity, global PR/media strategy, analyst relations (AR), and C-suite communications. Leading a distributed team of brand strategists, writers, PR agencies, and creative talent across multiple time zones, you will establish LumApps as the recognized global leader in its category.

  • International Employer Brand: Partner with Global HR and People Ops to project a unified employer brand that attracts top-tier global tech talent across all international offices and remote hubs.

5. Global Agency Leadership Agency Management: Direct international agency networks (PR, Brand, Production) and optimize global communications budgets to maximize return on investment.

*Skills*

  • Experience: 8+ years leading brand strategy and corporate communications in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or top-tier global agencies, with direct experience supporting global go-to-market strategies.

  • Global Track Record: Proven success scaling brand awareness across international markets (specifically North America, Europe, and expansion markets like APAC), navigating cross-cultural communication nuances, and managing multi-region PR campaigns.

  • Communications Mastery: Strong background in global media relations, analyst relations (Gartner Magic Quadrants, Forrester Waves), executive comms, and international reputation management.

  • Cross-Border Leadership: 4+ years of experience managing distributed international teams, time-zone logistics, and global agency rosters.

  • Storytelling Expertise: Flawless written and executive-level editorial skills, with the ability to build high-concept narratives that resonate across diverse enterprise markets.

💡 Why You’ll Love Working at LumApps

💰 401k Retirement Plan – We match 100% of your contribution up to 4%

title: Electrical/Electronic Engineer SME
description:
Torch Technologies

Thank you for your interest in employment with Torch Technologies. We are a 100% employee-owned, Certified Great Place To Work and named Best Places to Work in Huntsville/Madison County, headquartered in Huntsville, AL. Our team provides superior research, development, and engineering services to the Federal Government and Department of War. As one of the nation’s top 100 defense companies, the services we provide directly support the men and women who serve our country. Our corporate mission sums up the pride our employee-owners take in the work we do: “Lighting the Pathway of Freedom”. And, as a Certified Evergreen ESOP, we have made the commitment to grow and sustain our company for the next 100 years! Come grow with us!

Torch Technologies is seeking an Electrical/Electronic Engineer SME under the Technical and Management Advisory Services (TMAS) Armament Task Order contract to provide support to the Air Force at Eglin AFB, FL.

As an Electrical Engineer your duties will include the following, but are not limited to:

  • Support the Science and Technology (S&T) community in the development of advanced weapon concepts and technologies to dramatically improve weapon performance to include weapon-platform integration.

  • Assist in identifying, developing and implementing technology investment ideas to mitigate capability gaps for warfighters, including definitions of scope of work, budget, schedule and risk to further technologies.

  • Assist in generating system and subsystem requirements based on a thorough understanding of complex technical aspects of current and emerging threats, overarching warfighter requirements, capability trade studies, and emerging technologies.

  • Assist and advise in performing complex system and subsystem tradeoff studies, to include make-buy decisions, functional allocations, cost, weight, size and performance.

  • Prepare and coordinate written specifications, performance work statements and other technical documents (e.g. trip reports).

  • Monitor S&T development progress and document/report this progress to the team. Evaluate requirements, functional descriptions, and hardware and software specifications for completeness and requirements traceability. Review hardware and software development plans and design documents for conformance with applicable standards and requirements. Review interface specifications, drawings, and design documents to assess functional, signal, electrical and physical interfaces. Provide advice in technical meetings, project reviews and test planning meetings.

  • Monitor test planning and test conduct and document/report this progress to the team.

  • Review test plans, procedures and schedules to evaluate completeness/accuracy, requirements traceability, compliance with test requirements, risks and risk mitigation plans.

  • Review test reports for accuracy and completeness.

  • Provide on-site test support (ground and flight).

  • Design, plan, and support in-house tests to measure performance, reduce and analyze test results to quantify performance, and provide test result reporting.

Job Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship.

  • Bachelor of Science (BS) degree from an accredited college or university in Electrical/Electronic Engineering and/or Physics is required. At least 10 years’ of applicable experience is also required. Additional years of relevant experience may be substituted for education requirements.

  • Position requires candidates possess a current TOP SECRET security clearance with a background investigation completed within the past 5 years.

  • Must be willing to support geographically dispersed activities and be willing to travel ~2 times monthly.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Masters degree from an accredited college or university in Electrical/Electronic Engineering and/or Physics.

  • Strong weapon systems engineering background, knowledge and experience, including a sound understanding of weapon system survivability/effectiveness design and performance evaluation.

  • Strong engineering background in, knowledge of and experience in multi-spectral observables/signature management design, material selection and application, component integration, and performance evaluation.

  • Multispectral computational electromagnetic (CEM) prediction techniques and codes.

  • Multi-spectral observables/signature management measurement techniques, including near and far-field measurements utilizing anechoic chamber and outdoor test facilities.

  • Weapon system survivability analysis methodology

  • Good understanding of air and ground threat systems and their performance.

  • Able to think deeply and deliberately on methods to harness new or existing technologies.

  • Able to work well with others in a small high performing team environment.

  • Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Schedule: M-F; 8-5

Work Location: customer site

Travel: yes

Relocation Assistance Available: possible

Position Contingent Upon Award of Contract: No

#LI-AH1

title: Risk Technology Consultant
description:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

Job Description:

What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze business, risk, compliance, audit, security, and technology processes to identify improvement opportunities.

  • Support IT audits, cybersecurity assessments, compliance reviews, technology risk assessments, and control testing.

  • Evaluate technology processes such as change management, logical access, IT operations, system security, and related controls.

  • Document business, functional, technical, and data requirements based on client needs and project scope.

  • Support the design, configuration, prototyping, testing, and implementation of GRC, compliance, financial crime, and risk management technology solutions.

  • Assist with system configuration for GRC, fraud, customer risk rating, sanctions screening, audit management, third-party risk management, operational risk management, or other risk/compliance platforms.

  • Develop and execute test plans, test scripts, user acceptance testing support, and issue tracking.

  • Support automation efforts, including scripts, testing automation, workflow improvements, UI components, reports, dashboards, and documentation.

  • Analyze data to support control testing, compliance reviews, system validation, reporting, and client decision-making.

  • Prepare client-ready documentation, including requirements, process flows, test results, user guides, training materials, reports, and presentations.

  • Collaborate with clients and teammates to translate business problems into technology-enabled, sustainable solutions.

  • Continue building technical skills in areas such as GRC platforms, cloud, automation, data analytics, AI-enabled tools, and risk technology.

Expectations:

  • Strong interest in technology, risk management, business process improvement, compliance, cybersecurity, automation, data analytics, or systems implementation.

  • Technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms, tools, systems, and technical concepts.

  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills to develop effective, technology-enabled solutions to address client challenges, including thoughtfully evaluating outputs from new tools and technologies.

  • Curiosity and adaptability by learning new tools and technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities, and applying them to help solve problems.

  • Ability to translate business needs into requirements, process designs, testing plans, documentation, or technical solutions.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Comfort working in fast-paced, evolving environments with multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and commitment to high-quality work.

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team.

  • Intellectual curiosity and desire to build specialized skills in risk technology, IT controls, automation, data, cybersecurity, or GRC platforms.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, ownership, and interest in identifying opportunities to improve client outcomes and delivery approaches.

  • Ability to build an understanding of how your work contributes to client outcomes and overall business value.

  • Willingness to travel based on client and project needs. Travel expectations may vary by team, client, and engagement type.

  • Future certification interest to include CPA, CIA, CISA, or other firm-supported credentials aligned to the consultant’s area of focus.

Qualifications:

Outstanding academic performance in one of the following preferred majors or comparable fields:

  • Computer Science

  • Data Analytics

  • Information Science

  • Information Systems

  • Information Technology

  • Information Technology Management

  • Informatics

  • Management Information Systems

  • Security Risk Analysis

  • IT Risk Management

  • Computer Engineering or related engineering fields

  • Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or Operations Management with a technology focus, minor, or double major

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

Crowe accepts applications for this role on an ongoing basis.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $62,000 - $100,000 per year.

Our Benefits:
Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We care about our people and offer employees a comprehensive total rewards package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

How You Can Grow:
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

Crowe (www.crowe.com) is one of the largest public accounting, consulting and technology firms in the United States. Crowe uses its deep industry expertise to provide audit services to public and private entities while also helping clients reach their goals with tax, advisory, risk and performance services. Crowe is recognized by many organizations as one of the country's best places to work. Crowe serves clients worldwide as an independent member of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory services firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

Crowe will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act.

title: Senior Faculty Technician
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Technician, you will provide specialist technical expertise to support research, teaching, and commercial activities across the School of Engineering, Physics and Mathematics. The role will be instrumental in the management, maintenance, and enhancement of the North East Space Skills and Technology (NESST) facilities (not exclusively), working in partnership with academic staff, industry collaborators, and space sector specialists to advance research, technology development, and workforce skills.

As part of a multidisciplinary technical team, working alongside other technicians and the Scientific Officer, you will support pioneering activity in areas including optical satellite communications, satellite manufacturing and testing, space weather and space-based energy. You will play a key role in enabling world-class research, delivering specialist technical training, and helping to establish NESST as a centre of excellence for space skills, innovation and education.

Further information is available in the job description.

ABOUT THE TEAM
Within the School of Engineering, Physics and Mathematics at the Faculty of Science and Environment, the Department of Physics focuses on a broad spectrum of research areas, with core groups in Astrophysics (including Solar and Space Physics), Space Technology, Photovoltaics, Renewable Energy Technology and Materials, and Smart Materials & Surface We take a highly collaborative approach, working with a diverse range of academic and industry partners.

The successful candidate will be based in the NESST Building on our City Campus, as part of a multidisciplinary technical team comprising one Scientific Officer and a Laboratory Technician, all led by a Technical Manager.

ABOUT YOU
To be successful in the role you will have a degree or HND, preferably in Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Material Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline. Experience in operating, maintaining and laboratory or cleanroom equipment, particularly environmental testing and vacuum-based systems. The role also requires a proven ability to independently diagnose complex technical faults in equipment operation and to implement effective solutions. Experience in a technical role within cleanroom facilities is required.

You will possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to guide, train and support a diverse range of users, from students and early-career researchers to experienced academics and external partners. You will be equally comfortable working independently and contributing as part of a collaborative technical team.

Strong organisational and time-management skills are essential, together with the ability to manage competing priorities, coordinate multiple activities simultaneously and consistently deliver high-quality outcomes within agreed timescales. The role requires a proactive approach to responding to changing operational demands while maintaining a high standard of service delivery.

A high level of accuracy and attention to detail is required when maintaining technical records and documentation, ensuring compliance with relevant policies, procedures, and quality standards. This includes the management of equipment maintenance records, data logs, operational documentation, incident reports, and other compliance-related information.

Knowledge and proven experience in the implementation and management of health and safety requirements within science and engineering environments are required. You will be confident in developing, reviewing and applying risk assessments, standard operating procedures, COSHH assessments, and other compliance documentation, while providing guidance to staff and students to ensure safe and effective working practices.
Further information is available in the person specification.

If you would like an informal discussion about the role, please contact Demelza Menendez (demelza.menendez@northumbria.ac.uk)
To apply for this vacancy please click 'Apply Now'. Your application should include a covering letter and a CV.

ABOUT US

Join Northumbria University, a research-intensive institution unlocking potential and changing lives locally and globally. Named Times Higher Education's University of the Year in 2022 and Modern University of the Year in 2025, we rank top 25 in the UK for research power. Discover more about us.

With over 37,000 students from 140+ countries, we offer world-leading research, award-winning partnerships, and an outstanding student experience. We empower our exceptional staff, promoting a positive work-life balance and offering great benefits, including excellent pension schemes, flexible working, generous holiday entitlement and more.

Our Northumbria Values, co-created by our team, define who we are: Academic Excellence, Innovation, Inclusivity, Collaboration, and Ambition. Our Behaviours shape our work culture: We listen and learn, support one another, respect everyone, trust each other, and are bold.

Based in Newcastle upon Tyne and London, we are an on-campus organisation and offer flexible hours and location where the role allows. We pride ourselves on diversity and inclusivity, holding numerous awards for gender and race equality, disability confidence, and research excellence. We also hold the HR Excellence in Research award for implementing the concordat supporting the career Development of Researchers and are members of the Euraxess initiative to deliver information and support to professional researchers. The University has implemented a range of flexible working arrangements, and we are happy to explore candidate requirements as part of the recruitment process.

Apply now and join a community committed to transforming society and the economy. Explore "Our Exceptional People, Our Values and Behaviours" page to learn more about our commitments and see our Privacy Policy for further details.

title: Software Engineer (Generative AI and Innovation)
description:
Job Description

Excited by the pace of AI and the chance to build something meaningful? Join our growing Innovation team in Dublin and help create next-generation applications using the latest tools, technologies, and ideas. AI is a huge part of what we do — but we’re an innovation team first, applying whatever emerging technology best solves the problem, from LLMs to data, integration, and automation.

You’ll work alongside experienced and curious colleagues in a collaborative environment that encourages exploration, learning, and shared problem-solving. With strong support from senior leaders and visibility across the business, the team is well placed to develop, test, and scale new solutions. Your work will be visible, valued, and connected to key priorities from day one.

This is a hybrid position with a requirement of 3 days in the office.

THE ROLE & YOUR MISSION

This is an opportunity to grow as an engineer while building, testing, and scaling solutions that make a real difference. As a mid-level member of the team, you’ll take ownership of features and components end to end, turning ideas into practical applications that address real business and client needs — with AI and LLMs the biggest part of the toolkit, alongside data, integration, and automation. Alongside hands‑on engineering, you’ll help shape our innovation hub by contributing to hackathons, engaging with the broader tech community, and supporting a culture centered on experimentation, learning, collaboration, and results.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Own medium‑scale features and components end to end, from prototyping through to production‑ready solutions, with senior guidance available when you need it
  • Contribute to design discussions, bringing sound technical reasoning and viable suggestions to the table
  • Build practical applications — AI‑powered and otherwise — that address real business problems and deliver measurable value
  • Work closely with colleagues across our Dublin and international Innovation teams, while taking initiative and contributing your own ideas
  • Work in an Agile environment where you can experiment, learn quickly, and see the impact of your work
  • Stay hands‑on with the latest AI tools, models, and techniques, with ongoing opportunities to learn, test, and evolve
  • Build and maintain evaluation harnesses and follow good practice in prompt engineering, experimentation, and solution design
  • Create reusable components, tools, and patterns that help the wider team work more effectively and consistently
  • Share what you learn, support technical quality, and help junior colleagues grow through code reviews and pairing
WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT

This is a chance to accelerate your career in a team that’s growing quickly and working with purpose. You’ll own meaningful work, explore the latest technologies, and develop your craft while helping shape how we build. With strong leadership support, visibility across the business, and access to the resources of a global organization, you’ll have the platform to make a genuine impact while continuing to grow. And you’ll do it from Dublin, one of Europe’s most dynamic and well‑connected tech hubs.

What you need to have:
  • Solid software engineering experience (typically 2–5 years), with a track record of delivering features independently
  • Experience contributing to production‑grade applications
  • Hands‑on experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript development, including a framework such as React, Vue, or Angular
  • Backend experience with Node.js, NestJS, or similar technologies
  • Experience using Python to build AI‑powered workflows, integrations, or applications
  • Good understanding of APIs and integrating AI into real‑world products and business processes
  • Hands‑on experience building with LLMs, including prompt design, tool use, and structured outputs
  • Familiarity with RAG, retrieval pipelines, and embeddings
  • Exposure to modern agent patterns and multi‑step, tool‑connected workflows
  • Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes, and an interest in how AI applications are deployed and scaled
  • Good communication skills, a practical and thoughtful approach to problem‑solving, and the ability to work across engineering and business teams
What makes you stand out:
  • Experience taking features from early experimentation through to production use
  • Curiosity about emerging standards in the agent ecosystem, including Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Exposure to vector databases and semantic search
  • An eye for the quality, reliability, latency, and cost‑efficiency of AI systems
  • Exposure to AI evaluation frameworks, testing approaches, and guardrails for reliable and responsible AI
  • A willingness to support others and contribute to engineering best practices

We know that candidates may not meet every listed requirement exactly. If you’re excited about the role and believe you could thrive in it, we encourage you to apply.

Why join our team:
  • We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
  • We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
  • Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well‑being.

description:
About you:

We recognise that diversity & inclusion are catalysts for success. We’re heightening awareness on the benefits of people diversity, diversity of experiences and diversity of our perspectives. Creating a culture of inclusivity where all employees feel a sense of belonging.

Our combined energy is fueled by different nationalities, across 6 continents and 24 countries. Our commitment is to celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability.

About the job:

Kent is looking for a Senior Cost Engineer based in Dubai, UAE.

The Senior Cost Engineer is a pivotal client-side project controls position embedded directly within the asset owner’s project delivery team based in Dubai. Operating from the client/operator perspective, this role holds primary responsibility for the overall financial governance, budget management, commercial evaluation, and cost forecasting of major energy infrastructure capital projects. Acting as a trusted commercial authority, you will closely monitor multi-million-dollar EPC contractor expenditures, evaluate variation orders, implement robust change management frameworks, and deliver executive-level financial reporting aligned with international joint-venture standards.

Skills and Responsibilities:
  • Establish, monitor, and enforce overarching cost control systems, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and budget baselines across assigned major capital projects.
  • Review, audit, and validate EPC/EPCM contractor progress payment certificates, monthly valuation applications, milestone billings, and detailed timesheets to ensure alignment with actual physical completion.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously refine realistic EAC forecasts, cash flow projections, commitment logs, and risk/contingency drawdowns.
  • Lead the technical and commercial evaluation of contractor Variation Requests and Change Order Requests (CORs); perform cost-impact assessments and negotiate equitable adjustments.
  • Manage project financial structures within SAP Project Systems (PS)—including WBS creation, purchase order (PO) commitments, Service Entry Sheet (SES) approvals, and final asset capitalization workflows.
  • Protect project financial interests by proactively auditing contractor cost reports, identifying billing discrepancies early, and developing technical defenses against potential commercial claims.
  • Prepare high-level monthly cost variance reports, Earned Value Management (EVM) metrics, and executive dashboards for senior project leadership, board members, and international shareholders.
  • Partner closely with Project Managers, Planning/Scheduling Engineers, Procurement Leads, and Contracts Engineers to integrate cost trends with project schedule critical paths.
Your knowledge/skills, education, and experience:

Knowledge/ Qualification/ Training/ Certification:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, or Industrial), Quantity Surveying, Finance, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum 10 to 12+ years of dedicated cost engineering or project controls experience within the oil and gas sector (upstream, midstream, or major gas processing facilities).
  • Significant background operating in a Senior/Lead capacity managing multi-hundred-million-dollar capital project budgets.
  • Extensive experience working on the client/operator side (IOC, NOC, or major joint venture), overseeing tier-1 EPC/EPCM contractors.
  • Based in or prepared to work full-time from the regional engineering hub in Dubai, UAE, with potential travel to project operational sites as required.
  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English is mandatory for high-level shareholder reporting and executive management presentations. Conversational Arabic is a distinct advantage.

Communication:

  • Excellent interpersonal and analytical attributes
  • Able to effectively communicate technical issues to peers and line manager (written and verbal)

Skills

  • Advanced mastery of SAP Project Systems (PS) and Commercial Management modules (WBS maintenance, SES processing, and financial reporting).
  • Expert capability in analyzing Cost Performance Index (CPI), Schedule Performance Index (SPI), and integrating cost curves with Primavera P6 schedules.
  • Deep knowledge of FIDIC and customized EPC contract conditions, change management protocols, and claim negotiation principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in MS Excel (complex financial modeling, macro-driven dashboards, pivot tables) and cost-estimation databases.

Core Competencies

  • Professional firmness to rigorously challenge unjustified contractor scope additions, inflated unit rates, or unverified progress claims.
  • Uncompromising commitment to corporate governance, transparency, and audit trail precision.
  • Ability to look beyond immediate spend to foresee long-term budget risks, market inflation impacts, and currency/commercial exposures.

  • Exceptional skill in translating complex financial metrics into concise, actionable executive summaries for non-financial stakeholders.

Preferred Certifications (Optional)

  • Certified Cost Professional (CCP) or Certified Estimating Professional (CEP) via AACE International.
  • Member or Fellow of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (MRICS/FRICS) or equivalent chartered quantity surveyor status.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or formal SAP End-User/Super-User certification.

  • Own hiring, performance management, recognition, and career growth initiatives.

Accelerate Business Development

  • Champion consultative sales practices and relationship-focused lending.
  • Represent Atlantic in the community to enhance brand visibility and lending opportunities.

Optimize Financial and Operational Performance

  • Drive technology initiatives that improve reporting, efficiency, and the lending experience.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory, investor, and credit union requirements while maintaining strong risk management standards.

Who We Are


We are Atlantic. Our mission is to help people do better. We’re a fast-moving, inclusive team that cares about getting to the right answer and making good decisions. We value clarity, accountability, and people who aren’t afraid to ask tough questions and challenge how things are done.

Atlantic is an Equal Opportunity Employer.


Why Join Atlantic?

At Atlantic, residential lending isn't a back-office function, it's a growth engine, and this role leads it. Here's what you'll get:

  • A seat at the table with meaningful influence on company direction.
  • Broad exposure across the entire organization.
  • Leadership growth with real autonomy and accountability.
  • A collaborative, growth-oriented culture with flexibility and support.
  • Competitive compensation, full benefits, and 401K match.

You'll own the strategy, the P&L, and the team with the support of an organization that measures success by the members who get into homes because of the work you do.


Ready to Build Something Bigger?

If you're ready to lead a residential lending division where you'll own the strategy, build the team, and grow the business, not just manage the pipeline, we'd love to connect. Apply today!

title: Employee & Labor Relations Expert
description:
Cosun is een internationale agrarische coöperatie die al ruim 125 jaar bestaat en in handen is van zo’n 8.000 telers van suikerbieten. Het is ons doel bij te dragen aan een plezierige, voedzame en circulaire wereld door met elkaar alles uit onze gewassen te halen en het goed te doen voor huidige en toekomstige generaties. Cosun is georganiseerd in meerdere businessgroepen, namelijk Cosun Beet Company, Aviko, Cosun Ingredients & Duynie.

Binnen Cosun en onze businessgroepen, implementeren wij een nieuw Target Operating Model met als drie complementaire onderdelen: business, centre of excellence en shared service centre. Met dit model, bouwen we aan een toekomstbestendige organisatie. HR maakt hier onderdeel van uit. Door expertise te bundelen en processen te standaardiseren, versterken we kwaliteit, transparantie en naleving van wet- en regelgeving. Binnen HR speelt het centre of excellence een centrale rol in het ontwikkelen van beleid, kaders en standaarden die de hele organisatie ondersteunen.

Context en wat ga je doen?

Binnen het HR centre of excellence ontwikkelt en stuurt het team op richtinggevende, organisatiebrede kaders op basis van strategische prioriteiten, marktontwikkelingen en wet- en regelgeving. Het CoE fungeert als inhoudelijk kompas en architect voor HR-beleid en borgt samenhang, consistentie en schaalbaarheid over alle businessgroepen heen.

Vanuit deze rol vertaalt het team de Cosun-strategie en externe ontwikkelingen naar integrale en toekomstbestendige oplossingen, waarbij niet alleen wordt gereageerd op behoeften uit de business, maar actief richting wordt gegeven aan besluitvorming en beleidsvorming in aansluiting op de Cosun strategie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het vormgeven en implementeren van een samenhangende Employee & Labour Relations strategie, waarbij je zorgt voor een evenwichtige balans tussen organisatie brede doelstellingen inclusief het centrale medezeggenschapsorgaan (COR) en belangen van medewerkers en medezeggenschapsorganen van de verschillende Business Groepen binnen Cosun.

Wat je concreet doet binnen de organisatie

  • Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een Employee & Labour Relations strategie die aansluit op organisatiedoelstellingen, waarden en de diverse workforce-structuren binnen Cosun
  • Je ontwerpt en realiseert een Labour Relations programma in samenwerking met HR en business, en vertegenwoordigt de organisatie tijdens CAO-onderhandelingen en andere arbeidsrechtelijke vraagstukken

As a member of the Enterprise Transformation team, the Transformation Delivery Director leads a portfolio of complex programs and cross-functional initiatives supporting Digital Asset Solutions while acting as strategic partner to business, technology, operations, and control leaders. This role is responsible for ensuring alignment between enterprise strategy, investment, and execution while driving disciplined delivery, transparency, and measurable business outcomes across the portfolio for DTCC, our clients, and the global financial markets. Success in this position demands the ability to oversee multiple complex programs, engage executives to shape priorities, resolve tradeoffs, and remove barriers, and develop high-performing teams of program management professionals that deliver predictable outcomes in the face of ambiguity and evolving enterprise needs.


Your Primary Responsibilities:

Portfolio & Program Leadership

Executive & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with enterprise portfolio leaders to balance delivery rigor, financials, capacity constraints, and evolving business priorities across the enterprise.
  • Develop and deliver executive level communications, including portfolio health views, risk narratives, dependency analyses, investment tradeoffs, and outcome reporting.

Delivery Governance & Risk Management

  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and talent development across Transformation Delivery.

Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively at the executive level, with strong judgment, influence, and communication skills.
  • Advanced capability in developing executive‑level materials and narratives, including dashboards, decision papers, and strategic narratives.
  • Strong financial and analytical acumen, including experience overseeing budgets, investment tradeoffs, and outcome realization.
  • Experience with portfolio and program management tooling (e.g., Planview, Jira) and enterprise governance models.
  • Advanced program or portfolio management certification (e.g., PgMP, PMP) strongly preferred.
  • SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE) certification or experience is a plus, including hands-on experience facilitating Agile execution, dependency management, and program-level delivery governance.
  • Experience with digital assets and/or blockchain technology and products a plus

Talents Needed for Success:

  • Strong enterprise mindset with the ability to align strategy, execution, and outcomes across diverse initiatives and stakeholders.
  • Executive presence and credibility, with the ability to influence, challenge constructively, and drive alignment at senior levels.
  • Proven ability to lead program management professionals, developing high performing talent while maintaining accountability for results.

title: Jr./Mid Machine Learning Engineer – Time-Series & Inertial AI
description:
We are building a new Systems-Level Integration (SLI) team focused on Smart high-performance Inertial Sensors and Systems. As a Machine Learning Engineer in our expanding Riyadh office, you will pioneer the use of Deep Learning to enhance the raw performance of MEMS IMU sensors.
In the initial phase of this role, you will focus entirely on software, simulation, and data-driven modeling. You will work with datasets provided by our core engineering team to train models that correct stochastic errors, denoise signals, and improve sensor performance.

What You Will Do

  • Time-Series AI Development: Design, train, and validate neural networks (CNNs, LSTMs, TCNs, Transformers, etc…) to denoise raw inertial sensors data and fuse them for better performance.

  • Virtual Sensing: Develop AI models that enhance MEMS IMU sensor outputs using self-supervised or supervised learning techniques.

  • Data Pipeline Engineering: Build robust data processing pipelines to handle massive, high-frequency inertial systems datasets (filtering, normalization, augmentation, and windowing).

  • Cross-Border Collaboration: Work closely with the Egypt-based Systems and Firmware teams to ensure your models are designed within the computational limits of edge microcontrollers (TinyML).

  • Rapid prototyping: You will be implementing ML algorithms based on published academic research papers.

  • Research: You will be required to regularly survey state-of-the-art academic research papers on the intersection of machine learning and inertial systems.

  • Model Optimization: Quantize and prune trained PyTorch/TensorFlow models for eventual deployment on resource-constrained embedded targets (e.g., ARM Cortex-M).

(Must-Haves)

  • Education: BSc or MSc in Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or a strictly related engineering field.

  • SCE Membership: Engineer membership in the Saudi council of engineers (Engineer Grade category) is mandatory for this role.

  • AI/ML Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with Deep Learning frameworks (PyTorch preferred) and a solid understanding of training models on time-series data.

  • Coding: Python proficiency is mandatory, with strong software engineering practices (unit testing, modular code design).

  • Version Control: Git proficiency is mandatory.

The \"Nice-to-Haves\" (Bonus Points)

  • Sensor Fusion Knowledge: Familiarity with classical inertial navigation concepts, attitude representations, Extended Kalman Filters (EKF), or AHRS algorithms.

  • Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs): Understanding of how to constrain AI models using the laws of physics (e.g., kinematics).

  • Edge AI: Experience with machine learning model deployment on Microcontrollers, STM32Cube.AI, or ONNX runtime.

Why Join Us

  • Work on real-world AI + hardware systems, not just theoretic al models.

  • Be part of a deep-tech company building advanced sensing technologies.

  • Collaborate with highly specialized engineering teams across borders.

  • Take ownership as a one of the founding ML engineers in Riyadh.

  • Grow in an environment that embraces AI-driven innovation.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, 3D
description:
Position Overview

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (3D), you will be a lead contributor in building the next generation of AI-native applications. You sit at the intersection of robust backend orchestration and intuitive frontend design. Your primary mission is to design and implement "agentic" workflows/harnesses/systems where AI doesn't just respond to prompts but proactively executes tasks, manages state, and interacts with external tools to solve complex user problems.

You will work across the entire stack, leveraging best in class frameworks and tooling for both frontend, data storage, runtime and API design. You will work closely with the UX Research team to understand and develop new interfaces and interaction techniques.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Engineering: Lead the development of full-stack features, from database schema design to high-fidelity UI implementation
  • Agentic Workflow Orchestration: Design and implement backend logic that allows AI agents to interact with APIs, databases, and long-running processes autonomously
  • Agentic UX Design: Build "Human-in-the-loop" interfaces that allow users to monitor, steer, and collaborate with AI agents in real-time
  • Infrastructure & Security: Architect secure and performant backend systems using best practices and design patterns, to support high-concurrency AI operations
  • State Management: Manage complex, asynchronous application states where data may be updated concurrently by both users and background AI agents
  • Performance Optimization: Build efficient applications and services, understand how to best to maximize both perceived and actual user experience. Optimize the entire request-response lifecycle, focusing on minimizing latency in LLM streaming and database queries
  • Technical Health: Maintain high standards for code quality, focusing on static type safety, clean architectural consistency and comprehensive unit and integration testing

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience: Typically 5–8 years of professional full-stack software engineering experience
  • Frontend Stack: Deep expertise in React, TypeScript, and modern CSS/HTML. Ability to build complex, data-rich applications
  • Backend Stack: Proven experience with RDBs (e.g. PostgreSQL) and Object Stores (e.g. s3)
  • API Design: Strong experience designing and consuming RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs with a focus on reliability and security
  • AI Development Tooling: Expert-level proficiency with modern agentic development environments (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf) to accelerate the shipping cycle
  • Architecture: Solid understanding of distributed systems, serverless architectures, and relational database modeling
  • Deployment: Familiarity with CI/CD practices and tools (e.g. Jenkins) and cloud providers for compute/network (e.g. AWS ALBs/ECS)
  • Communication: Ability to bridge the gap between technical LLM capabilities and practical, user-facing product features

Preferred Qualifications

  • Agentic Frameworks: Hands-on experience with agentic orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or PydanticAI)
  • AI UX Patterns: Deep understanding of "Agentic UX" patterns, such as ReAct, streaming UI updates, generative UI, and proactive notifications
  • LLM Observability: Experience with monitoring and evaluation tools for AI agents (e.g., LangSmith, Braintrust, or Helicone) to track agent reliability and cost
  • Tool-Calling Expertise: Proven track record of building "Tools/Functions" for LLMs to interact with third-party SaaS platforms or internal databases
  • Durable Runtimes: Hands-on experience with durable runtime frameworks such as temporal or similar
  • Storage: Experience with Supabase e.g. Row Level Security (RLS), and database migrations
  • Vector Databases: Familiarity with pgvector or other vector stores for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) workflows
  • Real-time Systems: Experience with WebSockets or Supabase Realtime to provide instant feedback for long-running agentic tasks

description:
The Department of Physiology at the University of Tennessee Health Sciences invites applications for a full-time, non-tenure Instructor position.

Responsibilities include executing the experiments, training, and supervising fellows and students, and managing laboratory maintenance (including purchasing, storage, and inventory of reagents, cells, and supplies). Conceptual initiation and project oversight are required.

EDUCATION: Ph.D., M.D., or equivalent degree.

EXPERIENCE: Minimum three (3) years of Postdoctoral experience or equivalent.

THE UNIVERSITY OF TENNESSEE HEALTH SCIENCES

The University of Tennessee Health Sciences is a statewide flagship, public, academic health institution in Tennessee. Founded in 1911, the mission of the University of Tennessee Health Sciences is to improve the health and well-being of Tennesseans and the global community by fostering collaborative education, research, scientific discovery, clinical care, and public service. Employing more than 4,600 people on its faculty, staff, and not-for-profit corporation faculty practice groups, and with more than 3,200 students across the state, UT Health Sciences contributes $4 billion to the economy of Tennessee.

Part of the University of Tennessee System, the Health Sciences is headquartered in Memphis and includes all six of UT’s doctoral-degree-granting health science colleges -- Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Nursing, Graduate Health Sciences, and Health Professions. UT Health Sciences spans the state with its four major, regional clinical health science locations in Memphis, Knoxville, Chattanooga, and Nashville, as well as more than 100 clinical education sites across Tennessee. UT Health Sciences is the largest educator of health care professionals in the state and operates the state’s largest residency and fellowship advanced training programs.

Located in West Tennessee on the banks of the Mississippi River, Memphis is the second-largest city in the state and among the largest cities in the Southeast. The Greater Memphis metropolitan area has more than 1.3 million residents, and the city ranks among those with the lowest cost of living in the country. It is home to a vibrant restaurant scene, a revitalized Downtown, the Midtown Arts District, many scenic neighborhoods, an active medical district, and a burgeoning airport in the midst of a $214 million modernization.

Memphis boasts attractions, including Elvis Presley’s Graceland, the Memphis Grizzlies, historic Beale Street, the National Civil Rights Museum, the second-largest urban county park in the United States, and the Memphis in May World Championship Barbecue Cooking Contest.

title: AIML - Senior Applied ML Research Scientist, Accessibility
description:
We are seeking an Applied Machine Learning Research Scientist to join our Accessibility efforts on the Human-Centered Machine Intelligence (HCMI) team within AIML at Apple. Research Scientists in HCMI tackle significant technical challenges, collaborate with partner teams to ship products, and shape the field of human-centered AIML via external publication. Join us to advance ML research and intelligent interactive technologies that enable people of all abilities to use Apple technology.

The Human-Centered Machine Intelligence (HCMI) group advances ML modeling and interactive technologies grounded in human-centered research. We are a close-knit team of research scientists and engineers working closely with product and platform teams across Apple.

The Accessibility team within HCMI specifically focuses on core ML technologies that address grand challenges in accessibility, including equitable speech access for people with communication disabilities, visual understanding for people who are blind or low vision, sign language technology, and more. We are especially interested in researchers who want to bring expertise in one or more of the following areas to these accessibility challenges: multimodal reasoning, agentic systems and multi-turn interaction, contextual understanding, privacy-preserving ML, and synthetic data and evaluation methodologies.

Minimum Qualifications

  • PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction or related field.
  • Experienced researcher, with research depth in one or more of: multimodal modeling, agentic systems and tool use, computer vision, speech, or foundation model post-training and evaluation.
  • Publication and research record commensurate with seniority.
  • Proven history of turning research contributions into tools, datasets or products, or strong potential to do so.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience conducting research in accessibility or demonstrated commitment to accessibility.
  • Experience doing data collection or data curation (e.g., developing data or annotation protocols).
  • Experience with human-centered evaluation methods (e.g., developing user study protocols or running studies).
  • Experience developing and shipping products that use machine learning.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills.

Job Description


Perform maintenance/repairs on sedans, light/medium/heavy trucks, trailers and heavy work equipment and any attached equipment, and/or auxiliary equipment, which is part of the specialized vehicles, operated by the Company. The following list sets forth the principal duties required for the job. This list is not intended to limit assignment of work or the degree of supervision under all operating conditions. Employee may perform miscellaneous, related, and incidental work in addition to that specifically outlined below.

What you’ll do:

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Service and repair boom/pedestal assemblies of the Company’s specialized equipment including troubleshooting equipment; inspect cables, chains and rods; inspect sheave liners; inspect and repair monitoring system; inspect fiberglass components; inspect turntable; remove and replace reduction gearboxes; inspect pins, bushings and bearings; and load test boom assemblies.

  • Service and repair hydraulic systems including troubleshooting the hydraulic system; inspect, remove and replace hydraulic pumps, motors, valves, cylinders and the accumulator; and remove and replace swivel collector block.

  • Service and repair heating and ventilation systems including diagnose A/C unit problems; conduct pressure test on A/C unit; check for leaks using appropriate devices; check internal system controls; replace compressor; service A/C clutch assembly; and replace compressor seals, refrigerant hose, condenser assembly, receiver dryer, and evaporator core.

  • Troubleshoot and repair winch assemblies.

  • Service and repair the steering system of Company vehicles including repair power steering pump and manual steering gearbox.

  • Service and repair the air brake systems of Company vehicles including air compressors, air brake chambers, and air control valves.

  • Service and repair hydraulic and electric braking systems including inspect and repair master cylinder; test power unit and vacuum supply; inspect power boost system; repair power brake system; and service and repair antilock brake system.

  • Inspect and service differentials and power dividers and transmission assemblies of Company vehicles including manual clutch, manual transmissions and transfer cases, transaxles (front-wheel-drive), and automatic transmissions.

  • Service and repair the fuel and exhaust systems including computer control system; test and repair diesel fuel pump; inspect and service intake and turbo system; service and repair fuel injection system (gas/diesel); and inspect and service governors.

  • Assist others in the diagnosis of more complex problems.

  • Operate Company vehicles and associated equipment and perform duties incidental to the operation of such equipment.

  • Maintain tools, equipment and work area in a clean and orderly condition.

  • Maintain records and submit reports as required.

  • Attend and participate in training as assigned and assist in the training of other employees.

  • Perform less skilled work as assigned.

  • Report irregularities and abnormal conditions.

  • Assist employees of equal or higher classification.

  • Direct the work of employees assigned to assist.

Minimum Requirements for Fleet Technician B:

Education:

  • High school graduate or GED required.

Experience:

  • At least 2 years of strong automotive mechanical diagnosis with hydraulic and diesel repair experience. Graduation from an automotive trade school with diesel engine experience is highly desirable.

Licenses/Certifications:

  • Must possess and maintain a valid state driver's license.

  • Must obtain Class A CDL within 12 months of entry date into the Fleet Technician B classification or vacate the job classification.

  • Must obtain Fluid Power Society Certification and two (2) applicable ASE certifications within 24 months of entry date or vacate the current job classification.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

These are additional expectations for the job and could include specific work experience, license / certifications, preemployment testing, expectations about travel, shift work, etc.

  • Must qualify through demonstration, examination and/or performance appraisal as determined by the Company.

  • Must exhibit competency and aptitude in the fundamentals and mechanics of vehicle maintenance and repairs.

  • Must become familiar with and have the ability to operate the computer systems utilized by the Fleet Services organization.

  • Must acquire within such time frame as determined by the company, the qualifications necessary to perform the duties of the Fleet Technician A or vacate the current job classification.

  • Successful completion of the Tuff Tech pre-employment placement test is required for this position.

  • For Fleet Techs that support Transmission, travel of 80% – 100% may be required.

  • Shift work may be required

Fleet Technician B wages: ~$33.00/hour-$37.00/hour with additional upward movement available into a Fleet Technician A!

As time permits there will be options for performing independent AI based research, including publications and presentations.

The position will be in our new facilities at DEPICT (at Rigshospitalet) and referring to both Department of Radiology with Professor Adam Espe Hansen and Department of Nuclear Medicine with Professor Flemming Littrup Andersen.

The Centre of Diagnostic Investigation comprises a collection of highly specialized departments: Diagnostic radiology, clinical biochemistry, pathology, clinical immunology, clinical physiology/nuclear medicine, clinical microbiology, clinical genetics & center of genomic medicine.

title: Organisation Design Principal
description:
About Citco

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office Locations worldwide. With more than $2 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.

For more information about Citco, please visit

About the Team & Business Line:

Citco Group provides services to our Citco Group of Companies and helps business to succeed in client service excellence.

The Citco HR function comprises of five teams that collaborate to support business operations: Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, Reward, People Operations and HR Business Partners. We are now evolving this model by introducing Organisation Design as a new, enterprise capability within HR.

Your role:

The Design function is putting in place a structured way of making decisions about how Citco is organised - how many management layers exist, where accountability sits, how wide each manager's span of control is, and whether the structure fits what the business needs to deliver.

This role does the hands-on organisation design work: reviewing current structures, supporting business units through structure changes using Citco's org design framework, and building the analysis that design decisions rest on so that org design at Citco is a continuous discipline, not a one-off event.

This is a unique opportunity to help build Citco’s OD capability from the ground up. The role offers a challenging but highly rewarding mandate, with real scope to influence executive decision-making, introduce innovative approaches, and embed OD thinking at enterprise level.
The successful candidate will have the chance to make a lasting impact, helping to shape a function that delivers meaningful insight, drives strategic outcomes, and evolves with the business.

Current-state analysis and structure reviews

  • Document and map existing organisation structures across business units: reporting lines, spans of control, management layers, and governance forums.

  • Map the current operating model alongside the structure: end-to-end activities performed by each function, how work flows across teams, where decisions are made, and how this connects to what the business is trying to deliver.

  • Identify structural problems with evidence: duplicate roles and activities, capacity constraints, key person dependencies, hand-off friction between teams, and spans or layers outside Citco's benchmarks.

  • Build and maintain the org structure baseline and span and layer reporting and keep it current.

Support design and testing of future structures

  • Start every design engagement from strategy: understand what the business unit is trying to achieve, what the operating model needs to deliver, and translate that into design criteria.

  • Support the full design cycle under Citco's org design framework: from the case for change and current-state assessment, through design principles, option development, and design testing, to role design and transition.

  • Prepare the materials for design sessions with business leaders covering structure options, span and layer effects, headcount and cost comparisons - and support facilitation.

  • Test proposed designs rigorously before they are approved: clear accountability for each outcome, workflow without unnecessary hand-offs, clarity of decision rights, interfaces between teams, leader capacity, capability gaps, client impact, and resilience.

  • Support role design: role profiles and accountabilities for affected roles, role mapping from current to future structure, and workforce impact analysis.

  • Support transition planning: future-state headcount models including growth scenarios, hiring requirements, and analysis of impacted teams and individuals.

Governance and measurement

  • Manage incoming requests through the OD intake and triage process, applying the criteria for when OD involvement is mandatory versus advisory.

  • Track whether structural changes deliver what was intended: benefits and adoption measures, post-implementation reviews 3–6 months after go-live, and the discipline's KPIs — managers within span benchmarks, layer counts by business unit, and structural changes processed through OD governance.

  • Work day-to-day with the discipline's key stakeholders: Business Directors, Finance, and within HR.

About You:

  • 8+ years' experience in HR, organisation design, workforce analytics or management consulting, with at least 4 years on organisation design or organisation effectiveness work.

  • Hands-on involvement in at least two significant restructures or design projects where you have mapped current states, built structure options, and tested designs.

  • Ability to think strategically about structure. You understand that an org structure is a consequence of the operating model and the strategy it serves.

  • Experience working directly with senior stakeholders on sensitive, confidential work

  • Familiarity with structured org design methods (e.g. Galbraith Star Model, Kates Kesler) and you have worked with a defined method rather than designed by instinct.

  • Experience analysing or designing operating models, understanding how work, decision rights, governance and structure fit together.

  • Exposure to Oracle Fusion HCM or similar HRIS data structures.

Core skills

  • Confident working with HR and organisational data in Excel (Power BI is a plus), able to build headcount models and span/layer analysis, and turn them into a clear, well-evidenced storyline.

  • Strong strategic thinking, business and financial acumen

  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills

  • Strong project management discipline

Our Benefits

Your wellbeing is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.
