Director- Privileged, Non-Human Identity & Operations Services (ID: WHQ00026720)

United's Digital Technology team is comprised of many talented individuals all working together with cutting-edge technology to build the best airline in the history of aviation. Our team designs, develops, and maintains massively scaling technology solutions brought to life with innovative architecture, data analytics, and digital solutions.

Job Overview and Responsibilities

The Director of Privileged, Non-Human Identity & Operations Services leads one of United's most critical cybersecurity portfolios, responsible for securing the privileged, machine, workload, automation, and AI identities that enable the enterprise. This role exists to reduce high-risk identity exposure, strengthen enterprise control effectiveness, and sustain secure, resilient operations across United’s 24x7 technology environment. This leader defines the strategy, architecture, governance, and transformation roadmap for these high-risk identity domains while providing executive oversight for Identity Operations & Resilience. The role partners across technology and business teams to strengthen security, improve operational resilience, and accelerate United's digital transformation through modern identity capabilities.

  • Privileged & Non-Human Identity Strategy:
    • Define strategy, roadmap, operating model, and governance for privileged and non-human identity services that reduce enterprise identity risk, improve control maturity, and align investment priorities to United’s cybersecurity and digital transformation objectives.
    • Architecture & Engineering Leadership:

This role is Remote.

title: Sr Identity Access Management Engineer
description:
When you’re the best, we’re the best. We instill an environment where employees feel engaged, satisfied and able to contribute their unique skills and talents while living and working as their authentic selves. We provide extensive opportunities for personal and professional development, building both employee competence and organizational capability to fuel exceptional performance through an inclusive environment both now and in the future.

Summary:

In this role, you will lead the design, implementation, and support of enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions, with a primary focus on SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) and IdentityIQ (IIQ). You will deliver secure, scalable identity governance capabilities across cloud and on-premises environments, including identity lifecycle management, access governance, provisioning, role management, and system integrations. You will collaborate with Security, Risk, Audit, Technology, and business teams while providing technical leadership across complex IAM initiatives.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, configure, and maintain SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) and IdentityIQ (IIQ) solutions.
  • Develop and support identity profiles, lifecycle states, transforms, provisioning policies, workflows, rules, and access request processes.
  • Design and maintain identity lifecycle management processes, including joiner, mover, leaver (JML), provisioning, de-provisioning, and access changes.
  • Configure and support application onboarding, aggregation, reconciliation, identity correlation, and disconnected application integrations.
  • Develop integrations using SailPoint APIs, REST APIs, SCIM, Java, BeanShell, PowerShell, and related technologies.
  • Design and implement role-based access control (RBAC), attribute-based access control (ABAC), role mining, and role engineering solutions.
  • Lead access certification, segregation of duties (SoD), access governance, and risk-based identity control initiatives.
  • Support SailPoint IdentityIQ modernization and migration to SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, as applicable.
  • Partner with Security, Risk, Audit, Technology, and business teams to translate security, compliance, and technical requirements into scalable IAM solutions.
  • Implement governance controls and support audit and compliance requirements, including SOX, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001, and NIST.
  • Lead technical delivery across IAM initiatives, including requirements, solution design, testing, deployment, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communication.
  • Improve IAM processes, automation, security, and operational effectiveness while mentoring engineers and providing technical guidance across the team.

Qualifications:

  • Relevant degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Business, or related technical field preferred.
  • 5 or more years of progressive Identity and Access Management (IAM) experience required.
  • 5 or more years of hands-on SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) and/or IdentityIQ (IIQ) implementation experience required.
  • Experience implementing identity lifecycle management, access certifications, access requests, provisioning and de-provisioning, role management, segregation of duties (SoD), and RBAC or ABAC models.
  • Experience configuring SailPoint connectors, identity profiles, transforms, correlation rules, workflows, provisioning policies, certification campaigns, and access governance capabilities.
  • Experience integrating IAM solutions with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, LDAP, HR systems, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and relational databases.
  • Experience developing and supporting IAM integrations using REST APIs, SCIM, Java/BeanShell, PowerShell, Python, SQL, or similar technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of IAM standards and technologies, including SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), federation, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and Zero Trust principles.
  • Experience delivering enterprise-scale IAM solutions and working across complex cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Experience with privileged access management technologies such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, or similar platforms preferred.
  • Experience with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, SailPoint IdentityIQ-to-ISC migrations, enterprise RBAC, role mining, CI/CD practices, or related IAM technologies preferred.
  • SailPoint Identity Security Cloud Engineer or SailPoint IdentityIQ Engineer Certification highly preferred; additional identity, cloud security, cybersecurity or information security certifications preferred.

title: Project Controls Assistant
description:
About the job:

Kent is looking for a Project Controls Assistant to support project controls, financial administration, cost tracking, invoicing, reporting, and project administration activities for commissioning, construction, and engineering projects. This position works closely with Project Managers, Project Controls personnel, Procurement, Finance, and other project stakeholders to ensure accurate project reporting and financial management throughout the project lifecycle.


Skills and Responsibilities:

Responsibilities:

The Project Controls Assistant supports the financial, administrative, and reporting functions of a commissioning project. This role is responsible for maintaining cost tracking systems, supporting invoicing and billing processes, monitoring payment status, and assisting with project controls reporting. The position works closely with Project Managers, Cost Controllers, Procurement, and Finance teams to ensure accurate and timely project financial management.

Project Controls & Administration

  • Support daily project controls administration functions across the commissioning project lifecycle.
  • Maintain ERP system reports, project logs, and tracking tools to ensure accurate and up-to-date project data.
  • Organize and manage project documentation and files within designated project folders and systems.
  • Ensure data integrity between project controls systems, ERP tools, and internal tracking logs.

Cost Tracking & Reporting

  • Maintain invoice trackers, billing logs, and cost tracking tools.
  • Assist in the preparation of monthly project review reports and presentations.
  • Support cost forecasting activities by providing accurate and timely financial data.
  • Track project expenditures against budgets and highlight variances to the project team.

Invoicing & Billing

  • Prepare client invoices in accordance with contract terms and project milestones.
  • Support invoice validation by reconciling billed labor against approved timesheets.
  • Submit draft invoices to the Cost Controller for review prior to client submission.
  • Ensure all billing documentation is complete, accurate, and auditable.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to resolve billing discrepancies.

Client Payment Tracking

  • Track client payment status, including aging and outstanding receivables.
  • Participate in weekly Client Invoice Payment meetings and provide status updates.
  • Follow up on overdue invoices and coordinate with finance and project teams as needed.

Procurement & Vendor Coordination

  • Collaborate with the procurement team to review project purchase orders (POs) and vendor invoices.
  • Assist in validating vendor invoices against contract terms and received services.
  • Track commitments and expenditures related to procurement activities.

Financial Close & Accruals

  • Support the monthly accrual process by identifying unbilled work and outstanding costs.
  • Assist in month-end financial close activities, ensuring accurate cost capture.
  • Maintain supporting documentation for accruals and financial adjustments.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work under the guidance of the Project Manager and Cost Controls team.
  • Interface with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Procurement, Finance, and Field Teams.
  • Provide clear and timely updates on project financial status and billing progress.

Your Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience:

Knowledge / Qualification / Training / Certification:

  • 5 years of experience in project controls, accounting, or project administration (commissioning, construction, or engineering environment preferred).
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and project tracking tools.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or similar).
  • Basic understanding of project cost control, billing, and financial processes.
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced project environment.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Experience supporting commissioning or construction projects.
  • Familiarity with timekeeping systems and labor reconciliation processes.
  • Exposure to cost forecasting, accruals, and financial reporting cycles.

Communication:

• Excellent command of the English language in both oral and written communication and skills.
• Ability to communicate effectively with project teams and stakeholders.

Behavior / Core Competencies:

• Team-oriented and collaborative.
• Strong attention to detail.
• Proactive and organized.
• Adaptable and responsive to changing priorities.
• Demonstrates accountability and professionalism.

HSSEQ:

The Employee shall observe the Health, Safety, Sustainability, Environment, and Quality rules of the Company, its clients, and the governing authorities of the host country.

Details About the Role:

Location: Houston, TX
Relocation Required: No
Travel Required: Minimal, as required by project needs
Contract Type: Full Time, Regular
Experience Level: 5+ years

title: Software Engineer, App Store
description:
Apple Services Engineering is one of the most exciting examples of Apple's long-held passion for combining the liberal arts and technology. We are the people who power Apple TV, Apple Music, Apple Podcasts, Apple Books, and the App Store. Our products operate at massive scale, delivering a huge variety of entertainment to customers in more than 150 countries and over 35 languages, and meeting Apple's high expectations for performance and quality at every step. Our engineers build secure, end-to-end solutions: the custom software that processes creative work, the tools our providers use to deliver media, the server-side systems, and the APIs behind many Apple services. We use those systems to build delightful, easy-to-use customer experiences, increasingly enhanced by AI and generative AI. Thanks to Apple's unique integration of hardware, software, and services, engineers here get behind a single unified vision, one that always includes a deep commitment to privacy, a core Apple value. Although Services is a bigger part of Apple's business than ever, these teams remain small, nimble, and cross-functional, which means greater visibility and a wider array of opportunities than you might expect. If you care about the details that make an interface feel effortless, you will find a lot to love here.

As a Frontend Engineer on Apple Services Engineering, you will build the next generation of customer- facing user experiences for some of the world's most widely used subscription services. You will work day to day in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript alongside modern component frameworks and build tooling, partnering closely with design, product, and backend engineers to ship interfaces that are fast, accessible, and beautiful at global scale. This is a hands-on engineering role where craft matters. The surfaces you build are seen by hundreds of millions of people, so attention to detail, a high bar for quality, and a genuine investment in performance and accessibility are essential. You will also have the opportunity to help surface AI- powered and generative AI capabilities in consumer-facing interfaces, translating complex model behavior into experiences that feel simple and intuitive. We are looking for someone who is self-motivated and drives their commitments to completion, who collaborates generously, and who enjoys mentoring as much as being mentored. If you like solving hard problems and sweating the small stuff, this role is for you.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience building complex, large-scale production applications with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern JavaScript or TypeScript component framework, such as Svelte,
  • React, Vue, or equivalent.
  • Experience writing maintainable CSS at scale, including preprocessors or modern CSS tooling (Sass,
  • LESS, CSS modules, or equivalent).
  • Working knowledge of the modern frontend toolchain, including Node.js, package management,
  • module bundlers such as Vite or Webpack, continuous integration, and HTTP networking
  • fundamentals.
  • Experience writing automated tests for frontend code using frameworks such as Vitest, Jest,
  • Playwright, or Cypress.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated craft and a high quality bar, with strong attention to detail in shipped user interfaces.
  • Depth in web performance and accessibility, including profiling, measurement, and WCAG-aligned
  • practices in large-scale applications.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills spanning build tooling, network behavior, and the browser
  • runtime.
  • Experience with Svelte, and with building or maintaining shared component libraries and design
  • systems.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of partnering across design,
  • product, and backend, and of both mentoring and being mentored.
  • Self-motivated ownership, with a history of driving commitments to completion and surfacing risks
  • early.
  • Familiarity with AI and ML concepts, and experience integrating AI-driven or generative AI features into
  • web interfaces.

Research User Computing Linux Specialist

Company: King Abdullah University of Science & Technology

About the Role

The Research User Computing Linux Specialist designs, operates, and continuously improves KAUST's Linux-based research end-user computing platforms, including Ubuntu and Rocky Linux endpoints, physical scientific workstations, and virtual scientific workstation services. This role enables secure, reliable, and high-performance access to scientific desktop environments for faculty, researchers, and students.

Responsibilities

  • Administer, maintain, and improve Ubuntu and Rocky Linux end-user platforms to provide stable and secure scientific workstation services for KAUST's research and academic communities.
  • Develop, standardize, and maintain Linux workstation builds and images for physical and virtual scientific desktops, ensuring consistency, reliability, and readiness for research use.
  • Manage and support remote scientific workstation platforms, including NICE DCV and Kasm Workspaces, to enable secure, high-performance access to research desktop environments.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, patching, monitoring, and compliance activities using scripting, configuration management, Infrastructure as Code, and GitOps-aligned practices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex Linux endpoint, workstation, remote desktop, GPU, driver, performance, identity, storage, and network-related issues, escalating where deeper platform or infrastructure support is required.
  • Integrate Linux desktops and workstations with enterprise IAM, storage, network, monitoring, security, and endpoint management services to support compliant and reliable operations.
  • Partner with faculty, researchers, students, research labs, HPC, storage, security, and advanced computing teams to understand scientific workflows and translate requirements into sustainable workstation solutions.
  • Support installation, validation, and maintenance of scientific and research software on Linux workstation environments, considering compatibility, performance, reproducibility, and user needs.
  • Implement and maintain security and compliance controls for Linux workstation environments, including patching, hardening, audit logging, endpoint security, and alignment with KAUST policies and relevant frameworks.
  • Develop and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, user guidance, dashboards, and service metrics to improve supportability, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  • Evaluate new Linux desktops, remote access, virtualization, automation, and scientific workstation technologies, and provide recommendations to improve service quality and platform capability.
  • Perform other applicable tasks and duties assigned within the realm of the employee's knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of the position.

Qualifications

  • Essential: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Preferred: Relevant Linux certification such as Red Hat Certified Engineer, Linux Foundation Certified Engineer, LPIC, or equivalent.
  • Certification or formal training in configuration management, automation, security, IT service management, NICE DCV, Kasm Workspaces, or related platforms is desirable.
  • Security, cloud, networking, or endpoint management certifications such as Security+, CISSP, CCNA, ITIL, or equivalent are desirable.

Required Skills

  • Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills across endpoint, workstation, and scientific desktop environments.
  • Strong automation mindset, with the ability to reduce manual work through scripting, configuration management, Infrastructure as Code, and repeatable operational processes.
  • Good understanding of research and scientific computing needs, including GPU-enabled workstations, specialized software, reproducibility, performance, and secure remote access.
  • Ability to diagnose issues across operating systems, drivers, remote desktop platforms, identity, storage, network, security controls, and user-side configurations.
  • Customer-centric approach, with the ability to work directly with faculty, researchers, students, and technical teams, communicate clearly, and set realistic expectations.
  • Strong documentation and continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to create runbooks, standards, support materials, and operational metrics.
  • Good collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with platform, network, security, IAM, storage, HPC, vendor, and research support teams.
  • Awareness of security, compliance, auditability, and operational risk in enterprise and research computing environments.
  • Ability to prioritize work in a deadline-driven research and teaching environment while maintaining service reliability and user trust.
  • Willingness to learn and evaluate new Linux, remote workstation, automation, and scientific computing technologies.

Preferred Skills

  • Hands‑on experience with remote scientific workstation platforms such as NICE DCV, Kasm Workspaces, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with GPU‑enabled Linux workstations, NVIDIA/CUDA environments, scientific software stacks, or specialized research desktop environments.
  • Exposure to security and compliance baselines such as NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, CIS Benchmarks, ISO standards, or institutional security requirements.
  • Experience working directly with faculty, researchers, students, labs, vendors, and cross‑functional IT teams to gather requirements and deliver sustainable technical solutions.

title: Data Product Owner
description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

U.S. Bank is seeking an experienced Data Product Owner to drive the strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and delivery of data products within the Investment Services Data Domain. This role serves as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, governance partners, and technology teams, translating business needs into scalable, governed, and reusable data products that support reporting, analytics, operational decision-making, and AI-enabled use cases.

The Data Product Owner is accountable for the full lifecycle of assigned data products, including intake, prioritization, requirements management, adoption, governance, and continuous improvement. While primarily focused on product ownership and stakeholder engagement, this role may also contribute to the design, prototyping, and development of foundational "gold" data products to accelerate delivery, support modernization efforts, and promote consistency across the organization.


Essential Functions

  • Develop and maintain product vision, strategy, roadmaps, and priorities for assigned data products, ensuring alignment with business objectives and enterprise data strategy.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities, gather requirements, and translate business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlogs.
  • Lead intake, prioritization, and roadmap discussions, balancing business value, strategic objectives, technical dependencies, risk considerations, and available delivery capacity.
  • Collaborate with data engineering, architecture, analytics, and governance teams to design and deliver trusted, scalable, and reusable data products that support reporting, analytics, operational processes, and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Champion data-as-a-product principles, including product ownership, discoverability, documentation, governance, data quality, metadata, lineage, and lifecycle management.
  • Drive adoption and continuous improvement through stakeholder engagement, product performance monitoring, user feedback, and measurement of business outcomes.
  • Support the development and evolution of governed "gold" data products that improve consistency, traceability, scalability, and reuse across business and technology teams.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, modernize, and consolidate data assets and reporting solutions, including support for cloud migration and enterprise data initiatives.
  • Contribute to product design, prototyping, data analysis, or development activities when appropriate to accelerate delivery and establish foundational data capabilities.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience.
  • Typically eight or more years of experience in data, analytics, product management, business analysis, technology delivery, or related disciplines.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience defining business requirements, user stories, product roadmaps, and prioritization frameworks.
  • Experience working across business and technology organizations to deliver data, analytics, or technology solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and complex business requirements.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience managing data products, analytics products, business intelligence solutions, or enterprise data initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing, data engineering, data modeling, reporting, analytics, and modern cloud data architectures.
  • Experience with technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, SQL Server, Postgres, or similar data platforms.
  • Knowledge of data governance, data quality, metadata management, lineage, stewardship, and data-as-a-product principles.
  • Experience defining product KPIs, adoption metrics, service levels, and business value realization measures.
  • Experience operating within Agile product delivery environments and managing product backlogs.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience supporting modernization initiatives, including migration of data assets from on-premises to cloud environments.
  • Experience supporting Investment Services, Fund Services, Custody, Fund Accounting, Transfer Agency, or other financial services organizations preferred.

    **The role offers a hybrid/flexible schedule, which means there's an in-office expectation of 3 or more days per week and the flexibility to work outside the office location for the other days.**

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

Benefits:

Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. That's why our benefits are designed to help you and your family boost your health, protect your financial security and give you peace of mind. Our benefits include the following:

  • Healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Basic term and optional term life insurance

  • Short-term and long-term disability

  • Pregnancy disability and parental leave

  • 401(k) and employer-funded retirement plan

  • Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure)

  • Up to 11 paid holiday opportunities

  • Adoption assistance

  • Sick and Safe Leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law

Review our full benefits available by employment status here.

U.S. Bank is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, and other factors protected under applicable law.

E-Verify

U.S. Bank participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program in all facilities located in the United States and certain U.S. territories. The E-Verify program is an Internet-based employment eligibility verification system operated by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services. Learn more about the E-Verify program.

In addition to salary, U.S. Bank offers a comprehensive benefits package, including incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase 401(k) contribution and pension (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). U.S. Bank will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment. title: Digitization Technician
description:

This is a federal contracting opportunity that we, the Company, are bidding on and has not been awarded. The availability of this position is contingent upon successful award of the contract.


Position Summary

We are seeking a Digitization Technician to perform the scanning and conversion of paper-based Indian Trust records into electronic format for the Department of the Interior’s Bureau of Trust Fund Administration (BTFA). Work occurs primarily at AIRR in Lenexa, KS, with potential short-term (up to 14-day) assignments at alternative BTFA locations.


Accommodation Requests

We are committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, contact careers@bodwegroup.com.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The following inexhaustive list of duties represents a sample of work routinely performed by this role:

  • Digitize records using approved scanning equipment and BTFA policy-compliant processes.
  • Prepare, scan, and verify scanned documents according to SOPs and digitization procedures.
  • Assist with document prep and reassembly teams to support smooth workflow.
  • Ensure proper handling, routing, and tracking of documents throughout digitization.
  • Maintain adherence to federal records management requirements.


Education, Experience, and Technical Skills

Required Education, Experience, and Technical Skills

·High school diploma or equivalent.

1 year of experience operating digitization/scanning equipment and experience in document handling, digitization, or records management.

Ability to follow detailed SOP’s, BTFA procedures and federal record-keeping requirements.

Ability to obtain and maintain language a moderate public trust adjudication.

Ability to travel to alternate sites for short-term assignments as required.

Working Environment

This position operates in a professional office setting. The role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, printers, and photocopiers. The work environment is generally quiet and free from exposure to loud noise, hazardous materials, or heavy machinery. Employees are typically seated for extended periods and may occasionally move about the office to attend meetings or access equipment and supplies.

Walking: This role requires the ability to move about inside the office to access the required technological equipment.

Stooping/Kneeling/Crouching/Crawling: This role may require stooping to reload printer trays with print paper, moving equipment, and managing cords.

Using Hands/Fingers: This role constantly operates technological office equipment such as laptops, mice, keyboards, computer monitors, telephones, scanners, and copiers.

Talking/Hearing: This role requires constant communication with others in the organization to exchange information, review information, and make decisions about information.

Seeing: This role requires seeing, viewing, and distinguishing all aspects of internal and external communications.

Carrying/Lifting: This role requires lifting up to 20lbs to transport technological office equipment to and from various workspaces.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: BI utvecklare till Agio
description:
Om Agio

Agio är ett väletablerat svenskt IT konsultbolag som grundades 2003 och i dag har kontor i både Stockholm, Luleå och Kiruna. De är experter på att skapa effektivare verksamhetsprocesser inom offentlig sektor och industri – där modern digitalisering, automation och AI står i centrum. Agio är särskilt starka inom ärende- och dokumenthantering, beslutsstöd, digital transformation och skräddarsydd systemutveckling. Med långsiktiga kundrelationer, hög kompetens och fokus på hållbar utveckling levererar de IT lösningar som lyfter organisationer till nästa nivå.

Agio beskriver sig själva som en arbetsplats där kollegor trivs, utvecklas och har roligt tillsammans – en kultur som kombinerar stark teknisk kompetens med omtanke, balans i livet och engagemang i varje leverans.

Vad vi erbjuder

Som utvecklare på Agio får du en trygg anställning samtidigt som du arbetar i strategiskt viktiga och utvecklande uppdrag hos Agios kunder. Vi erbjuder:

Stark trygghet med kollektivavtal, nära stöd från dina chefer och kollegor med långsiktiga uppdrag.

Tekniskt stimulerande miljöer: du får arbeta hos kunder som ligger i framkant inom automation, verksamhetskritiska IT‑lösningar inom offentlig sektor och tung industri.

Kompetensutveckling som prioriteras: vi hjälper dig hitta rätt uppdrag och rätt väg framåt i karriären.

Balans och välmående: uppdrag hos en kund som värnar om hållbara arbetsliv och tydliga arbetsprocesser.

Vad tjänsten innebär

Vill du arbeta nära kunder, använda din kompetens för att skapa smarta och värdeskapande BI‑lösningar och samtidigt utvecklas i ett tryggt och stabilt bolag? Som BI‑utvecklare hos Agio får du arbeta i uppdrag som verkligen betyder något. Våra lösningar bidrar bland annat till framtidens energisystem, effektivare brottsbekämpning och utvecklingen av modernare vårdinformation.

I rollen kommer du att:

  • Utveckla och implementera BI‑lösningar baserat på kundens behov.
  • Designa och bygga dataflöden och pipelines från flera olika datakällor.
  • Skapa och förvalta datamodeller för säker och effektiv datahantering.
  • Skapa rapporter och visualiseringar som ger tydliga, datadrivna insikter.
  • Arbeta nära kunder och översätta deras behov till praktiska och hållbara lösningar.
  • Dela kunskap och bidra till kompetensutveckling både internt och ute hos kund.

Du blir en del av Agios team inom Dataanalys & BI – ett Microsoft‑orienterat team med konsulter i både Luleå och Stockholm. Här får du kollegor som brinner för området, stöttar varandra och tillsammans bygger lösningar från ax till limpa. Området är prioriterat och du kommer spela en viktig roll i teamets fortsatta utveckling, samtidigt som du får en personlig och skräddarsydd utvecklingsresa.

Vem vi söker

Vi söker dig som är erfaren BI‑utvecklare och vill kombinera teknisk fördjupning med nära samarbete med kunder och verksamhet.

Vi tror att du har:

They advance our mission and exemplify excellence, compassion, teamwork and purpose in all that they do. Indiana University Health is seeking individuals who embody these values to join our Operational Excellence team in the role of Project Manager – Operational Excellence.

Description

The Project Manager – Operational Excellence supports initiatives that advance quality, efficiency, and patient-centered care across the health system, partnering with clinical and operational leaders to plan, execute, and sustain improvement projects that strengthen organizational performance. The Project Manager applies structured project management and change leadership to deliver measurable, lasting results, developing project charters, timelines, communication plans, and performance metrics aligned with system priorities. By facilitating cross-functional workgroups, the Project Manager ensures timely progress, risk mitigation, and alignment with operational goals while monitoring project milestones and preparing status updates for leadership, steering committees, and stakeholders. Additionally, the Project Manager leverages an awareness of Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement tools to analyze workflows, identify root causes, and design optimized processes, while simultaneously developing change management plans that support adoption, readiness, and long-term sustainability. Finally, the Project Manager – Operational Excellence creates training materials, communication assets, and stakeholder updates that support project success, collaborating closely with analytics teams to define KPIs, dashboards, and reporting structures.

  • Requires proficiency with project management tools and data visualization platforms.
  • Requires the ability to lead at least 3 projects simultaneously.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow-MSH-13050-226
description:
Salary:Per Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai institutional salary scale and final offer letter. Approximately $74,692/year.

Department: Neurology - The Abimael Laboratory of Neurometabolism / Neurometabolomics and Neuroinformatics Core

Physical work location: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai, Annenberg Building, 1468 Madison Avenue, New York, NY 10029

Name PI or Supervisor: Isaac Marin-Valencia, MD - isaac.marin-valencia@mssm.edu - 212-241-6947

Web link to Lab:https://labs.icahn.mssm.edu/marin-valencia-lab/

Web link to Department: https://www.mountsinai.org/care/neurology

Administrative Contact: Lidija Ivic- Lidija.ivic@msms.edu

The postdoctoral researcher will participate in a collaborative research program in neurometabolism and mass spectrometry-based metabolomics. The primary purpose of the position is to conduct research that defines metabolic alterations in neurological and neurometabolic disease, develops and applies analytical mass spectrometry methods, and supports interpretation of metabolomic and stable-isotope tracing data. The research will use biological specimens and experimental models to identify and quantify metabolites, characterize metabolic pathways, discover candidate biomarkers and therapeutic targets, and improve understanding of disease mechanisms.

The postdoctoral researcher will work within the Abimael Laboratory of Neurometabolism and the Neurometabolomics and Neuroinformatics Core under the supervision of the Principal Investigator. The scholar will contribute scientific expertise in analytical chemistry and mass spectrometry to investigator-initiated and collaborative research projects, participate in experimental design, execute analytical studies, analyze and interpret data, and communicate findings to collaborating investigators. The appointment is research-focused and temporary in nature, with scientific exchange, collaborative research, and development of advanced expertise in metabolomics and mass spectrometry as central program objectives.

Technical Duties: (include any protocols)

• Design and perform sample-preparation and metabolite-extraction workflows for biological specimens, including plasma, serum, urine, tissue, and other research samples.
• Develop, optimize, validate, and apply targeted and untargeted mass spectrometry workflows using LC-MS/MS, QTOF-MS, GC-MS, and related analytical platforms as appropriate to individual research projects.
• Prepare standards, internal standards, calibration samples, pooled quality-control samples, extraction blanks, and analytical batches using appropriate quality-control procedures.
• Operate mass spectrometry and chromatography instrumentation; perform routine instrument setup, calibration, performance checks, cleaning, preventive care, troubleshooting, and documentation necessary to maintain reproducible research performance.
• Process, curate, normalize, and analyze mass spectrometry datasets; perform metabolite identification/annotation, quantitative analysis, quality-control assessment, statistical analysis, pathway analysis, and biological interpretation.
• Conduct and analyze stable-isotope tracing and metabolic flux experiments when required by research projects.
• Plan and execute assigned research projects from experimental design through sample analysis, data interpretation, visualization, and presentation of results.
• Maintain accurate experimental records, protocols, instrument logs, quality-control documentation, and research data in accordance with laboratory and institutional standards.
• Collaborate with laboratory members, investigators, clinicians, statisticians, and other scientific partners to refine experimental approaches and interpret complex metabolomic datasets.
• Provide scientific consultation and collaborative technical guidance to Core users on sample collection and preparation, analytical study design, mass spectrometry workflows, data quality, and interpretation. Core-related activities will be directly connected to collaborative research objectives and the scholar’s mass spectrometry research expertise.
• Contribute to preparation of figures, scientific presentations, manuscripts, abstracts, reports, and grant-related research materials, and participate in laboratory meetings and scientific discussions.
• Follow laboratory safety, chemical hygiene, biosafety, data-management, and instrument-use procedures.

Educational and other Requirements for the position:

• Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree in analytical chemistry, pharmaceutical analysis, chemistry, biochemistry, metabolomics, mass spectrometry, or a closely related scientific discipline.
• Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry, chromatography, mass spectrometry, quantitative bioanalysis, and metabolomics principles.
• Ability to design and execute research experiments, critically evaluate analytical quality, interpret complex datasets, and communicate scientific findings.
• Proficiency with mass spectrometry data-processing and statistical/visualization software.
• Strong organizational, documentation, communication, and collaborative skills.
• Ability to work independently on defined research objectives while collaborating effectively in a multidisciplinary academic research environment.

Experience Required:

Demonstrated research experience in mass spectrometry-based analytical science, including biological sample preparation, metabolite or small-molecule extraction, LC-MS/MS and/or high-resolution mass spectrometry, analytical method development/optimization, quality control, data processing, statistical analysis, and scientific interpretation. Experience with metabolomics, quantitative bioanalysis, QTOF/Orbitrap/triple-quadrupole platforms, GC-MS, stable-isotope tracing, biomarker discovery, and collaborative translational research is highly desirable. Experience troubleshooting and maintaining mass spectrometry and chromatography systems is also desirable. The candidate’s background includes more than seven years of targeted and untargeted LC-MS research, sample preparation, quality control, data processing and interpretation, and experience with Orbitrap, triple-quadrupole, QTOF, UHPLC/HPLC, and GC-MS platforms.

Goals/Outcomes of the Research Project:

The principal outcome will be generation of rigorous, reproducible mass spectrometry-based research data that advances understanding of metabolic mechanisms in neurological and neurometabolic disease. Expected outcomes include: (1) development, optimization, and application of robust metabolomics and quantitative mass spectrometry methods; (2) identification and quantitative characterization of disease-associated metabolites and metabolic pathways; (3) generation and interpretation of high-quality datasets from investigator-initiated and collaborative studies; (4) contribution to biomarker and therapeutic-target discovery; (5) dissemination of research through presentations, abstracts, manuscripts, and other scholarly products; and (6) scientific exchange and growth in advanced analytical chemistry, metabolomics, experimental design, data interpretation, and collaborative research. The Postdoctoral Researcher is expected to progressively assume scientific responsibility for defined research projects while working under the mentorship and supervision of the Principal Investigator.

title: Attendance Secretary - California Trail Middle School, 8 hours
description:
TITLE: Attendance Secretary (Secretarial Assistant)

HOURS OF WORK: 8 Hrs. Daily/175 days

LOCATION: California Trail Middle School

STATUS: Classified – Non-Exempt, Full Time

POSITION SUMMARY:

The job of Secretarial Assistant was established for the purpose/s of providing clerical support to assigned school site personnel; communicating information to staff and the public; providing complete and accurate records; collecting funds for daily meal transactions as needed and/or assigned; balancing accounts and depositing funds utilizing established accounting practices; and providing information and/or direction as may be requested. Additionally, secretarial assistants may be assigned to student supervision duties including but not limited to lunchroom supervision and added support for certified staff members during recess duty.

This position reports to the building administrator.

PRIMARY DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

Administers first aid and prescription medications to students (under the direction of a health care professional) as needed and/or assigned for the purpose of meeting immediate health care needs within established guidelines.

Answers telephone calls for the purpose of screening calls, transferring calls, responding to inquiries and/or taking messages.

Assists students, teachers, secretarial staff, administration, PTO, in the completion of their duties (e.g. laminating, proof reading, copying, greeting, arranging for lunches, scanning, taking photos, assisting with fire drills, summer school, etc.) for the purpose of ensuring a safe and efficient work environment.

Assists with processing of documents, forms, mailings and materials (e.g. attendance, enrollments, SIT meetings, printing requests, etc.) for the purpose of disseminating information to appropriate parties.

Attends department and/or in-service meetings for the purpose of gathering information required to perform functions.

Collects payments for a variety of events and programs (e.g. fines, fees, food items, lunch tickets, and fundraisers, etc.) for the purpose of completing transactions and/or securing funds.

·Distributes materials (e.g. mail, checks, supplies, messages, printing, flyers, etc.) for the purpose of ensuring delivery to addressee.

Maintains manual and electronic documents files and records (e.g. letters, forms, reports, on line calendar, daycare providers, attendance, newsletters, etc.) for the purpose of providing up-to-date information and/or historical reference in accordance with established administrative guidelines and legal requirements.

Maintains inventory of supplies and materials (e.g. forms, office supplies, textbooks, etc.) for the purpose of ensuring items' availability.

Monitors attendance and contacts parents who have not notified the District that their child will be absent as assigned for the purpose of documenting reasons for student absences and ensuring that absent students are safe.

Monitors student food choices as assigned for the purpose of ensuring compliance with established financial and student nutritional guidelines.

Prepares sales transaction documents (e.g. daily cash receipts, record breakfast and/or lunch counts, etc.) for the purpose of providing written support and/or conveying information.

Prepares standardized documents (e.g. form letters and memos, calendars, bulletins, notes home on lunch balances, etc.) for the purpose of communicating information to other parties.

Processes daily transaction data for the purpose of documenting activities, maintaining accurate account balances and/or conveying information.

Reconciles cash and credit receipts to meal count as assigned for the purpose of maintaining accurate account balancing and complying with established policies and/or procedures.

Responds to inquiries of students, staff and parents (e.g. general school questions, type and/or cost of meals and food items, account balances, etc.) for the purpose of providing information and/or direction.

May be assigned to lunchroom supervision, added support for certified staff members during recess duty and other student supervision duties as needed.

Perform other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

High school diploma or equivalent required.

Two years of office experience preferred.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

Excellent verbal, written and listening communication skills.

Ability to organize and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.

High degree of motivation, responsibility, and confidentiality.

Demonstrated ability in compiling, organizing, and analyzing data.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced work environment.

Highly collaborative team player.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, etc.).

Ability to self-initiate areas of opportunity, make recommendations for improvement, and follow up as necessary to achieve desired results.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

This position requires the performance of light work. The position must be able to discern and prepare data to communicate information with parents, staff, and students. The position requires occasionally moving between buildings and at times remaining in a stationary position. The position is performed in a generally hazard free environment and a clean atmosphere.

title: DIRECTOR OF CRISIS INTERVENTION SERVICES
description:
This is a merit hire position. The Dauphin County Mental Health/Autism/Developmental Programs is currently accepting applications for a full-time position of Director of Crisis Intervention Services. The hourly rate for this position is $27.92. The Director of Crisis Intervention is responsible for the administrative and supervisory work associated with assisting the Dauphin County Mental Health/ Autism/ Developmental Programs Administrator 3 in directing the crisis intervention components of the County mental health/developmental programs agency. Work includes the supervision of all crisis intervention services in the County. In this capacity, the Director of Crisis Intervention analyzes and assists in planning, developing, and implementing a comprehensive crisis intervention program, providing telephone, walk-in, and mobile crisis services; and monitors direct services to ensure program quality and conformance with established Federal, State, and Local mental health regulations and policies. Supervision is exercised directly over two program supervisors and indirectly over 22 full and part-time crisis intervention staff members. Director of Crisis Intervention also maintains coordination and oversight of external licensed crisis intervention providers in the county, credentialed under the HC MCO to assure continuity of services and completion of all emergency service obligations. In the absence of the County Mental Health/Autism/Developmental Programs Administrator 3, the employee is responsible for the continued operations of the crisis intervention program.

  • Three years of experience in public or private social work, which included one year in a public welfare program and one year in a supervisory capacity; and a master’s degree, which includes or is supplemented by 12 college credits in sociology, social welfare, psychology, gerontology, criminal justice, or other related social sciences.

  • Or five years of experience in public or private social work, which included one year in a public welfare program and one year in a supervisory capacity; and a bachelor’s degree/ or an RN in the state of Pennsylvania, which includes or is supplemented by 12 college credits in sociology, social welfare, psychology, gerontology, criminal justice, or other related social sciences.

  • Or a PA-credentialed LCSW, LPC, LMFT, or Psychologist.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

At the time of hire, a valid driver’s license and positive driving record, a favorable criminal background check, child abuse and FBI clearances, as well as favorable references are required. The applicant must provide proof of a valid Pennsylvania driver’s license within 60 days from the date of hire. Code § 83 and driving is not an essential function of the position.

title: Assistant Director - Cardiology
description:
The Assistant Director supports the Director in overseeing the department's administrative, operational, financial, and clinical research activities. The position assists with staff supervision, study operations, budgeting, regulatory compliance, vendor coordination, and process improvement to support the successful execution of clinical trials and research initiatives. Working collaboratively with faculty, research teams, sponsors, CROs, vendors, and departments, the Assistant Director also supports operational planning and strategic initiatives while developing broader leadership responsibilities.

  • Support the Director in the day-to-day operational, administrative, financial, and clinical research activities of the department to ensure efficient operations and achievement of departmental goals.
  • Coordinate departmental workflows, staff assignments, operational priorities, and resources to support clinical trials, research initiatives, and administrative operations.
  • Assist with the recruitment, onboarding, supervision, mentoring, training, and performance management of administrative and research staff while promoting a collaborative work environment.
  • Coordinate clinical research studies and operational activities, ensuring compliance with study protocols, sponsor requirements, institutional policies, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Support regulatory compliance by coordinating regulatory documentation, submissions, quality assurance activities, audit readiness, and corrective action plans, as needed.
  • Monitor study timelines, enrollment, operational metrics, and project milestones, communicating progress, identifying issues, and assisting with timely resolution.
  • Assist with departmental and study budgets by tracking expenses, reconciling financial activity, preparing reports, and coordinating with Finance and other institutional departments.
  • Coordinate communications and activities with investigators, sponsors, CROs, vendors, consultants, and internal departments to support departmental and research operations.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, dashboards, and operational metrics to support leadership decision-making and continuous process improvement.
  • Participate in departmental meetings, committees, and special projects, and perform other related duties as assigned.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Health Care Administration, Public Administration, Business Administration, Life Sciences, Clinical Research, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
  • Clinical research or project-management certification is preferred.
  • 5 years minimum experience, preferably in a hospital, academic medical center, health care, clinical research, or related environment.
  • Experience in clinical research operations, departmental administration, budgeting, regulatory activities, or project management preferred.
  • Supervisory, team-lead, or staff-coordination experience preferred.
  • Experience working with a contract research organization, pharmaceutical company, biotechnology company, academic research organization, or clinical research sponsor preferred.
  • Experience with clinical trial management systems, electronic data-capture and regulatory platforms, financial and contract-management systems, research

General Skills and Competencies

  • Knowledge of applicable clinical research, regulatory, and accreditation requirements, including FDA, GCP, ICH, Institutional Review Board, The Joint Commission, New York State Department of Health, and institutional standards.
  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project-management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, deadlines, and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated professionalism, accountability, adaptability, attention to detail, and commitment to quality.

description:

This role is responsible for ensuring alignment between enterprise strategy, investment, and execution while driving disciplined delivery, transparency, and measurable business outcomes across the portfolio for DTCC, our clients, and the global financial markets. Portfolio & Program Leadership

Executive & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with enterprise portfolio leaders to balance delivery rigor, financials, capacity constraints, and evolving business priorities across the enterprise.
  • Develop and deliver executive level communications, including portfolio health views, risk narratives, dependency analyses, investment tradeoffs, and outcome reporting.

Delivery Governance & Risk Management

  • Proactively manage portfolio-level risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and financials, identifying systemic trends and driving timely resolution and alignment at the appropriate leadership level.
  • Partner with governance, risk, and control stakeholders to ensure compliance, transparency, and effective escalation.

People & Capability Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop program leaders, building and sustaining a high performing transformation delivery team by strengthening program management capability, standards, and ways of working.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and talent development across Transformation Delivery.
  • Mitigates risk by following established procedures, spotting key errors and demonstrating strong ethical behavior.

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively at the executive level, with strong judgment, influence, and communication skills.
  • Advanced capability in developing executive‑level materials and narratives, including dashboards, decision papers, and strategic narratives.
  • Strong financial and analytical acumen, including experience overseeing budgets, investment tradeoffs, and outcome realization.
  • Experience with portfolio and program management tooling (e.g., Planview, Jira) and enterprise governance models.
  • Advanced program or portfolio management certification (e.g., PgMP, PMP) strongly preferred.
  • SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE) certification or experience is a plus, including hands-on experience facilitating Agile execution, dependency management, and program-level delivery governance.
  • Experience with digital assets and/or blockchain technology and products a plus

Talents Needed for Success:

  • Strong enterprise mindset with the ability to align strategy, execution, and outcomes across diverse initiatives and stakeholders.
  • Executive presence and credibility, with the ability to influence, challenge constructively, and drive alignment at senior levels.

  • Systems thinking orientation, identifying patterns and trends across programs to proactively address systematic treats and delivery constraints.

  • Commitment to continuous improvement of delivery practices, governance, and organizational capability.

title: Space Systems Engineer
description:
Title:

Space Systems Engineer

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!

KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.

Why Join Us?

  • Innovative Projects: KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions.
  • Collaborative Environment: Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace.
  • Impactful Work: Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of space defense.

Position Summary:

KBR National Security Solutions is seeking a motivated and talented Space Systems Engineer with a strong background in Verification and Validation (V&V) to join our team in Chantilly, Virginia. The position will support a major U.S. Government organization responsible for the acquisition, integration, and operation of proliferated satellite constellations. The position provides expert advice and manages systems engineering processes and implementation for System Program Office (SPO)-developed collection system, including space vehicle, payloads, and associated ground command and control elements. This role is critical for ensuring that proliferated satellite constellations meet mission requirements through disciplined systems engineering practices. You will work across space, ground, and user segments to define verification strategies, trace requirements, and assess contractor compliance throughout the lifecycle.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and develop requirements from higher level Enterprise governing documents to the Segment level and lower levels.

  • Develop and manage system-level verification and validation (V&V) strategies.

  • Define verification methods, success criteria, and traceability from requirements to test.

  • Evaluate contractor V&V plans, procedures, and results.

  • Support test planning across components, subsystems, systems, and mission levels.

  • Identify gaps, risks, and disconnects in verification approaches and recommend corrective actions.

title: Senior AI/ML Flex Solution Engineer
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Summary

The AI/ML Flex Solution Engineer (SE) is a high-impact, customer-facing technical role supporting AI/Machine Learning (AI/ML) initiatives across our strategic US Major Accounts. This role is designed for a technical professional who possesses a strong foundation in AI/ML concepts, technologies, and solution architecture, positioning them above a generalist but not necessarily requiring deep specialization (Level 200-300 technical depth). The Flex SE will act as a critical, hands-on technical resource, accelerating customer adoption and success. This role translates business challenges into AI/ML- driven solutions through the rapid development of MVPs and prototypes, supporting our regional SE teams, and driving growth in this strategic area. The AE and SE maintain ownership and ultimate approval over the account strategy. The Flex SE role is designed to be supportive, not to supersede their authority. The RVP should provide prescriptive guidance on which accounts the Flex SE should prioritize, as the RVP possesses the most comprehensive regional overview.

Key Responsibilities and Scope

Technical Leadership & Solutioning

  • Partner with regional Account Executives (AEs) and Solution Engineers (SEs) to identify, qualify, and develop AI/ML opportunities within USMajors accounts. The direction of which account teams to partner with should come from the RVP.

  • Conduct technical presentations, product demonstrations, and workshops focused on our AI/ML portfolio (e.g., platforms, services, and MLOps tools).

  • Architect and prototype foundational AI/ML solutions, including proof-of-concepts (PoCs) that demonstrate clear business value.

  • Serve as the technical bridge between customers and the central AI/ML Product and Engineering teams, synthesizing customer feedback and emerging requirements.

  • Maintain a current understanding of the competitive landscape and industry trends in AI/ML, advising internal teams and customers accordingly.

  • Drive sales acceleration through AI-assisted "hands-on-keyboard" development, creating Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) and functional prototypes that quickly demonstrate platform capability and time-to-value.

  • Lead the rapid technical build of customized AI/ML prototypes to secure technical wins and directly influence incremental consumption for the region.

Cross-Regional Enablement

  • Provide direct technical support and capacity augmentation for regional SE teams engaged in complex or specialized AI/ML sales cycles.

  • Develop and deliver AI/ML training materials and technical guidance to upskill the broader USMajors SE organization.

  • Document successful solution patterns and best practices, contributing to a centralized knowledge base for regional SE reuse.

  • Travel up to 30-40% of the time to support critical customer engagements across the assigned regions.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with AI/ML concepts, such as data preparation, model training (supervised/unsupervised), deployment, and monitoring. Ability to translate this experience directly into how Snowflake can help advance the customer’s AI/ML initiatives.

  • Technical Depth: Possesses Level 200-300 knowledge of AI/ML: capable of designing robust solutions, discussing common algorithms and frameworks, and implementing standard MLOps pipelines.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Metrics That Matter

The performance of the Flex SE will be measured primarily based on their direct contribution to accelerating and growing our AI/ML business within the USMajors sector. Our current annual run rate as a business is about $1.8 billion, with AI/ML contributing 2% of that.

  • Blended Attainment: 60% tied to incremental consumption for the region and 40% tied to TACV bookings for the region

  • % Increase YoY in AI/ML Revenue: 100% year-over-year growth in AI/ML revenue across USMajors. Some Flex SEs may be subject to doing more than 100% and others less than 100% depending on need/feasibility.

  • AI/ML Use Case Tech Wins ($ and Volume): Measured by use cases the Flex SE is tagged to

  • AI/ML Use Case Go-Lives ($ and Volume): Measured by use cases the Flex SE is tagged to

  • Regional Technical Proficiency in AI/ML: Measured by AI/ML technical proficiency for SE Generalists at the start of the year compared to end of year

title: Job Title: Sr. Construction/Installation Engineer - (Structure - Topsides & Bridges)
description:
Title:

Job Title: Sr. Construction/Installation Engineer - (Structure - Topsides & Bridges)

Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR!

The KBR team of teams delivers future-forward science, technology and engineering solutions and mission-critical services that help governments and companies around the world accomplish their most important objectives, while also helping achieve their sustainability goals. KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions provides holistic and value-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle. These include world-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design and engineering capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets.

Job Title: Sr. Construction/Installation Engineer - (Structure - Topsides & Bridges)

KBR is growing its Project Management Consultancy (PMC) team for an exciting, high‑profile offshore development in Abu Dhabi. The ADNOC PMC project role would be based initially in Contractors Office/ Fabrication Yard Office in Abu Dhabi for some time and then will later move to Offshore Site on 6 weeks on/ 3 weeks off rotation.

Job Purpose

The Senior Construction/Installation Engineer - Structures (Topsides & Bridges) is responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing the construction, load-out, transportation, offshore installation, hook-up, and commissioning support activities for Offshore Topsides, Interconnecting Bridges, and associated structural facilities.

The role ensures that all offshore construction and installation activities are executed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with project specifications, approved procedures, client requirements, and industry standards. The incumbent will provide technical leadership, interface management, and construction engineering support throughout all phases of project execution.

Key Responsibilities

Construction & Installation Engineering

  • Lead construction and offshore installation engineering activities related to topsides, bridges, modules, and associated offshore structures.
  • Review and approve installation methodologies, lifting plans, rigging studies, transportation analyses, and offshore execution procedures.
  • Ensure constructability considerations are incorporated during engineering and fabrication phases.
  • Develop installation work packs, method statements, and execution plans.
  • Coordinate with engineering, fabrication, marine, and commissioning teams to support project objectives.
  • Monitor offshore installation progress and provide technical guidance to site teams.

Offshore Structures Installation

Manage and support installation activities for:

  • Offshore Topsides
  • Production Decks
  • Utility Decks
  • Wellhead Decks
  • Interconnecting Bridges
  • Bridge Support Structures
  • Flare Bridges and Flare Structures
  • Deck Extensions
  • Living Quarters Modules
  • Equipment Modules and Skids
  • Brownfield Modification Structures
  • Secondary Steel and Structural Appurtenances

Load-Out & Marine Transportation

  • Coordinate topside and bridge load-out activities from fabrication yards.
  • Review sea-fastening designs and transportation studies.
  • Support transportation readiness reviews and marine assurance activities.
  • Coordinate with barge contractors, vessel operators, and marine warranty surveyors.
  • Ensure transportation activities are executed safely and according to approved procedures.

Offshore Installation & Hook-Up

  • Support offshore heavy lift operations involving topsides and bridge structures.
  • Coordinate crane vessel activities and installation sequences.
  • Monitor lifting, positioning, alignment, and structural connections.
  • Support bridge integration, mechanical completion, and structural tie-ins.
  • Coordinate hook-up and interface works with commissioning teams.
  • Resolve offshore construction challenges and engineering queries.

Engineering Review & Technical Support

  • Review construction drawings, fabrication deliverables, lift studies, and installation analyses.
  • Participate in constructability reviews, HAZID, HAZOP, and SIMOPS workshops.
  • Review and manage technical queries (TQs), field engineering changes, and installation deviations.
  • Provide technical recommendations to project management and offshore execution teams.
  • Ensure engineering deliverables support safe and efficient offshore installation.

HSE Responsibilities

  • Ensure strict compliance with project HSE requirements and offshore safety regulations.
  • Participate in risk assessments, toolbox talks, and pre-job safety meetings.
  • Ensure all offshore activities are conducted under approved Permit-to-Work systems.
  • Support incident investigations and implementation of corrective actions.
  • Promote a strong safety culture across all construction and installation activities.

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Interface with Engineering, Fabrication, Marine Operations, Hook-Up, Commissioning, Quality, and Project Controls teams.
  • Coordinate with installation contractors, heavy lift vessel operators, and subcontractors.
  • Participate in client meetings, readiness reviews, and project progress meetings.
  • Ensure effective communication between offshore and onshore project teams.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Verify compliance with approved procedures, quality plans, and project specifications.
  • Support inspection and testing activities during offshore installation.
  • Review and approve as-built records and installation documentation.
  • Assist in punch list management and project handover activities.
  • Participate in internal and external audits as required.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Civil Engineering, Marine Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Master's Degree is an advantage.

Professional Certifications (Preferred)

  • PMP Certification
  • BOSIET/HUET
  • Offshore Safety Certifications
  • Lifting and Rigging Certification
  • NEBOSH or equivalent HSE qualification

Experience

  • Minimum 15-18 years of experience in offshore construction and installation within EPC/EPCI oil & gas projects.
  • Minimum 5 years in a senior construction, offshore installation, or execution engineering role.
  • Proven experience in the installation of:
    • Offshore Topsides
    • Production Platforms
    • Interconnecting Bridges
    • Utility Modules
    • Living Quarters
    • Flare Structures
    • Brownfield Offshore Modifications
  • Experience with heavy lift vessels, marine transportation, and offshore hook-up activities.
  • Previous experience in Middle East offshore projects (ADNOC, Saudi Aramco, QatarEnergy, etc.) is preferred.

title: Biltestare / Bilrunner
description:
Vi söker nu en Biltestare / Bilrunner till vårt team. Det här är en hybridroll för dig som gillar bilar, trivs med praktiskt arbete och uppskattar en vardag där arbetsuppgifterna kan variera.

Rollen består av två huvudsakliga delar: att testa och kontrollera bilar som kommer in till oss samt att arbeta som Bilrunner och hjälpa till att hålla vårt dagliga bilflöde rullande.

Fördelningen mellan de två delarna är inte fast utan styrs helt av verksamhetens behov. Under vissa perioder kan du arbeta nästan uteslutande med biltestning, medan du under andra perioder främst arbetar som Bilrunner. Det kan exempelvis innebära att du under en period arbetar upp till 100 % som Biltestare och under en annan period upp till 100 % som Bilrunner. Det finns alltså ingen fast procentuell fördelning mellan Biltestare och Bilrunner. Fördelningen varierar löpande utifrån verksamhetens behov.

Du behöver därför trivas med båda delarna av tjänsten och vara flexibel kring var du behövs mest för stunden.

Som Biltestare

Som Biltestare är du en viktig del av vårt inflöde av bilar. Du testar, provkör och kontrollerar bilar som kommer in till oss för att säkerställa att vi får en tydlig bild av bilens skick och vilka eventuella åtgärder som behöver genomföras.

Du arbetar metodiskt och noggrant och behöver kunna upptäcka både tydliga och mindre uppenbara fel och brister.

Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar bland annat:

  • Testa och provköra inkommande bilar
  • Identifiera fel, skador och andra brister
  • Dokumentera resultatet från genomförda tester
  • Kontrollera bilens funktioner och allmänna skick
  • Fotografera och dokumentera relevanta avvikelser
  • Rapportera vilka fel och åtgärdsbehov som upptäckts
  • Kontrollera exempelvis motor, växellåda, bromsar, elektronik och övriga funktioner

Som Bilrunner

Som Bilrunner är din uppgift att hjälpa till att hålla vårt bilflöde rullande. Det är en praktisk och rörlig roll där du ser till att bilar kommer till rätt plats vid rätt tidpunkt och hjälper logistikteamet med de uppgifter som behöver lösas under dagen.

En arbetsdag kan exempelvis innebära att du hämtar en bil hos en kund, kör en annan till verkstad eller besiktning och därefter hjälper till att flytta och organisera bilar på våra uppställningsytor.

Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar bland annat:

  • Hämta och lämna bilar hos kunder
  • Flytta och parkera bilar på anläggningen
  • Hjälpa till att hålla ordning på bilar och nycklar
  • Flytta bilar mellan olika platser och uppställningsytor
  • Utföra enklare checklistor, fotografering och kvittenser
  • Hjälpa logistikteamet med praktiska ärenden när behov uppstår
  • Köra bilar till och från verkstäder, besiktning och samarbetspartners

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som har ett stort bilintresse och som trivs med att arbeta praktiskt. Du behöver vara noggrann när situationen kräver det, men samtidigt kunna arbeta effektivt när tempot är högt.

Eftersom tjänsten är en hybridroll är flexibilitet särskilt viktigt. Du behöver vara bekväm med att arbetsdagen kan förändras och att verksamhetens behov avgör om du för stunden arbetar främst som Biltestare eller Bilrunner.

Det är därför viktigt att du är intresserad av båda delarna av tjänsten. Rollen är inte en renodlad Biltestartjänst och fördelningen mellan arbetsområdena kan förändras över tid.

Vi söker dig som:

  • Trivs med praktiskt arbete
  • Har ett stort intresse för bilar
  • Är ansvarstagande och självgående
  • Har B körkort för manuell växellåda
  • Klarar av att arbeta i ett högt tempo
  • Är noggrann och har ett öga för detaljer
  • Har god förståelse för hur bilar fungerar
  • Har lätt för att samarbeta och hjälpa till där det behövs
  • Är flexibel och kan växla mellan olika typer av arbetsuppgifter

Tidigare erfarenhet från bilhandel, verkstad, biltestning, fordonslogistik, rekond eller liknande arbete är meriterande, men rätt inställning och ett genuint bilintresse väger tungt.

Vad vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du arbeta i en snabbväxande verksamhet där det händer mycket och där du får en viktig roll i det dagliga bilflödet.

Du får en varierad arbetsdag med mycket eget ansvar och möjlighet att utveckla dina kunskaper inom både bilar och fordonslogistik.

För rätt person finns goda möjligheter att utvecklas och ta mer ansvar över tid.

Praktisk information

  • Anställningsform: Timanställning
  • Omfattning: Minst 100 timmar per månad, med möjlighet till fler timmar
  • Placering: Upplands Väsby
  • Arbetstider: Främst vardagar, med möjlighet till arbete på kvällar och helger vid behov
  • Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Ansökan och information:

title: 0000001385.DEPUTY CONSTABLE I.CONSTABLE PRECINCT  3
description: Performs licensed peace officer tasks in accordance with State and local laws and the policies and procedures of the Constable’s Office and performs bailiff tasks for the Justice of the Peace.Delivers and executes civil papers to include citations, small claims notices, injunctions, subpoenas, summons and restraining orders.
