(These minimum qualifications are required prior to the candidate taking the written entry-level law enforcement examination.). Minimum educational requirements: (A) have passed a general educational development (GED) test indicating high school graduation level; or (B) hold a high school diploma. Examples of various combinations of TCOLE certification, education and/or work experience (not inclusive): 1. Without TCOLE: • Two years of law enforcement experience (to include a certified jailer); OR • Thirty hours of college from an accredited college or university with a grade "C" or better in each class. (This candidate would enter an academy upon hire with an estimated completion time of 6 months, then complete 6 months of field training. At the end of twelve (12) months, the employee would become a Deputy Constable I, gr. 66, Step 1). 2. With TCOLE (which equates to six months of work experience), the candidate must possess an additional: • Eighteen (18) months of law enforcement experience; OR • Six (6) months of law enforcement and fifteen hours of college from an accredited college or university with a grade "C" or better in each class. (At the end of twelve (12) months working in the Constable's office, the employee would move to Deputy Constable I , gr. 66, Step 1) 3. With TCOLE Only • If a candidate has only a TCOLE license the candidate can sit for the exam. If the candidate passes the exam and a Constable is interested in hiring the candidate, the person can be hired, but would remain a deputy constable recruit for 2 ½ years, until he/she meets the minimum qualifications of 3 years work experience, then move to Deputy Constable I , gr. 66, Step 1). Special Requirements/Knowledge, Skills & Abilities: Ability to effectively communicate, both verbally and in writing, and establish and maintain effective working relationships with employees, departments and the general public. Must be at least 21 years of age and possess a valid Texas Driver’s License, with good driving record. This position requires successful completion of a written examination, physical agility assessment, psychological exam (L3 updated within 180 days or less by Dallas County approved vendor), polygraph examination by a Dallas County approved vendor, and a physical examination (L2 updated within 180 days or less) and performed by the Dallas County Employee Health Center or Dallas County approved vendor and which meet the qualification screening guidelines consistent with those of the Dallas County Sheriff’s Office; and, an extensive background investigation conducted by Dallas County approved vendors. If the full screening guidelines are not met, this position will be filled at a reduced salary (gr. 65). Mandatory drug testing prior to employment, and will be subject to random, unannounced drug and/or alcohol tests during employment. Must be a U.S. citizen. Must have never been convicted of an offense above the grade of a Class B misdemeanor or a Class B misdemeanor within the last ten years; never convicted of any family violence offense; not prohibited by state or federal law from operating a motor vehicle; not prohibited by state or federal law from possessing firearms or ammunition. Physical/Environmental Requirements: Must be able to perform defense tactics against individuals. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to sit, stand, walk, and drive. title: Senior Software Engineer (SDE3) — Data & Intelligence Platform
description:
Tesco UK • Welwyn Garden City • Hybrid • Full-Time • Permanent • Working hours 36 • Apply by 15-Oct-2026

You'll be a core engineer on the data and intelligence layer that connects Tesco's supply chain forecasting outputs to the people and systems that act on them. The platform sits at the intersection of data engineering, applied ML, and developer infrastructure - you'll work across all three, owning problems end to end.

This isn't a role where you'll spend your days in a narrow lane. The work is genuinely varied: one week you're designing a data API, the next you're improving retrieval quality in a RAG pipeline, the next you're working with infrastructure to get a service into production. We're looking for someone who finds that energising rather than uncomfortable.

What is in it for you
We're all about the little helps. That's why we make sure our Tesco colleague benefits package takes care of you - both in and out of work.

  • Annual bonus scheme of up to 20% of base salary.
  • Holiday starting at 25 days plus a personal day (plus Bank holidays).
  • Private medical insurance.
  • 26 weeks maternity and adoption leave (12 months service required at the qualifying date) at full pay, followed by 13 weeks of Statutory Maternity Pay or Statutory Adoption Pay, we also offer 6 weeks fully paid paternity leave.
  • Free 24/7 virtual GP service, Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and your family, free access to a range of experts to support your mental wellbeing.

The above information is a shortened summary, refer to our policies for full details

You will be responsible for

Data platform - a high-performance service that brings together multiple data sources - analytical, caching, vector, and object stores - behind a clean typed API. Supply chain data is high-volume and time-sensitive; getting the data layer right underpins everything else the platform does.

Intelligence layer - we work closely with forecasting teams across the business who produce demand signals, predictions, and recommendations. Our job is to make that intelligence accessible, actionable, and explainable - surfacing it through well-designed APIs, keeping it fresh, and ensuring the right data reaches the right place at the right time.

LLM integration - a conversational and tool-calling layer that gives supply chain teams natural language access to platform data and forecasts. You'll work on retrieval quality, tool design, prompt architecture, and streaming response pipelines. This is a relatively new area for us and there's genuine room to shape how it evolves.

You will need

Someone who:

  • Takes ownership. When something is broken or missing, you fix it, you don't wait to be asked
  • Is comfortable with ambiguity. Not every problem will have a clear spec, you can navigate that without needing handholding
  • Writes code other engineers want to work with readable, tested, with the complexity in the right places
  • Has worked across backend services and data systems in production, and has the scars to show for it
  • Can pick up new technology without being precious about what they already know

Technically, you're strong in TypeScript and Python (or willingness to learn quickly), you've built or operated data-intensive backend services, and you have some experience with LLM APIs or retrieval systems - enough to be productive quickly, even if you haven't done it at scale before.
Kubernetes and cloud-native deployment experience is useful. So is supply chain or forecasting domain knowledge. Neither is required.

The work is meaningful
The platform influences ordering decisions across thousands of stores. When it works well, products are on shelf. When it doesn't, they aren't. That directness of impact is something most engineering roles don't offer.

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to shared frontend/backend or developer platform infrastructure
  • Infrastructure as code - Helm, Kubernetes manifests, CI/CD pipeline design
  • Supply chain, replenishment, or demand forecasting domain familiarity

About us

You might know us as a supermarket, technology company or even for our award-winning mobile network. Truth is, we're all of those things, and much more. Our colleagues work with one goal in mind, helping to make every day a little better for our customers, colleagues and communities all over the world. No two customers are the same, neither are our colleagues.

At Tesco, we champion a balance that lets you thrive both in and out of work. Spend 60% of your week collaborating with colleagues at our office locations or local sites and the rest remotely. Whether you're just kicking off your career, juggling passions, or navigating big life events, we're here to support you. We always welcome a conversation about flexible working, so talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.

We're proud to be an accredited Disability Confident Leader, where everyone's welcome. That's why we commit to providing a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you need support with your application, for more information. And if you're interested in joining our team but don't tick every box, don't let that hold you back from applying.

title: Physician - Program Director, Internal Medicine Residency
description:
The Program Director is responsible for the leadership, organization, operation, and general administration of the Internal Medicine Residency Program. The Program Director is also responsible for the standards, quality, and reputation of the program. They will be expected to integrate the program with existing hospital services in a manner that enhances value and quality for patients and residents’ educational experiences, as well as promote an optimum environment for professional development. The program director must administer and maintain an educational environment conducive to educating the residents in each of the ACGME competency areas. The Program Director will collaborate with the Graduate Medical Education Committee (GMEC) and DIO to prepare and present routine status reports on the program and its residents, as well as meet all required ACGME standards to obtain and continue program certification.

Job Standards and Performance Expectations

  1. Strategic Leadership and Operations
    1. Prepares written goals and objectives of the program with respect to the knowledge, skills and other attributes of residents for each level of training and for each major rotation or assignment.
    2. Plans, coordinates, and implements curriculum and evaluates methodology for the six general ACGME competencies.
    3. Approves the selection of program faculty as appropriate.
    4. Is familiar with and complies with ACGME and Review Committee policies and procedures as outlined in the ACGME Manual of Policies and Procedures.
    5. Develops training schedules and assignments to meet the educational goals of the program.
    6. Provides discipline when appropriate and is available for advice or counseling.
    7. Prepares and submits information required and requested by the ACGME, including but not limited to the program information forms and annual program resident updates to the ADS, and ensure that the information submitted is accurate and complete.
    8. Conducts an annual recruitment, interview, and selection process.
  2. Quality and Performance Improvement
    1. Oversees and ensures the quality of didactic and clinical education in all sites that participate in the program.
    2. Provides each resident with documented semiannual evaluation of performance with feedback.
    3. Monitors the need for and ensures the provision of back up support systems when patient care responsibilities are unusually difficult or prolonged.
    4. Monitors resident stress, fatigue, sleep deprivation, including mental or emotional conditions inhibiting the performance of learning, and drug or alcohol related dysfunction.
    5. Develops and implements dependable measures to assess residents skills in the general competencies of patient care, medical knowledge, practice-based learning and improvement, interpersonal and communications skills, professionalism, and systems-based practices. Develops and implements dependable measures to assess residents competence in other areas as defined in the ACGME program requirements for the particular specialty.
    6. Evaluates program faculty and approves the continued participation of program faculty based on evaluation.
  3. Collaboration and Partnership
    1. Facilitates resident participation in educational and scholarly activities required by the program and sponsoring institution.
    2. Maintains clinical responsibilities in continuity clinic as deemed appropriate.
    3. Serves as liaison with appropriate personnel at other institutions participating in training.
    4. Implements policies and procedures consistent with the institutional and program requirements for resident duty hours and the working environment, including moonlighting.
    5. Complies with the sponsoring institutions written policies and procedures, including those specified in the Institutional Requirements, for selection, evaluation and promotion of residents, disciplinary action, and supervision of residents.
    6. Ensures compliance with grievance and due process procedures as set forth in the Institutional Requirements and implemented by the sponsoring institution.
  4. Other Duties As Assigned
    1. Performs other duties as assigned or requested.

Experience - 3 years of Graduate Medical Education or administrative experience. Applicants with less than 3 years of experience may be considered for Associate Program Director role
Education - M.D.
Special Skills - Coordinate meetings Delegates appropriately to all levels of staff Develop office procedures Knowledge of healthcare standards and regulations Leadership and management capabilities Excellent computer skills Good interpersonal/human relations skills Good oral and written communication skills good time management/prioritization skills
Licensure - Certified in Internal Medicine by ABIM or AOBIM, Louisiana licensure; State and federal DEA

title: GE Aerospace Intern - Asheville
description:
Job Description Summary

The Student Employee will support operations improvement initiatives by collecting and documenting accurate process timing data across a variety of manufacturing and inspection environments. This includes conducting both on-the-floor and video-based observations to capture manual time and automatic cycle time for Shared Resource processes, high-volume machining operations, and QA laboratory inspection activities, including Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) operations. The data gathered in this role will help inform productivity analysis, identify improvement opportunities, and support operational decision-making. The Student Employee may assist with broader continuous improvement efforts such as identifying process waste, documenting standard work by operation, and developing standard work combination sheets.

Job Description

Role Responsibilities

  • Conduct on-the-floor and video-based observations of manufacturing and inspection processes to document manual time and automatic cycle time.
  • Collect process timing data across Shared Resource operations, high-volume machining processes, and QA laboratory inspection processes, including CMM operations.
  • Ensure collected data is accurate, complete, and organized for use in productivity analysis and operations improvement efforts.
  • Partner with operations, manufacturing engineering, quality, and support teams to clarify process steps and validate observed information.
  • Assist in identifying process inefficiencies, waste, and improvement opportunities within observed workflows.
  • Support the documentation of standard work by operation to improve process consistency and visibility.
  • Help develop standard work combination sheets and other operational improvement materials as needed.
  • Maintain professionalism and attention to safety while working in production and laboratory environments.
  • Provide timely updates, summaries, and documentation to support ongoing improvement projects.
  • Work onsite and maintain a flexible schedule to support observations across multiple shifts, including early mornings, evenings, and other off-shift hours as needed.
  • This internship will last from Sept - December and does not include relocation
  • This is a part time role approx 20 hours as week

Required Qualifications

  • Associate’s Degree or High School Diploma / GED from an accredited school or institution

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to capture information accurately.
  • Good observational skills with the ability to recognize process variation and inefficiencies.
  • Interest in operations, manufacturing, lean principles, or continuous improvement.
  • Ability to organize data and document findings clearly and consistently.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with hourly and salaried team members.
  • Willingness to learn manufacturing and inspection processes in a hands-on environment.
  • Comfortable working independently while also collaborating with cross-functional teams.
  • Flexible and dependable, with the ability to adapt to changing priorities and schedules.
  • Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office tools such as Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing, industrial engineering, quality systems, or time study methods is helpful but not required.

title: Staff Program Manager, Voice of the Customer Programs
description:
This role will lead our effort in capturing, synthesizing, and acting on customer feedback. In this role, you will serve as the strategic owner of our VoC infrastructure, turning quantitative metrics and qualitative customer insights into actionable business and product strategies. You will directly manage customer-facing survey initiatives, act as a primary platform administrator and power user for Qualtrics, monitor our product feedback channels, and support our qualitative research efforts including customer focus groups.

What You Own

Survey Architecture & Qualtrics — Own, manage, and optimize the enterprise Qualtrics platform for customer-facing survey and feedback initiatives, acting as the primary subject matter expert and administrator. Design, launch, and manage customer-facing survey programs across the lifecycle, including NPS, CSAT, CES, onboarding, and post-interaction surveys. Establish data collection best practices to reduce survey fatigue and ensure high response rates and representative sampling.

Product Feedback & Cross-Functional Collaboration — Collaborate with Product and Customer Adoption & Experience teams to build and scale a standardized product feedback process. Connect OvC data to ChurnZero Health Scores. Aggregate insights from direct surveys and customer-facing teams to translate customer feedback into prioritized product backlog items and feature enhancements. Design a close-loop process to communicate how feedback drives change both internally (with cross-functional teams) and externally (with customers).

Focus Groups & Qualitative Insights — Plan and support customer focus groups, advisory boards, and in-depth interviews to gather deep qualitative insights. Synthesize qualitative findings alongside quantitative data to create unified story-driven reports for leadership.

Playbooks & Enablement — Educate customer-facing teams on our survey initiatives and feedback processes. Design playbooks for pre- and post-survey outreach that align with best practices on responding to customer feedback in a supportive manner.

Program Strategy & Analytics — Build executive dashboards and quarterly reporting to track core CX metrics, customer sentiment trends, and the ROI of VoC initiatives. Establish automated workflows to flag and address detractor issues in real time.

Program Goals

  • Deliver quarterly executive Root-Cause Analysis for key CX surveys
  • 10+ NPS improvement in year one
  • 90% adherence to Detractor Close-Loop Response target of 48 hours
  • 25% of Product Roadmap VoC-driven
  • Consolidate all CX surveys into Qualtrics
  • Experience:
    • 4+ years of Program Management experience
    • 3+ years of experience in Customer Experience (CX), Market Research, or Customer Insights, with direct ownership of VoC programs
  • Technical Experience: Hands-on experience with Qualtrics (survey design, logic, dashboards, and integrations) is preferred.
  • Qualitative Expertise: Demonstrated experience organizing, facilitating, and analyzing findings from focus groups and customer interviews.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Strong ability to translate raw data into clear narratives that influence Product, Engineering, and Executive decision-making.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Marketing, Psychology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tues - Thurs) from our San Mateo, CA headquarters.

The annual base salary range for this position is $166,345 - $205,485. This role is also eligible for a target bonus.

Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level.

title: Plating Technician 3rd Shift
description:
Howmet Aerospace in Branford, CT is currently hiring highly motivated and energetic candidates to join their team. Howmet Aerospace is a leading provider of advanced engineered solutions for the aerospace and transportation industries worldwide. The Branford facility is focused on producing jet engine components that are essential for mission-critical performance and efficiency in aerospace and defense applications. With over 50 years of experience in the Branford facility, we are proud to contribute to the development of more fuel-efficient, quieter aerospace engines, and sustainable ground transportation. For more information, please visit www.howmet.com.

Follow @howmet: Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.

Job Summary

We are currently looking for a candidate to fill the role of 3rd shift (10:30pm-7:00am) Plating Technician. This position will be responsible to perform a series of operations to complete electro plating process in a proper manner. Perform work assignments covering blades, vanes, clusters, overhaul and repair and OEM parts as needed. This position requires someone with excellent attention to detail and strong math skills. All training required to run our plating tanks will be provided by Howmet.

Job Responsibilities

  • Receive cartons and certify part number and quantity received against internal paperwork.
  • Determine appropriate job requirements by reviewing the internal work instructions and paperwork provided.
  • Responsible to visually inspect each piece to ensure proper pre-plate preparation, i.e.: masking, has been completed prior to processing for plating.
  • Will be expected to perform minor trimming to masking overages, as needed.
  • Attach parts to various plating rack fixtures, ensuring parts are securely in place before submerging racks into tanks.
  • Check fluid levels in various tanks, ensure proper settings are maintained or equipment control panels during plating process, including amount of platinum needed per part to make proper weight gain.
  • Determine amount of platinum plating formula needed based on measurement calculation of surface areas to be plated and number of pieces to be processed.
  • Check PH levels prior to plating process and add appropriate chemical solution. PH is checked once per shift if parts are being processed; addition of water is controlled by systems controls. If additions such as platinum or potassium hydroxide are needed, refer to work instructions. Ensure good contacts are maintained by cleaning bars and making minor adjustments as needed.
  • Monitor amps, temperature levels and solution movement in tanks to ensure proper results are achieved.
  • Move and lift racks in and out of tanks in a timely manner as required throughout each stage process.
  • After process of plating has been completed, Plater will visually inspect each piece, weigh and record output using digital read-out scale into internal record bank.
  • Verify final gain result, meets specification requirements prior to releasing to next operation.
  • Remove all masking by placing trays of parts into electric furnace in an orderly manner, if needed.
  • Ability to use proper and safe containerization methods for all hazardous waste.
  • Keep work area clean and organized.
  • Adhere to all company safety rules and practices and wears protective equipment as directed.
  • Perform other job duties as needed or directed by management.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED from an accredited institution.
  • One (1) year of working in a manufacturing or similar environment
  • Employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • This position entails access to export-controlled items and employment offers are conditioned upon an applicant's ability to lawfully obtain access to such items.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Three (3) years of manufacturing experience.
  • One (1) year of work experience in an aerospace environment.
  • Experience and knowledge specifically to high-temperature diffusion coatings (aluminide, chromide, and platinum aluminide coatings) for gas turbine engine components.

Salary & Benefits

  • Starting salary $25.00
  • Shift differential: 3rd shift $2.00 - Ability to train on 1st shift for several months.
  • External hires are eligible for a $1,000 sign on bonus.
  • Benefit package includes, Medical, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off and more - eligible from day one.
  • Excellent benefits/401K vested from day one.

title: Software Engineering Manager (Test & Devops)
description:
At the company, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.

The Role: The Software team at the company spans the full stack of a regulated medical device company — from embedded and real-time systems through application software, ML inference, GUI, DevOps, and test engineering. It is a team that builds across every layer, working to medical device software standards and shipping software that has to perform reliably in clinical environments.

This is a people-first leadership role. You will manage and develop a team of test and DevOps engineers, set priorities and development plans, and drive performance, while staying hands-on in the technical direction.

At the company, all team members work at least 4 days per week in the office, plus a flexible work-from-home day. This role is based in our London (Kings Cross) office.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and mentor a team of DevOps and test engineers, setting priorities, individual development plans, conducting performance reviews, and maintaining a high standard of engineering practice
  • Own the CI/CD strategy and build and release infrastructure across the software stack, including the multi-device test fleet, pipeline reliability, and artifact management
  • Own the Yocto-based embedded Linux platform build and deployment, including the signed software update mechanism with rollback, hardware compatibility checks, and image integrity and authenticity
  • Lead architecture reviews, perform proofs-of-concept for new infrastructure tools, and contribute directly to codebases where high-level technical hurdles require expert intervention.
  • Define and drive the software V&V and test automation strategy, building infrastructure for continuous validation and championing design for testability across the engineering stack
  • Establish compliance-as-code workflows that map verification evidence to IEC 62304 (Class C) and ISO 14971 risk controls, maintain the high-bar for engineering excellence in a regulated safety-critical environment and automate regulatory evidence generation to reduce time to submission
  • Own cloud-side data pipelines and infrastructure-as-code, supporting data ingest, analysis, and MLOps workflows where required
  • Coordinate cybersecurity workstreams, working closely with IT and QARA teams
  • Partner with the Software Engineering Manager on release processes, branching strategy, and automated quality gates
  • AI is fundamental to our culture — it's not just a tool, but a core part of how we work, collaborate, and innovate. We expect all team members to embrace AI in their daily work and continuously find new ways to use it effectively.

Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in software, DevOps, or test engineering, with at least 3 years in an engineering management or team lead role
  • Proven experience leading and growing DevOps, test, platform, or infrastructure teams
  • Strong hands‑on background in CI/CD, build systems, and test automation for embedded and/or cloud systems
  • Experience with embedded Linux build and deployment, ideally Yocto-based BSPs, or a strong equivalent

title: GTM Lead
description:
Headquarters: UK
URL:

Remote · ~3 days/week · 12-week contract · £500–£650/day · Immediate start · Paid working trial for finalists

About AutoGPT

At AutoGPT, we're building toward a future where AI agents do real work for people — not just answer questions, but take action, complete tasks, and move work forward.

Our mission is to democratize AI by making powerful digital assistants accessible and useful to everyone, regardless of technical background. We created one of the most-starred open-source projects on GitHub, and our hosted platform is now live and accepting paying customers.

We already have a large global audience and tens of thousands of branded search visitors every month. What we don't yet have is a proven, repeatable go-to-market motion.

That's what you'll find.

The Product

  • AutoPilot: an AI teammate that builds and runs working automations from a conversation.

  • AutoGPT Builder: a graph-based canvas for creating agents without coding.

  • AutoGPT Marketplace: discover and deploy ready-made agents.

  • Agent Library: manage, schedule, and monitor agents.

Try it in 60 seconds, no signup required: platform.agpt.co/tour/chat

The Role

Your mandate is to find, prove, and begin scaling a repeatable path from an ICP-fit prospect with an urgent job to an activated, retained AutoGPT customer.

You'll investigate and fix the constraint wherever it exists: ICP selection, positioning, proof, pricing, website conversion, checkout, onboarding, activation, lifecycle communication, product experience, or acquisition.

This isn't a role where you deliver recommendations to another marketing team. You'll personally research, write, build, launch, measure, and iterate, with direct access to the founders, product, engineering, and customer and funnel data.

What You'll Own

  • Establish reliable measurement from acquisition through purchase, activation, and retention.

  • Interview customers, non-buyers, churned users, and high-fit waitlist members.

  • Validate or disprove our ICP and use-case hypotheses.

  • Define the initial ICP, anti-ICP, JTBD, buying trigger, and value proposition.

  • Improve positioning, use-case pages, proof, checkout, and onboarding.

  • Help define and improve activation and time to value.

  • Launch segmented waitlist campaigns.

  • Run controlled paid-search tests around high-intent, non-branded problems.

  • Validate SEO opportunities before scaling content.

  • Test product-led social, YouTube, outreach, or partnerships where evidence supports them.

  • Work directly with product and engineering on funnel and activation improvements.

  • Maintain a prioritized experiment backlog with hypotheses, costs, results, and decisions.

  • Provide concise weekly reporting: one async memo and one 30-minute decision meeting.

  • Protect and elevate the AutoGPT brand throughout.

What Success Looks Like

Within 10 business days:

  • A reliable view of the funnel, including qualified traffic and meaningful product activation.

  • Evidence explaining the biggest current drop-offs.

  • Customer and high-fit non-buyer interviews completed.

  • Initial improvements or experiments already live.

  • Numeric targets agreed for the remainder of the contract.

By the end of the engagement:

  • ICP and use-case hypotheses validated or rejected.

  • Qualified conversion and/or activation and retention improved.

  • Acquisition sources that produce genuinely valuable customers understood.

  • The beginnings of a repeatable acquisition + activation motion — or compelling evidence identifying and addressing a more fundamental constraint.

  • A documented growth operating system and clear recommendation for what comes next.

The primary outcome isn't more traffic. It's more ICP-fit customers who successfully use AutoGPT and remain customers.

Who We're Looking For

You've personally operated in an early-stage product-led B2B or prosumer SaaS environment — perhaps as a first or second growth hire, founding marketer, hands-on growth lead, product-growth operator, or former founder.

You can demonstrate:

  • Relevant 0-to-1 growth results, including the starting baseline.

  • Exactly what you personally did — real pages, emails, ads, onboarding flows, dashboards, or research.

  • Strong customer-research and product-marketing judgment.

  • Analytical self-sufficiency across attribution, billing, and product data.

  • Experience improving onboarding, activation, or retention.

  • Ability to write and ship landing pages, emails, ads, and lifecycle communication.

  • Hands-on paid-search and experimentation experience.

  • Excellent written English and strong brand judgment.

  • Ability to work autonomously and communicate concisely.

Experience with AI, automation, developer tools, no-code products, or open-source communities is useful, but evidence that you've solved this kind of commercial problem matters more.

This Is Not

  • An adviser-only fractional CMO role.

  • A strategy-deck engagement.

  • A pure paid-acquisition role.

  • An SEO content-production contract.

  • A social-media management role.

  • An agency account-management role.

  • A position for someone who needs a full design, analytics, and marketing team before shipping.

Agency applications aren't suitable. We want the individual who will personally do the work.

Why AutoGPT?

You'll own the commercial growth problem at a pivotal moment: a famous brand, a live product, an existing audience, and a genuinely open playing field.

You'll have direct access to the founders, fast decisions on experiments, and no approval bureaucracy for agreed reversible tests.

We're a small, kind, globally distributed team that values empathy, autonomy, and shipping. What you prove during this engagement can become the company's long-term growth engine.

Details

Role: Contract GTM Lead (0-to-1)
Term: Initial 12 weeks, approximately 3 days/week
Location: Fully remote, async-first, with meaningful European working-hour overlap
Rate: £500–£650/day, depending on evidence and experience
Start: Immediate
Selection: Finalists complete a paid working trial

How to Apply

The application takes approximately 10 minutes.

Apply here:

We'll ask for:

  1. Two relevant examples of early-stage growth work, including the starting position, problem, your personal contribution, what you shipped, results, and what didn't work.

  2. An example where an apparent acquisition problem turned out to be a different funnel, product, or positioning problem.

  3. What you'd need access to in your first week.

  4. Your availability, time zone, day rate, and number of other active clients.

  5. A short recording after trying AutoGPT, covering the biggest unknown you'd investigate, the first metric you'd establish, and one thing you'd deliberately avoid doing prematurely.

We assess candidates on relevant evidence, analytical judgment, hands-on execution, customer and product-marketing ability, brand judgment, and autonomy.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary

Provides strategy and leadership for team responsible for medical economics analysis activities, including extracting, analyzing and synthesizing data from various sources to identify risks and opportunities, and improve financial performance and outcomes. Collaborates with health plans to develop scoreable action item (SAI) tracking tools and identify opportunities to improve performance and data management, and support, guide and influence decision-making related to clinical programs, initiatives and strategy.

Essential Job Duties

• Supports strategy development, vision and direction for the medical economics function including SAI analytics, governance and trend mitigation. Demonstrates accountability for performance and financial results, and keeps executive leadership apprised.
• Provides oversight for medical economics team and activities - ensuring delivery of work/project plans, required reporting, development of SAI tracking tools and performance/data management improvement initiatives.
• Recruits, hires, onboards, mentors, develops, and manages medical economics team of professionals.
• Collaborates with leadership to develop and implement a companywide SAI governance process that moves through ideation, analysis, health plan review, approval, implementation planning and monitoring.
• Identifies opportunities to improve health plan performance and data management.
• Leads staff in SAI analysis, key performance indicator (KPI) reporting and tracking.
• Implements tracking tool for trend mitigation items being worked between health plans and shared services (tools and technology).
• Facilitates standardization of tools and view utilized in trend drill down process.
• Leads staff in best practices across all areas of SAI development.
• Coordinates SAI analyses that are completed outside of the MedEcon team - including payment integrity, national contracting, health care services and health plans.
• Leads staff in vendor proposal review and performance review in support of vendor management team; consults with shared service partners on program improvement efforts and tracking.
• Performs consistent follow-up on issues and opportunities identified.
• Acts as thought leader for creation of additional data views for efficient analytics member level MLR, clinical condition and authorization views.
• Stays abreast of professional developments and industry trends.

Required Qualifications

• At least 10 years of health care analytics and/or medical economics experience, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
• At least 5 years management/leadership experience.
• Bachelor’s degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, health care management or related field.
• Advanced understanding of Medicaid and Medicare programs or other health care plans.
• Advanced analytical work experience within the health care industry (i.e., hospital, network, ancillary, medical facility, health care vendor, commercial health insurance, large physician practice, managed care organization, etc.)
• Advanced proficiency with retrieving specified information from data sources.
• Advanced experience with building dashboards in Excel, Power BI, and/or Tableau and data management.
• Advanced knowledge of health care operations (utilization management, disease management, HEDIS quality measures, claims processing, etc.)
• Advanced knowledge of health care financial terms (e.g., PMPM, revenue) and different standard code systems (ICD-10CM, CPT, HCPCS, NDC, etc.) utilized in medical coding/billing (UB04/1500 form).
• Advanced understanding of key managed care concepts and provider reimbursement principles such as risk adjustment, capitation, FFS (Fee-for-Service), Diagnosis Related Groups (DRG’s), Ambulatory Patient Groups (APG’s), Ambulatory Payment Classifications (APC’s), and other payment mechanisms.
• Advanced understanding of value-based risk arrangements
• Advanced experience in quantifying, measuring, and analyzing financial, operational, and/or utilization metrics in health care.
• Advanced problem-solving skills.
• Advanced critical-thinking and attention to detail.
• Ability to effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and engage with various levels within the organization.
• Strong time-management skills, and ability to manage simultaneous projects and tasks to meet internal deadlines.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products, advanced skills in Excel (VLOOKUPs and pivot tables)/applicable software program(s) proficiency.


Preferred Qualifications

•Experience in complex managed care.

Vi söker dig som är nyutexaminerad ekonom och som drivs av att utveckla både dig själv och din omgivning. Du är en lagspelare, men trivs även med att jobba självständigt. Du är strukturerad, utåtriktad, nyfiken och drivs av nya utmaningar.

Vidare ser vi gärna att du har:

  • Goda studieresultat och engagemang vid sidan av studierna.
  • Mycket goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift.
  • Ett intresse för att utveckla affärer och verksamheter.

Relevant arbetslivserfarenhet (exempelvis inom ekonomi, bank, kundkontakt) är meriterande. Studier inom IT-relaterade ämnen, utöver dina ekonomistudier, samt mycket goda Excel-kunskaper är meriterande.

Vi erbjuder

Som en del av Deloitte får du tillgång till världens största konsultnätverk med kollegor världen över som du kan nyttja för att utveckla både dig själv, våra klienter och vår verksamhet. Du får arbeta med spännande, komplexa uppdrag, både på global och nordisk nivå, i team som alltid värderar ditt perspektiv och på en revisionsavdelning i framkant av digitaliseringen. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att erbjuda dig möjligheter att driva din personliga utveckling. Vi erbjuder dig praktisk erfarenhet, en personlig coach som långsiktigt stöttar dig i din karriär och kontinuerlig feedback och support från mer erfarna kollegor.

Du får möjlighet att arbeta i ett företag som hjälper andra aktörer i deras resa mot en mer hållbar organisation, samtidigt som vi arbetar målmedvetet med våra egna ambitioner inom både klimat, miljö och socialt ansvar. Vi ser ett värde i att våra medarbetare har olika erfarenheter vilket främjar nytänkande och bidrar till fler perspektiv.

Ansökan

Du ansöker online. Din ansökan ska bestå av:

  • CV

  • Betygskopior från högskola/universitet - De betyg som du laddar upp bör inte vara utdragna senare än 2 månader tillbaka i tiden.

I det första steget laddar du upp ditt CV. I nästa steg laddar du upp dina universitetsbetyg (över hittills avklarade kurser) samt svarar på frågor som är kopplade till rollen, inklusive en motivering till varför du sökt denna roll. Observera att både CV samt fullständiga betyg behöver laddas upp för att din ansökan ska ses som fullständig. Vi tillämpar löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vid inskickad ansökan ska du få ett bekräftelsemejl från oss. Får du inte detta mejl råder vi dig att skicka in din ansökan på nytt. Om du söker flera tjänster hos oss ber vi dig att i dina ansökningar tydliggöra vilken roll du är mest intresserad av.

På Deloitte värdesätter vi olika kompetenser, perspektiv och erfarenheter, eftersom det skapar bättre möjligheter att effektivt lösa komplexa utmaningar för våra kunder. Vi uppmuntrar dig att söka tjänsten om du tror att dina färdigheter kan bidra till vårt teams framgång.

Som ett kvalitativt led i Deloittes rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en bakgrundskontroll, detta för att öka kännedomen om våra framtida medarbetare, trygga arbetsmiljön för våra medarbetare och möta regelkrav. Processen för bakgrundskontroller genomförs i samarbete med ToFindOut. . För de tjänster som Deloitte efterfrågar universitetsbetyg, genomförs en verifiering som en del i rekryteringsprocessen. För frågor hänvisar vi till ansvarig rekryterare i processen.

Frågor

Om du har frågor om tjänsten eller om rekryteringsprocessen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Helen Nehma, hnehma@deloitte.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

What impact will you make?

På Deloitte gör ditt arbete en meningsfull skillnad, varje dag, medan du växer i en inkluderande företagskultur av samarbete och hög prestation. Utöver att skapa lösningar strävar vi efter att göra en positiv och avgörande skillnad för andra i vår omgivning, våra klienter och samhället. På Deloitte hittar du tidigare dolda möjligheter att lyckas och inser din fulla potential.

title: NGM - Grade Control Driller
description:
Position Description:

Would you like to have a career with a collaborative, diverse, and dynamic mining company? We have an exciting opportunity for you!

Our people division is growing, and we are looking for a Grade Control Driller to join our team. The successful candidate will operate Reverse Circulation (RC) drill rigs safely and efficiently to deliver high-quality grade control drilling while maintaining drill accuracy, sample integrity, and equipment reliability in accordance with mine plans, production schedules, and company standards.

At Nevada Gold Mines, our vision is to be the world’s most valued gold mining business by finding, developing, and operating the best assets with the best people. We are committed to a safe work environment sending every person home safe and healthy every day and leaving a sustainable legacy on our host communities.

Responsibilities:

  • Operate RC drill rigs safely and efficiently in accordance with site procedures and manufacturer requirements
  • Complete pre-start inspections, workplace examinations and risk assessments before commencing work
  • Deliver grade control drilling to specified collar locations, depths and quality standards
  • Ensure all drill samples are collected, handled and bagged in accordance with grade control sampling procedures to maintain sample integrity and prevent contamination
  • Monitor and maintain representative sample recovery throughout the drilling process
  • Operate and maintain cyclones, splitters and sampling systems to maximize sample quality and minimize contamination.
  • Immediately identify and report any issues that may compromise sample integrity, drill accuracy or drilling quality
  • Conduct routine operator maintenance, inspections and housekeeping of drilling equipment
  • Identify and report equipment defects and coordinate repairs with Maintenance
  • Accurately complete drill logs, production reports, pre-starts and operational documentation
  • Work closely with Geology, Mining, Survey and Maintenance teams to achieve production objectives
  • Maintain compliance with all health, safety, environmental and statutory requirements
  • Actively participate in toolbox meetings, safety observations and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

  • Minimum three (3) years' experience operating Reverse Circulation (RC) drill rigs, preferably in grade control and/or production mining environments preferred
  • Demonstrated commitment to achieving and maintaining a zero-harm safety culture required
  • Strong understanding of grade control drilling practices, drill pattern accuracy and sample quality requirements required
  • Strong understanding of grade control sampling practices, including representative sample recovery, contamination prevention, cyclone and splitter maintenance, and preservation of sample integrity required
  • Demonstrated ability to consistently produce high-quality, representative RC samples in accordance with grade control QA/QC requirements required
  • Understanding of the impact that drilling practices and sample quality have on ore control and mining outcomes required
  • Experience operating in active open pit mining environments preferred
  • Sound knowledge of hazard identification, risk management and critical risk controls preferred
  • Ability to perform routine operator maintenance and equipment inspections preferred
  • Ability to identify mechanical issues and report defects promptly preferred
  • Commitment to maintaining drill rig cleanliness and housekeeping standards preferred
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills preferred
  • Basic computer literacy, including Microsoft Office and electronic reporting systems preferred
  • Current driver's license and relevant site competencies required
  • Demonstrated ability to perform the inherent requirements of the position required

What We Can Offer You

  • A comprehensive compensation package including a competitive medical, dental, and vision plan with national provider networks, a 401k retirement plan with employer contribution AND employer match, paid time off, company-sponsored medical clinics, company match share purchase program, and much more!
  • Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team.
  • Endless opportunities to grow and learn with industry colleagues.
  • Access to a variety of career opportunities across the organization.
  • Nevada Gold Mines is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Thank you for your application, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Intermediate Engineer-Information Services (A/V)
description:
Intermediate Engineer-Information Services (Productivity Management A/V)

Our team members advance our mission and exemplify excellence, compassion, teamwork, and purpose in all that they do. Indiana University Health is seeking individuals who embody these values to join our Information Services organization in the role of Intermediate Engineer-Information Services (Productivity Management).

Summary

The IS Engineer – Intermediary (Productivity Management – A/V) is responsible for supporting, maintaining, and enhancing IU Health’s enterprise audiovisual and collaboration environments. This role serves as a technical bridge between senior A/V engineers and frontline support teams, focusing on operational stability, incident resolution, and execution of enterprise A/V initiatives.

The Intermediary Engineer independently handles moderately complex A/V and collaboration issues, supports project deployments, and contributes to standardization and continuous improvement efforts across conference rooms, auditoriums, clinical AV environments, and Microsoft Teams–enabled collaboration spaces.

Fulfills customer requirements via design/build/test/troubleshoot/document activities for enterprise-class datacenter computing hardware, software, networking tools and platforms. Evaluates, analyzes, configures, and implements new products and tools while ensuring appropriate operational monitoring is enabled. Provides support for logical networking and communications protocols, Microsoft products, Intel and midrange platforms, relational databases, and programming/scripting.

Candidate Qualifications

Candidates for the position will be evaluated according to the following criteria and competencies.

• Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience.
•3-5 years of experience required.
• Healthcare, health insurance and health providers experience and understanding of processes is preferred.
• Experience working with hypervisors and scripting required.
• Requires experience working with vendors to quote moderately complex solutions.
• Cloud experience is preferred.

Additional- Preferred Skills

  • Microsoft Teams and Teams Rooms
  • Enterprise A/V platforms (e.g., Crestron, Extron, Cisco, Yealink, or similar)
  • Fundamental networking concepts (QoS, VLANs, bandwidth considerations)
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and customer service‑ skills.
  • CTS or progress toward CTS / CTS‑I certification.
  • Experience supporting large‑scale A/V room inventories across multiple locations.
  • Familiarity with ITIL‑based service management practices.
  • Healthcare IT experience.

Role Responsibilities

Enterprise A/V & Collaboration Support

  • Provide Tier 2–3 technical support for enterprise A/V environments, including conference rooms, auditoriums, clinical AV spaces, and live‑streaming systems.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Microsoft Teams Rooms, cameras, microphones, displays, control systems, and room peripherals.
  • Assist with installation, configuration, testing, and validation of A/V solutions in accordance with established architectural standards.

Microsoft 365 & Productivity Platform Integration

  • Support collaboration platforms that intersect with A/V services, including Microsoft Teams, Teams Rooms, Stream, and related Microsoft 365 services.
  • Partner with senior engineers and architects to ensure A/V solutions integrate with Microsoft 365 governance, security, and lifecycle practices.

Operational Excellence (KTLO)

  • Manage day‑to‑day operational workload including break/fix incidents, service requests, lifecycle refresh support, and vendor coordination.
  • Participate in root‑cause analysis for recurring issues and recommend corrective actions to improve reliability and user experience.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, asset inventories, and configuration records.

Project & Program Support

  • Execute defined technical tasks for enterprise A/V and productivity initiatives under the guidance of senior engineers or architects.
  • Support pilots, upgrades, firmware updates, and hardware refresh cycles across enterprise environments.

Key Relationships

Reports to: Manager-Information Services

Direct Reports: N/A

Onsite Monday - Friday - Day shift ( (some hybrid flexibility)

Location: Indianapolis, IN

Indiana University Health is unlike any other healthcare system, and we are looking for team members who share the things that matter most to us. IU Health leaders play a crucial role in advancing the mission of our organization and inspiring teams to make a meaningful difference in the lives of patients. As one of Indiana’s largest employers and the most comprehensive medical system in the state, our vision is to lead the transformation of healthcare through quality, innovation, and education, and make Indiana one of the healthiest states.

IU Health is the largest health system in Indiana with nearly 40,000 team members, 15 hospitals, and $8.64 billion in operating revenue. Indiana University Health is dedicated to a fair hiring process and is committed to equal opportunity and nondiscrimination for all individuals, regardless of age, color, disability, ethnicity, marital status, national origin, race, religion, gender identity, expression, sexual orientation, or veteran status.

title: Telemetry Technician Trainee

    • Demonstrates competence and knowledge specific to the job responsibilities.

  12. Performs other related duties as required and assigned by supervisor.

description:

As a Team Member of the Food and Beverage team, the Restaurant Server is a CRCR Ambassador and takes personal ownership to ensure all of their actions are in the best interest of the business. The Restaurant Server is responsible for actively taking orders, conducting full and complete food/beverage service, and monitoring Guests’ dining experience. Interacts with dining room Guests in a polite, courteous manner to ensure gracious hospitality while anticipating their needs and providing personalized attention throughout the meal.

Position Functions
Essential Functions
• Provide exceptional Guest service, portraying a positive and professional attitude.
• Acquire station assignments from the Host team or management at the start of the work shift; properly complete all assigned opening and side work duties.
• Accurately checks identification of Guests who appear under 30 years of age and prevents underage service.

• Effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to Guests.
• Make recommendations for food and beverage menu items based on Guests’ preferences.

• Monitors Guests for signs of intoxication and disruptive behavior, identifies when to refuse alcohol service in a safe and courteous manner, and reports it to management.
• Properly present the Guest check and process payment for all food and beverages served.
• Provide attention to detail, including proper table settings, food presentation and tableside preparation.
• With direction from management, close the station at the end of the shift, completing all closing, side work, and checkout duties in a timely manner.
• Complies with the Department of Health and business sanitation standards.
• Other duties as assigned.

Skills
• Strong listening and communication skills.
• Problem-solving and critical thinking.
• Must be able to work independently and maintain a high level of performance.
• Must be able to complete tasks in a timely and efficient manner while maintaining business standards.
• Demonstrate a flock mentality, focused on teamwork and collaboration with others.
• Provide exceptional service to internal and external Guests while leveraging the knowledge of the position and the business, ensuring a clucktastic experience for all.
• Stay engaged and motivated with the business, department, and all Team Members at all levels while encouraging growth and development of self and others.
• Build lasting relationships by demonstrating honesty, integrity, and effective communication.
• Driven to exceed expectations while remaining accountable and fair.
• Skilled at walking with a Brahma while serving.

Qualifications

Minimum requirements:
• Must be at least 18/21 years of age, depending on the restaurant venue.
• 1+ years in a similar role.
• Must possess or be able to complete RBS training and certification for alcohol service.
• Must possess or be able to complete ServSafe/Food Handler’s training and certification.
• Must have a comprehensive understanding of the menu, including ingredients, preparation methods, and specials.
• Bilingual is a plus.
• Basic math skills.

Preferred qualifications:
• 2+ years in a similar role.
• Sports knowledge as necessary.

title: MST Therapist 1
description:
Bradford/Tioga/Sullivan Counties - Anticipated start date September 2026


SUMMARY

MST Therapist works with at risk youth and families to improve their overall functioning and reduce out of home placement. MST Therapist receives intense supervision for a small case load of 4-6 families to ensure that the progress of each youth and family system in behavior change that aligns with targeted outcomes. MST Therapist receives intensive training in the MST model and develops expertise in the delivery of MST principles and analytic process.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Attends MST and other company required trainings to establish the foundation necessary to function as an employee and therapist within the clinical program.
  2. Schedules regular meetings with youth and families with frequency meeting the needs of the family.
  3. Travels to youth homes and other appropriate systems as may be necessary to manage the treatment plan for an assigned case (schools, courts, etc.)
  4. Documents in electronic health record and client charts. Establishes youth record and enters all clinical documentation and activities within the expected time-frame. Closes cases as appropriate.
  5. Assesses needs of youth and develops a treatment plan in consultation with youth, family and supervisor. Reviews plan regularly with family and supports its application.
  6. Assumes on call responsibilities for week and weekend service needs as part of a team rotation to support youth and families in a targeted geography.
  7. Regularly meets with supervisor to review the status of cases and assess fidelity to the MST model.
  8. Develops familiarity with, acts on, and adheres to regulations and standards from MST, MCO’s, DHS, JCAHO, PREA, Background Clearances, etc.
  9. Familiar with and displays the ability to apply the principles of crisis management and trauma-informed care. Maintains CPR and first aid certifications.
  10. Seeks support of more experienced MST Therapists or Supervisor for difficult situations and communicates unusual events in a timely manner.
  11. Develops engagement with key stakeholders who have connections with assigned youth as a way to enhance treatment progress and sustainability.
  12. Develops positive working relationships with key stakeholders through collaboration, providing opportunities for referral outreach.


JOB FUNCTIONS

Must be able to demonstrate the ability to learn and apply the essential principles and analytic process of Multisystemic Therapy (MST) to youth and families through direct intervention.

Vocational Competencies as a first level MST Therapist emphasize learning the model and systems that support the delivery of the program to youth and families. Transitions theoretical knowledge gained through training into actual practice under close supervision with initial visits partnered under the direction of a supervisor or senior level MST Therapist. Demonstrates a broad knowledge of what MST addresses in terms of a youth’s peers, home, school and community. Able to generally describe key components of MST, including but not limited to family therapy, parenting skills, marital therapy, household management, adolescent education factors, adult and adolescent mental health care, drug and alcohol factors, time management skills, parent and youth peer management, and influential community aspects. Demonstrates the ability to discuss with peers terms that define the MST approach. These include but are not necessarily limited to a youth’s natural ecology, fit circle and assessment, expectations and roles, targeted behaviors, tailored interventions, reinforcement based therapy, mental health incorporation, etc. Develops and demonstrates the ability to use the MST and Adelphoi software, including establishing cases as a start of care, maintaining activity and clinical notes, updating treatment documentation and discharging youth from the program. With appropriate training, demonstrates the ability to log on, navigate, and use basic features as they pertain to a caseload including treatment documentation input and reports. Ability to describe how therapist adherence measures (TAM-R) and Supervisor Adherence (SAM) support overall program fidelity. At the end of an appropriate period of mentorship, demonstrates the ability to independently manage a caseload. Must have completed a minimum of 12 cases for promotional eligibility.

Behavioral Competencies to be emphasized include Communication (1:1 and Small Groups), Leadership (Self-Management), Relationship Building (Approachability & Boundaries), Teamwork (Knowing Your Own Role) and Personal Development (Learns a Job). Emphasis is on the ability to demonstrate growth across a depth and breadth of capabilities that indicate a foundation that will permit success in the role as an MST Therapist.

Process Competencies focus on Task Execution (Immediate Job Knowledge), Value Management (Basic Company Knowledge), Business Planning (Immediate Line of Site), Client Relationship Management (Immediate Co-Workers & Clients) Emphasis to develop the basic set of process related tasks to be able to participate in the use of company and program related systems and work flows.

title: Chair - Revenue Strategy & Innovation
description:
The Revenue Strategy and Innovation (RSI) Chair reports to the Mayo Clinic Chief Financial Officer and is a member of the Finance Leadership Team. The role requires partnership with all levels of Practice leadership and Mayo Clinic’s Clinical Practice Committees to ensure current and future payment models are aligned with Mayo Clinic’s current and future clinical care models. Site and shield CFO’s, the Chair of Revenue Cycle, Strategy, other finance leaders, the Kern Center for the Science of Health Care Delivery, Government Relations, and Information Technology will also be key partners for this position.

The Revenue Strategy and Innovation Chair oversees a team responsible for a portfolio of commercial and government payment revenue exceeding $20 billion on an annual basis, including: actuarial services, performance and analytics, commercial contracting, government and pricing strategy, strategic pricing, payment model innovation, and the chargemaster.

Position Responsibilities:

  • The Revenue Strategy and Innovation Chair supports the Chief Financial Officer and other executives in strategy development on core payment and reimbursement models, including the ideation and business planning on innovative payment and delivery models that support Mayo Clinic’s Strategic Operating Plan.

  • The Chair will have primary responsibility for ideation and model development, the financial design, performance and analytics, for negotiating strategies and tactics, and for the day-to-day operations that support new care models.

  • Using data and analytics to monitor and identify opportunities and exposures in both government and commercial segments to advance Mayo Clinic’s strategic operating plan and to the extent possible, merging efforts and approaches so that all parties – transactional revenue cycle as well as operating leadership – have access to accurate and real time information.

  • Leveraging the growing set(s) of pricing information available for healthcare providers to best effect for Mayo Clinic in terms of market intelligence and positioning.

  • Designing and implementing, in concert with practice leadership and supported by data and analytics, reimbursement and contract approaches that take advantage of opportunities and mitigate exposures.

  • Ensuring the necessary teams and individuals are engaged in the ideation and development of solutions so any corresponding at processes, workflows, training and change management are communicated.

  • Ensuring the data, analytic and operational capabilities, and skills for the future all exist.

  • Establishing and achieving performance metric targets and monitoring them for on-going enhancement.

  • Commercial contracting in domestic and international markets, direct-to-employer contracting, risk-based program design and analytics, strategic market pricing, and Medicare strategy.

  • The Chair will represent the department and participate in institutional committees and taskforces and be actively engaged with external groups to ensure Mayo is apprised and aware of market disruptors and innovations in payment and delivery models.

  • The Chair will coordinate Mayo resources (projects, people, facilities, money and equipment) in an effective and efficient manner and will lead, coach and mentor a staff of leaders.

This is a hybrid position and must be located within 100 miles of one of the following Mayo Clinic campuses: Jacksonville, FL; Phoenix, AZ; or Rochester, MN, with an expectation to work on-site based on business needs.

Minimum Education and/or Experience Required:

Requires an MBA, MHA, or similar degree and 10+ years of management experience in the healthcare field. Key skills and experience include a track record of success in negotiating provider-payer contracts, expertise in crafting successful risk-based contracts and payment models, and specific experience with CMS value-based models (ACO’s, BPCI, etc). Expertise and direct experience managing operations, including specific skills in budgeting and forecasting, process improvement, and planning and project management. Unique combinations of education and experience which provide an equivalent background may also meet the requirements of the position.

Additional Experience and/or Qualifications:

Broad experience at a payer, Academic Medical Center, or other provider-based organization is preferred. Experience in Commercial and Government risk-based contracting and payment models and a track record of results in Fee-for-Service contracting. Demonstrated success in both personnel and budgetary management. Ability to effectively build, lead and motivate teams of individuals with diverse skills and abilities. Proven ability to build successful, collaborative relationships with highest levels of physician and administrative leadership in a heavily matrixed structure. Able to understand and strategically apply financial analyses to the complex needs of Mayo practice and evolving business needs. A strong leader with excellent analytical abilities (ability to understand claims, quality and other quantitative metrics from an actuarial, data science, payer contracting, Medicare strategy, and market pricing team and use as inputs to design and execute risk-based programs), oral and written communication skills, presentation skills, and superior interpersonal skills that facilitate effective relationships both within and outside of Mayo Clinic. Politically savvy and able to function effectively in the face of ambiguity. Must demonstrate ability to work effectively in consensus-style operation that expects and promotes teamwork. Demonstrated ability to appropriately handle sensitive/proprietary information.

title: Senior Backend .NET Developer – Digital Health
description:
Twoday is the leading digital transformation partner in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 specialists, we collaborate with some of the most admired private and public organisations to deliver cutting-edge digital solutions. Our expertise spans software engineering, Data & AI, cloud platforms, digital experiences and business applications.

We are now looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to help transform a large-scale development and deployment platform from traditional DevOps into a modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering setup.

Permanent position at Twoday | Copenhagen

Senior Backend .NET Developer – Digital Health

Digital Engineering | Copenhagen

Senior Backend .NET Developer – Digital Health

Do you want to build and evolve business-critical digital solutions that support Denmark’s healthcare sector?

Twoday is looking for experienced Backend .NET Developers to join a major, long-term digital health delivery in Copenhagen. You will work with complex systems where reliability, security, maintainability and technical quality are essential – and where the solutions you help build and operate have a direct impact on critical public services.

This is a permanent position with Twoday, where this delivery would, if we win the tender, become your first assignment as a consultant with us.

The role

The customer is introducing a new delivery model in which several suppliers will collaborate closely on the development, maintenance and operation of a portfolio of business-critical healthcare applications.

Rather than operating as separate supplier organisations, developers from different companies will work together in shared teams. This makes technical expertise essential, but it also requires engineers who collaborate well, share knowledge and take responsibility for the overall delivery – not just their own code.

As a Senior Backend .NET Developer, you will work hands-on throughout the software delivery lifecycle: from analysis and refinement through design and development to testing, deployment, maintenance and troubleshooting in production.

You will be expected to contribute to building robust solutions and to take technical ownership in close collaboration with other developers, Solution Architects, testers, DevOps specialists and product stakeholders.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing, developing and maintaining backend services and server-side components

  • Developing APIs and integrations across a complex application landscape

  • Contributing to application design, data modelling and technical decision-making

  • Working with microservices, distributed systems and event-driven architectures

  • Designing for resilience, scalability, high availability and operational stability

  • Working with messaging technologies and asynchronous communication

  • Building and maintaining automated build, test and deployment pipelines

  • Contributing to containerised deployment and modern infrastructure practices

  • Implementing appropriate logging, monitoring and observability

  • Applying secure coding practices and considering security and privacy throughout the development lifecycle

  • Writing automated tests and contributing to high standards for code quality and documentation

  • Diagnosing and resolving issues across release and production environments

  • Contributing to backlog refinement and translating requirements into technically sound solutions

  • Sharing knowledge and collaborating across teams and suppliers

The formal role includes both development and operation of server-side components as well as version control and automated pipelines.

What we are looking for

You are an experienced, hands-on backend engineer with a strong foundation in C# and .NET and a track record of developing complex, business-critical software.

You are comfortable looking beyond an individual feature or service and understand how architecture, integration, data, security, deployment and operations come together in a production environment.

We are particularly interested in experience with several of the following:

  • C# and modern .NET / .NET Core

  • ASP.NET Core and backend service development

  • REST APIs and systems integration

  • Microservices and distributed systems

  • Messaging and event-driven architectures, such as Kafka or comparable technologies

  • SQL, data modelling and transactional systems

  • Domain-driven design and modern software architecture principles

  • Docker, containers and modern deployment practices

  • CI/CD and automated delivery pipelines

  • Azure DevOps or comparable engineering platforms

  • Git and collaborative development workflows

  • Automated testing and quality engineering

  • Observability, monitoring and production troubleshooting

  • Authentication, authorisation and secure software development

  • Resilience patterns and highly available systems

  • Agile software development

Experience from healthcare, Danish public-sector IT or other complex and regulated environments is a strong advantage.

Healthcare knowledge is not a prerequisite for every position on the team, but relevant experience from the healthcare domain will be particularly valuable.

Who you are

You are still close to the technology and enjoy solving difficult engineering problems.

You take ownership of your work from understanding the problem to seeing the solution perform reliably in production. At the same time, you recognise that seniority is not only about technical depth. You contribute constructively to technical discussions, challenge solutions when needed, support colleagues and help the team make sound engineering decisions.

The delivery will involve close collaboration across organisational boundaries, so you should be comfortable working transparently with colleagues from different companies and contributing to a shared engineering culture.

You must be fluent in spoken and written Danish and English.

The role is based in Copenhagen and requires a significant degree of onsite work at the customer.

Join Twoday

At Twoday, you will join a strong professional technology environment with colleagues working across software engineering, architecture, cloud, data and digital transformation.

This is a permanent position with Twoday, where this delivery would, if we win the tender, become your first assignment as a consultant with us. Your employment is with Twoday and is not limited to this particular customer or project.

For the right developer, this is an opportunity to combine deep backend engineering with a long-term assignment in an important and technically complex area of Danish digital infrastructure.

We look forward to hearing from you.

About Twoday

Twoday operates from modern offices across 30 locations in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and Lithuania. We have a strong and unique social environment with highly engaged employees. If you are the candidate we are looking for, you will play a central role with exciting opportunities to grow within an international and innovative group, working on cutting-edge technology and software solutions. You will also have the flexibility to occasionally work from one of our main offices in Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki or Vilnius.

Diversity & inclusion

Do you not meet all the requirements? Studies show that women and minorities are less likely to apply for a job if they don’t meet every qualification. At Twoday, we are committed to building a workplace and community where everyone is welcome. If you are excited about this role but your previous experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we still encourage you to apply.
