title: Supervisor, Field Operations
description:
Our culture lifts you up—there is no ego in the way. Our common purpose? We all want to win for our customers. We aim to always be evolving, dynamic, and ambitious. We believe in the power of genuine connections. Each employee is a part of what makes us unique on the market: agile and dedicated.

Time Type:

Regular

Job Description :

About Our Company

Breezeline is a dynamic, innovative company providing the very best Internet, TV, and Voice service to the US markets we serve. We are ‘Above And Beyonders’, who consistently strive to surprise and delight our customers by doing the unexpected. We continually look for new and better ways to enrich our customers’ lives through connected and memorable experiences.

As the eighth-largest cable operator in the United States, Breezeline reaches more than 1.7 million homes and businesses in 13 states with Internet, TV, Voice and fiber services. Headquartered in Quincy, MA, Breezeline is a subsidiary of Cogeco Communications Inc. (TSX:CCA).

Why Work At Breezeline?

As one of the country’s fast-growing Internet service providers, Breezeline offers our colleagues a vibrant workplace culture and excellent career opportunities. As a proudly diverse and inclusive organization, we believe that every person’s unique individuality should be welcomed and celebrated, and their abilities and potential should be honored and recognized. It is a key part of our culture to actively promote opportunities internally to ensure that you are never static in your career with us.

Internal Values – How we act

We’re proud that Breezeline is unlike any other employer in the industry. We work hard, but we never lose sight of the big picture. We understand that our colleagues are looking for more than just a great job – they want an extraordinary life – and at Breezeline, we want to make that a reality.

And here is how we do it.

Fun: We laugh a lot. It makes every day brighter, and if you don’t love what you do, you’re not doing it right.

Job flexibility: We think everything you do matters – at work and home.

Discounted services: We offer our customers some fantastic services, and we think you deserve to enjoy them in your home, too.

Total Rewards: Let’s be honest, everyone wants to make a good salary. We offer attractive total rewards and a great culture to go along with it. We’ve got you and your family covered with one of the best packages in the business.

Career evolution: At Breezeline, you get more than just a job. You get all the tools you need to learn, grow, and achieve your career goals!

Cutting-edge technology: Do you have a passion for technology? Great, we do, too. At Breezeline, you will get the opportunity to manage, influence, play, create, fix, and re-shape the industry.

Position Summary

Breezeline’s Supervisor Field Operations is a fully functioning, higher level role that supports the growth of the system by assuring the quality performance of the technical services, installation setup, testing, and maintenance of all current and future Breezeline products and services over an HFC network and other equipment associated with plant facilities and distribution systems. The incumbent ensures the quality of services provided to end users meets or exceeds established industry and company performance standards and is compliant with FCC requirements and protocol. He/she coordinates with all functional departments (corporate, market, or region, as applicable) regarding the optimization of overall business efforts. Accountabilities also encompass Core technician tasks which may include automation; less complex Commercial work (CB); +/- Fiber to the Home (FTTH).

Responsibilities

  • Supervisor installation, service and network job responsibilities and duties included.

  • Assist manager with training of technicians and other related field personnel.

  • Resolve customer problems and concerns.

  • Ensure timely completion of all orders for technical staff or service and proper notification procedures for delays in service.

  • Perform preventative maintenance when necessary.

  • Hire, train, and evaluate assigned staff.

  • Monitors WFX, Stratusync, iGlass throughout the day for information regarding changes to work schedule and for information about current installation, service call or OneView tickets.

  • Ensure all assigned work, reports and requested data from technicians are completed.

  • Maintains company truck and other equipment per service requirements and safety guidelines.

  • Drives a company vehicle between office and/or home, warehouse, and work sites in a safe and courteous manner, and in accordance with all laws and company policies.

  • Monitors Workforce Express System (WFX) throughout the day for information regarding changes to work schedule and for information about current work.

  • Communicates with dispatch (via WFX, phone, etc.) for assistance, status on current or new service requests.

  • Consults with manager and other supervisors for advice and assistance as needed.

  • Complete daily, weekly, monthly or other reports as required.

  • Demonstrates experience with the following: managing ambiguity and autonomy amongst the team; flexibility to work in an unstructured environment; dealing effectively with uncertainty and change

  • Interacts with customers in a professional, courteous manner including when responding to escalations and repeated customer concerns.

  • Educates customers regarding their existing and new services and promotes other Breezeline services to customers.

  • Ensures the quality of services provided to end users meets or exceeds established industry and company performance standards and is compliant with all national, state and local laws and regulations.

  • Participates in team meetings as scheduled.

  • Attends job-related training that may include initial training, refresher training, product and service updates.

  • Works on regularly scheduled days as well as unscheduled days and beyond regular work hours due to customer or operational demands.

  • Complies with all safety procedures and policies, as well as the assigned staff.

  • Ability to work outdoors and in extreme weather conditions and varying topographic, wet and dry locations

title: Rates Analyst
description:
Determined, imaginative, curious—if these are some of the ways you describe yourself, we want to learn more about you!

At TC Energy, we are proud to connect the world to the energy it needs. Guided by our values of safety in every step, personal accountability, one team and active learning, we deliver the critical energy that North America and the world rely on while balancing reliability, affordability and sustainability.

The Opportunity

Our Calgary-based Rates & Services West team plays an integral role supporting TC Energy’s Commercial objectives. In this fast-paced position, you will gain knowledge of the Canada Gas Commercial business by assisting in the development and pricing of transportation services for our wholly-owned pipeline systems in western Canada.

We are seeking a motivated Rates Analyst with knowledge and experience in analytical and financial modeling. The successful candidate will also demonstrate the ability to build and maintain collaborative working relationships to achieve business results. This individual has the proven skills, competencies and capacity to learn the rate-regulated pipeline transmission business and commercial framework to help optimize our assets.

Reporting to the Manager, Rates & Services West, this position provides analytical and project support for transportation rate calculations, forecasting, and commercial and financial initiatives related to the NOVA Gas Transmission Ltd. (NGTL) and Foothills pipeline systems. Working collaboratively with team members and business partners, the role contributes to the achievement of Canada Gas Commercial objectives through data-driven insights and operational support.

What you’ll do

  • Become a subject matter expert in the Canada Gas regulated business model

  • Independently perform cost of service, rates calculations and service analysis

  • Develop and maintain toll design, cost of service and pipeline financial models

  • Support the overall Commercial team in optimization and competitiveness initiatives

  • Support the Rates team in the development of rate design and transportation services

  • Work closely with internal partners to understand project requests and/or analysis and to validate and refine modeling assumptions and results

  • Assist in the monthly maintenance of the Rates database, and develop analytics-based enhancements as required

  • Be a champion for continuous process improvement through the development & maintenance of analytics solutions, including data gathering, visualization and automation of recurring tasks

  • Prepare reports and present analysis (including assumptions, methodology, impacts and overall results) to senior leadership

  • Effectively operate in a growing and changing environment under tight deadlines

  • Provide support for regulatory filings and industry committee initiatives

  • Other tasks as required

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Economics, Commerce/Business or related field

  • Minimum 4 years of related and progressive industry/business experience

  • An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of revenue / cost modeling and economic evaluations

  • Demonstrated experience working with complex financial/economic models

  • Proficient in full suite of Microsoft Office products, with strong Microsoft Excel modeling abilities in particular. This includes the ability to manipulate large volumes of data, efficiently manage model enhancements for scenario analysis and effectively maintain and improve spreadsheet models relevant to the current business environment

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills including the ability to work effectively, both independently and in teams, and to develop and maintain collaborative working relationships

  • Knowledge of Power BI and management information systems to support the Rates database

  • Detail-oriented with strong time management, planning and organizational skills

  • Ability to handle multiple assignments on a timely basis, with a high degree of accuracy and confidentiality

  • Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem identification and solution recommendations

  • Experience using data, analytics, or AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency, consistency, or transparency of analysis (e.g. automation, data preparation and/or visualization, or research synthesis)

  • Familiarity with the regulated pipeline model, including regulatory processes and rate design concepts

  • Exposure to accounting concepts such as depreciation; and with an understanding of fundamental principles of finance and/or economics and their applications to business situations

To remain competitive, support our high-performance culture and allow for more flexibility in the way we work, we offer a hybrid work model and flexible dress code for our eligible office-based workforce in Canada, the U.S. and Mexico. #LI-Hybrid

About our business

We are a leader in North American energy infrastructure, spanning Canada, the U.S. and Mexico. Every day, our dedicated team proudly connects the world to the energy it needs—moving over 30 per cent of the cleaner-burning natural gas used across the continent. Complemented by strategic ownership and low-risk investments in power generation, our infrastructure fuels industries and generates affordable, reliable and sustainable power across North America, while enabling LNG exports to global markets.

The Company

At WTW, our advisors develop new solutions to help the aging global population achieve financial security in retirement. We invite you to join our Retirement consulting team, recognized for its ability to combine actuarial and investment expertise to support organizations around the world in optimizing the effectiveness of their employee retirement programs. Whether a client has a defined benefit pension or a defined contribution plan, we work with them to determine the right approach to designing, funding, investing, governing and employee management that fits their specific goals.

Our team also provides training to groups of pension plan participants on the importance of retirement planning, the key features of their plans, and the concept of financial independence.

The Role

As a consulting intern on the Retirement team, you will apply your communication, technical, and project management skills in various projects for different pension plans (registered and unregistered defined benefit pension plans and defined contribution pension plans). For example, during your internship, you may work on an actuarial valuation and be involved in investment and risk management projects. Teamwork is an integral part of the life here. You will participate on teams that aim to find and implement the best possible solutions for our clients.

In this role at WTW you will:

  • Serve as a key resource on client teams performing necessary calculations or actuarial analysis on a wide variety of retirement projects
  • Work in a dynamic and social environment by participating in daily meetings with colleagues from the Retirement team
  • Learn more about the day-to-day of a consultant by creating client presentations, assisting to the team preparation and potentially attending client meetings
  • Work with a variety of colleagues and clients gaining knowledge and exposure to different work styles
  • Learn about WTW career paths
  • Have robust learning and development opportunities including trainings, mentorship programs, and actuarial exam support
  • Build connection with colleagues through optional social activities

We trust our colleagues to work in a variety of settings. This role can be hybrid or onsite.

The Requirements

  • Progress towards a Bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, math or statistics and have a strong academic record (cumulative grade point average of 3.0 or over)
  • Progress/interest towards actuarial credentials (ACIA, FCIA and/or ASA, FSA) preferred
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in French and English
  • Aptitude to balance and prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced work environment
  • Microsoft Office skills, particularly in Excel

WTW serves a clientele with a national and international presence and must be able to offer services in French and English at all times. This position requires bilingualism, as the intern will need to provide services related to various communications exclusively in French or English, in addition to interacting with multiple stakeholders in Canada who speak only French or English.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Drive meaningful change

Are you ready to kick-start your career in Data Engineering? In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to develop your skills by working on designing, building, and scaling data pipelines and infrastructure in a modern, cloud-native environment. You’ll collaborate closely with experienced engineers, get hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies, and gradually take on more responsibility as you grow.

This is a great opportunity to learn how a modern data platform is built and operated in practice. You’ll work on real data challenges, contribute to our core platform, and play a role in shaping how data creates value across the company.

Get a glimpse of our world

We’re looking for a curious and ambitious Data Engineer who is excited about learning how data pipelines are built and run in practice. Beyond coding, you’re interested in understanding how things work, from tooling and architecture to reliability and scalability.

You’ll join a team responsible for the backbone of the data platform that analytics, BI, our AI and ML use cases depend on. We work with a modern data stack, collaborate closely across teams and tackle real-world data problems at scale.

You’ll have room to experiment, bring ideas forward, and actively influence the evolution of our cloud data platform as we grow. If shaping a modern data platform excites you, you’ll feel right at home here.

Are you ready to embark on this journey with us?

As a Data Engineer, you will:

  • Design, build, and own scalable batch and streaming data pipelines that power analytics, BI, and AI/ML use cases
  • Contribute to the development of our core data platform, gaining experience with architecture,, shared frameworks, and platform tooling
  • Collaborate closely with teams cross analytics, BI, AI, ML and engineering to deliver reliable and impactful data solutions
  • Build and maintain data ingestion pipelines, working with data from variety of internal and external sources
  • Support improvements in data reliability and trust through data quality checks, monitoring, alerting, and observability
  • Work across data integration, storage optimization, and performance tuning to support growth at scale
  • Support and improve cloud infrastructure for data workloads, including compute, storage, and access control
  • Monitor and troubleshoot, and resolve pipeline and platform issues using our observability and monitoring tools
  • Contribute to optimizing data storage and retrieval for performance and cost efficiency
  • Stay curious about emerging data engineering trends and apply modern best practices to continuously improve the platform
  • Share knowledge and contribute to best practices, supporting team growth and continuous improvement across the team

You will work hands-on with technologies such as:

  • Azure Databricks
  • Azure Data/Delta Lake
  • Python & PySpark
  • SQL
  • Azure DevOps
  • Monte Carlo (Data Observability)
  • Azure Data Factory
  • Git
  • …and more!

Fuel for your success in the role

You're motivated by building high-quality data services and enjoy working in a fast-moving, collaborative environment. You like solving complex problems, care about reliability, and are always curious about better ways to do things.

We’re looking for someone who brings:

  • A Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Solid experience working with Python for data processing and automation.
  • Comfort working with Git in a collaborative development workflow
  • Basic knowledge of SQL, including writing queries and performing data transformation tasks.
  • An interest in working with data, including preparing, cleaning, and validating datasets.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • A proactive, continuous-learning mindset
  • Good written and spoken skills in English

What makes this role interesting

  • You’ll work on the core data platform that power analytics and decision-making across the whole Abacus Medicine Group
  • Exposure to modern data stacks and real-world scale challenges
  • Opportunities to influence platform architecture decisions as you grow
  • Hands-on experience with automation, observability, and reliability at scale

It is an advantage if you have experience or interest in:

  • Cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • Azure Data / Delta Lake for efficient storage and processing of big data.
  • Streaming or event-driven architectures
  • Data governance, lineage, and access management
  • Apache Spark and Databricks
  • PySpark
  • Orchestration tools (Azure Data Factory, Airflow, etc)
  • Data modeling and transformation concepts
  • CI/CD practices.

Your future colleagues

In the Data, Analytics & AI (D&A) department, we deliver end-to-end capabilities across Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Advanced Analytics, and AI-driven automation. We are responsible for developing and operating Abacus’ enterprise data hub, including data management, orchestration, and self-service data and BI platforms. Our work spans predictive and prescriptive analytics using OR, ML, and AI, as well as applying AI to optimize workflows and enhance personal productivity across the organization.

The department consists of over 30 colleagues with diverse profiles, including Data Scientists, Data Engineers, BI Developers, Data Analysts, GenAI Engineers and AI Advisors.

Our team consists of individuals from diverse nationalities, expertise areas, educational backgrounds, and ownership responsibilities across our data platforms and services. This diversity creates a strong environment for collaboration, technical synergies, and support among units, all while maintaining a positive and motivating work environment.

In summary, our goal is to create innovative data-driven solutions for core business problems within a friendly and professional work setting.

Moving Healthcare. Moving You.

In Abacus Medicine Group, you’ll experience the power of Moving Healthcare. With our change mindset, we’re moving the industry and improving healthcare as we broaden access to medicine.

But it's not just about moving healthcare, it's about Moving You. You’ll be part of a caring community of more than 1,750 people across the World. With us, you will be valued, empowered, and have a direct impact on driving change. Let's access the future of medicine and make a difference together. Your move.

title: Senior Data and AI Engineer
description:
Senior Data and AI Engineer

Make Power for Good

RES is the world’s largest independent renewable energy company. Our mission is simple: a future where everyone has access to affordable, zero-carbon energy. The problems we’re solving are among the most important of our generation - and the people working on them are extraordinary.

We’re building a world-class global data platform and looking for a Senior Data and AI Engineer to help shape it. If you want to engineer things that matter - at scale, with the latest tooling - this is the role.

The Role

You’ll be at the heart of RES’s data platform - designing, building, and operating the platform, pipelines, infrastructure, and datasets that power enterprise reporting, analytics, and AI/ML across the business.

This is a senior hands-on engineering role combining deep technical execution with architectural decision-making. You’ll set data and AI engineering standards, driving automation and MLOps practice, and work across the full Azure Fabric data stack - from ingestion through to feature-ready datasets that enable analysts, data scientists and AI teams to do their best work. You’ll partner with architecture, governance, modelling, and analytics teams to deliver end-to-end data and AI engineering products.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and operate reliable, secure, and observable data pipelines and curated datasets that power enterprise reporting, analytics, and AI/ML use cases.
  • Own engineering quality, performance, and cost optimisation - implementing robust data quality controls, testing frameworks, monitoring, and observability across the platform.
  • Build and maintain production-grade data infrastructure on Azure / Microsoft Fabric, including data lakes, lakehouses, and modern data warehouse patterns.
  • Produce feature-ready datasets and optimised data products that enable data scientists, AI engineers, and analytics teams.
  • Lead AI/ML engineering use cases - applying engineering best practice to model pipelines, data preparation, and AI-ready dataset design at scale.
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging data and AI engineering tools and patterns; drive continuous improvement of RES’s data ecosystem.
  • Define and implement CI/CD pipelines for data engineering workflows; apply infrastructure-as-code and automated quality gates as standard practice.
  • Lead engineering automation to reduce manual effort, improve reliability, and accelerate time-to-insight.
  • Apply containerisation and orchestration tooling (e.g. Docker, Airflow, or equivalent) to production data workflows.
  • Drive architectural decisions and shape the direction of the data platform.
  • Partner across architecture, governance, data modelling, and reporting to deliver coherent, end-to-end data and AI products.
  • Mentor and support engineers; set the standard for quality, craft, and engineering rigour across the team.

What You’ll Bring

  • Azure Fabric data platform - deep expertise across Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Purview, Unity Catalogue, and Data Lake / Lakehouse architectures.
  • Python - advanced proficiency including open-source data libraries, frameworks, and production pipeline development.
  • SQL - expert-level for data modelling, transformation, and complex query optimisation.
  • AI/ML engineering - experience building data infrastructure for machine learning and AI use cases, including feature engineering and model pipeline support.
  • MLOps - CI/CD for data pipelines, infrastructure as code, containerisation, and orchestration tools such as Airflow or equivalent.
  • Data quality & observability - hands-on experience with testing frameworks, monitoring, and quality controls in production environments.
  • LLMs and generative AI - practical understanding of how to engineer data products and pipelines that support LLM and GenAI use cases.
  • Technical leadership - track record of engineering and architectural decision-making, setting engineering standards and delivering high quality, innovative and automated AI and data engineering work, leading strategy, roadmaps and future thinking.

Your Background Essential

Degree in computer science, data engineering, software engineering, or a related field - or equivalent hands-on experience.

Significant experience (typically 7+ years) delivering enterprise-grade data engineering solutions in production environments.

Proven track record as a Senior Data Engineer, including building large-scale data systems using modern approaches and making architectural decisions.

Deep expertise in the Microsoft Azure data ecosystem - ADF, Synapse, Fabric, Purview, Unity Catalogue.

Advanced Python skills including open-source data libraries, frameworks, and messaging systems.

Strong experience building and maintaining production data infrastructure for AI and ML consumption.

Experience with MLOps practices: CI/CD for data pipelines, automated testing, and infrastructure as code.

Experience with modern data stack tooling - dbt, Airflow, Prefect, or equivalent orchestration and transformation frameworks.

Experience with automation tooling such as Power Automate, Power Platform, or equivalent.

Relevant certifications in Microsoft Azure, data engineering, or AI/ML.

Exposure to working alongside data scientists and AI engineers in a shared platform model.

Why RES?

  • Engineer at scale - a genuinely global data platform with real complexity and ambition behind it.
  • A modern, cloud-first stack - Azure, Fabric, Synapse, and active investment in AI tooling.
  • Join a brand new, agile, global data and analytics team at the heart of AI, innovation, Next Gen technology and driving innovation for competitive advantage for RES.
  • You will have a diverse portfolio and be able to lead on many types of work, honing and developing strong skills in Artificial Intelligence to shape your future career at the forefront of the latest technologies.
  • A collaborative, cross-functional data function with architecture, AI, science, analytics, and engineering working closely together.
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and commitment to your professional development.

  • United Kingdom

Permanent Full Time

At RES, we celebrate differences as we know it makes our company a great place to work. Encouraging applicants with different backgrounds, ideas and points of view, we create teams who work together to solve complex problems and design practical solutions for our clients. Our multiple perspectives come from many sources including the diverse ethnicity, culture, gender, nationality, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, marital status, parental status, education, social background and life experience of our people.

title: Assistant Portfolio Controller
description:
Department: Accounting and Finance

Reports to: Director, Accounting

Location: Nashville, TN


This role will be performed onsite in the Nashville office.


Adventurous Journeys Capital Partners (“AJCP”) is seeking an Assistant Portfolio Controller to join the firm’s real estate investments and development accounting team and support its rapid growth across various investment platforms focused on the hospitality, mixed-use, and single-family rental sectors.


ABOUT AJCP

Adventurous Journeys ("AJCP") Capital Partners is a vertically integrated real estate investment manager founded in 2008. The firm repositions real estate to build timeless, scalable businesses and brand platforms. We deliver returns on transformative real estate by applying placemaking, inspired design, and hospitality principles to spaces overlooked or undervalued by traditional investment firms. The firm’s current portfolio includes $5.9 billion of assets across 100+ properties and 50+ geographic markets. With a mission to humanize hospitality through handcrafted projects made by people for people, AJCP delivers spaces that evoke emotional connections and become backdrops for enriching life experiences. Our headquarters are in Nashville, with offices in Chicago, London, and Miami. For more information on AJCP, please visit .


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Assistant Portfolio Controller will be responsible for the accurate and timely reporting of financial information for multiple real estate funds and joint ventures. This will include significant interaction with outside auditors, tax advisors, and fund administrators. The role will interface directly with a variety of groups within AJCP including Development, Asset Management, Capital Markets, Portfolio Management and Investor Relations.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

Fund Level Responsibilities

  • Assist in the monthly closing process, financial statement and quarterly investor statement preparation, and lender reporting packages for assigned real estate funds and/or joint ventures
  • Assist in the review of the calculation of management fees, distribution waterfalls, and carried interest Support cash management activities for your real estate funds and/or joint ventures, including working with the Portfolio Management, Capital Markets, Development, and Asset Management teams, as applicable, to process capital calls and distributions, forecast liquidity and estimated tax payments, manage payments for construction and other owner costs, coordinate loan draws and reserve account fundings, and optimize working capital needs across your assets
  • Support the preparation and review of quarterly investor account statements
  • Assist the Portfolio Management team in their process over fair market value calculations on the assets within assigned investment vehicles
  • Prepare workpapers and supporting documentation for the annual audit and tax reporting process with the audit and tax providers

Property Level Responsibilities

  • Develop a deep understanding of all significant agreements, including but not limited to entity operational agreements and side letters, debt agreements, development management, asset management, hotel management and restaurant management agreements, and applicable leases and insurance contracts; ensure the compliance with each of these agreements across your assets
  • Provide support to our outsourced providers who perform the property level accounting
  • Review monthly workbooks of the property level accountants
  • Work closely with development managers on status of project, budgets, and accounts payable to fully understand the project
  • Monitor development status to ensure proper capitalization of project costs and place in service dates Critically analyze invoice coding and payment, new vendor setup and booking of payment within books and records
  • Maintain monthly checklists to ensure all invoices are captured timely and accurately each month
  • Assist Capital Markets team in lender funding of projects, including review of development and construction contractor pay applications and ensure proper documentation has been obtained (e.g. lien releases), true-up of retainage accounts are made and ensure invoice payments are made timely based on funding received

Other Responsibilities

  • Manage/document business processes and accounting policies to maintain and strengthen internal controls
  • Perform any additional responsibilities that may be required to support AJCP’s rapid growth

Key Responsibilities
Systems Software Development:

  • Mentor engineers across teams, championing best practices in systems integration, reliability, and operational excellence.

Software Development and Coding:

  • Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; coaches engineers across teams or units to drive improvements.

  • Acts as a subject matter expert within the organization to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code.

  • Leads process, architecture, and code reviews across projects and/or products/services to drive improvements.

  • Utilizes modern/emerging technologies to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix highly complex software issues.

  • Leads strategic initiatives to optimize software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging.

  • Encourages innovation, research, and relevant industry practices to optimize performance across products and domains.

  • Resolves and may troubleshoot highly complex and systematic issues requiring innovation related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.

  • Implements innovative API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:

  • Leads task and project initiatives for the design and development of software, systems, and services. Defines project or design scope; reviews, influences, and approves scope and design recommendations.

  • Provides technical guidance, domain expertise, and coaching in software architecture decisions and best practices that drive key organizational decisions, including industry standards and competitive considerations, providing mentorship and coaching for small teams and peers and contributing to both individual and team development across line of business/function.

  • Utilizes innovative methods to conduct highly complex periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards.

  • Collaborates with stakeholders across lines of business and externally, to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities.

  • Implements innovative performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.

  • Conducts regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements and translates into decisions and plans that can have a major impact on the organization.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:

  • Collaborates with stakeholders internally and externally to lead efforts to understand customer issues, root causes, and mitigation to align and explain rationale behind solutions.

  • Must provide expert technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues to mitigate recurrence.

  • Acts as an advisor to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements and solutions based on feedback.

  • Networks across lines of business to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.

  • Guides implementation of strategic solutions for customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes.

  • Investigates and troubleshoots the most complex and broadly reaching product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements).

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:

  • Collaborates with the security team and leadership teams to establish, follow, and improve upon development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members.

  • Participates in peer review processes and provides technical leadership with initiatives to ensure quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development.

  • Demonstrates, contributes to, and shares deep expertise of industry best practices and their application to software development processes.

  • Implements highly complex secure software development practices/solutions requiring modern/emerging innovation to prevent security vulnerabilities, leveraging automated solutions to augment the manual review process.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:

  • Leads project initiatives for periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).

  • Acts as subject matter expert to drive improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:

  • Manages and provides direction on timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable for critical high-impact projects or initiatives that impact the line of business, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements.

  • Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

  • Influences cross-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives.

  • Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long-term organizational success.

  • Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Problem Solving:

  • Leads specialized, advanced problem-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for complex issues.

  • Guides others to leverage innovative data-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and drives the implementation of solutions that prevent future issues.

Continuous Learning:

  • Contributes to the advancement of the field or industry through thought leadership (e.g., conference presentations, white papers, research contributions).

  • Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices.

  • Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing, promoting professional development across teams.

  • Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals.

  • Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives.

"

title: Senior Backend Java Developer – Digital Health
description:
With close to 3,000 employees, we are one of the largest tech consulting companies in the Nordics. To put it simply, we help people create value in the complex landscape of digital transformation.
Twoday is the leading digital transformation partner in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 specialists, we collaborate with some of the most admired private and public organisations to deliver cutting-edge digital solutions. Our expertise spans software engineering, Data & AI, cloud platforms, digital experiences and business applications.

We are now looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to help transform a large-scale development and deployment platform from traditional DevOps into a modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering setup.

Permanent position at Twoday | Copenhagen

Senior Backend Java Developer - Digital Health

Digital Engineering | Copenhagen

Do you want to build and evolve business-critical digital solutions that support Denmark’s healthcare sector?

Twoday is looking for experienced Backend Java Developers to join a major, long-term digital health delivery in Copenhagen. You will work with complex systems where reliability, security, maintainability and technical quality are essential – and where the solutions you help build and operate have a direct impact on critical public services.

This is a permanent position with Twoday, where this delivery would, if we win the tender, become your first assignment as a consultant with us.

The role

The customer is introducing a new delivery model in which several suppliers will collaborate closely on the development, maintenance and operation of a portfolio of business-critical healthcare applications.

Rather than operating as separate supplier organisations, developers from different companies will work together in shared teams. This makes technical expertise essential, but it also requires engineers who collaborate well, share knowledge and take responsibility for the overall delivery – not just their own code.

As a Senior Backend Java Developer, you will work hands-on throughout the software delivery lifecycle: from analysis and refinement through design and development to testing, deployment, maintenance and troubleshooting in production.

You will be expected to contribute to building robust solutions and to take technical ownership in close collaboration with other developers, Solution Architects, testers, DevOps specialists and product stakeholders.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing, developing and maintaining backend services and server-side components
  • Developing APIs and integrations across a complex application landscape
  • Contributing to application design, data modelling and technical decision-making
  • Working with microservices, distributed systems and event-driven architectures
  • Designing for resilience, scalability, high availability and operational stability
  • Working with messaging technologies and asynchronous communication
  • Building and maintaining automated build, test and deployment pipelines
  • Contributing to containerised deployment and modern infrastructure practices
  • Implementing appropriate logging, monitoring and observability
  • Applying secure coding practices and considering security and privacy throughout the development lifecycle
  • Writing automated tests and contributing to high standards for code quality and documentation
  • Diagnosing and resolving issues across release and production environments
  • Contributing to backlog refinement and translating requirements into technically sound solutions
  • Sharing knowledge and collaborating across teams and suppliers

The formal backend role covers both development and operation of server-side components in Linux-based environments as well as version control and automated pipelines.

What we are looking for

You are an experienced, hands-on backend engineer with a strong foundation in Java and a track record of developing complex, business-critical software.

You are comfortable looking beyond an individual feature or service and understand how architecture, integration, data, security, deployment and operations come together in a production environment.

We are particularly interested in experience with several of the following:

  • Java and modern Java-based backend development
  • Backend and server-side software development in Linux environments
  • REST APIs and systems integration
  • Microservices and distributed systems
  • Messaging and event-driven architectures, such as Kafka or comparable technologies
  • SQL, data modelling and transactional systems
  • Domain-driven design and modern software architecture principles
  • Docker, Kubernetes and containerized workloads
  • CI/CD and automated delivery pipelines
  • Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Automated testing and quality engineering
  • Observability, monitoring and production troubleshooting
  • Authentication, authorisation and secure software development
  • Resilience patterns and highly available systems
  • Agile software development

Experience from healthcare, Danish public-sector IT or other complex and regulated environments is a strong advantage.

Healthcare knowledge is not a prerequisite for every position on the team, but relevant experience from the healthcare domain will be particularly valuable.

Who you are

You are still close to the technology and enjoy solving difficult engineering problems.

You take ownership of your work from understanding the problem to seeing the solution perform reliably in production. At the same time, you recognise that seniority is not only about technical depth. You contribute constructively to technical discussions, challenge solutions when needed, support colleagues and help the team make sound engineering decisions.

The delivery will involve close collaboration across organisational boundaries, so you should be comfortable working transparently with colleagues from different companies and contributing to a shared engineering culture.

You must be fluent in spoken and written Danish and English.

The role is based in Copenhagen and requires a significant degree of onsite work at the customer.

Join Twoday

At Twoday, you will join a strong professional technology environment with colleagues working across software engineering, architecture, cloud, data and digital transformation.

This is a permanent position with Twoday, where this delivery would, if we win the tender, become your first assignment as a consultant with us. Your employment is with Twoday and is not limited to this particular customer or project.

For the right developer, this is an opportunity to combine deep backend engineering with a long-term assignment in an important and technically complex area of Danish digital infrastructure.

We look forward to hearing from you.

About Twoday

Twoday operates from modern offices across 30 locations in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and Lithuania. We have a strong and unique social environment with highly engaged employees. If you are the candidate we are looking for, you will play a central role with exciting opportunities to grow within an international and innovative group, working on cutting-edge technology and software solutions. You will also have the flexibility to occasionally work from one of our main offices in Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki or Vilnius.

Diversity & inclusion

Do you not meet all the requirements? Studies show that women and minorities are less likely to apply for a job if they don’t meet every qualification. At Twoday, we are committed to building a workplace and community where everyone is welcome. If you are excited about this role but your previous experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we still encourage you to apply.

title: Product Quality Engineer
description:
Product Quality Engineer

At Koenigsegg, quality is engineered from the start. As a Product Quality Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of Engineering, Production, and Suppliers to solve complex technical challenges and help deliver some of the world's most advanced Megacars.

What you'll do

  • Lead complex quality investigations using methodologies such as 8D, DMAIC, A3, 5 Why, Fishbone, and Root Cause Analysis.
  • Drive resolution of issues related to product design, manufacturing, assembly, suppliers, materials, and process variation.
  • Coordinate containment, corrective, and preventive actions while ensuring robust verification of implemented solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with Design Engineering to improve product robustness, manufacturability, and reliability.
  • Support production teams with hands-on problem solving on the shop floor.
  • Contribute to product development through DFMEA, PFMEA, APQP, design reviews, and risk assessments.
  • Drive continuous improvement and maintain quality documentation, standards, and compliance with automotive quality requirements.

Who you are

You are an analytical, hands-on engineer with a passion for solving complex problems. You take ownership, challenge existing ways of working, and collaborate effectively across functions in a fast-paced environment.

We believe you have

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Automotive, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience in automotive or manufacturing quality.
  • Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, GD&T, metrology, DFMEA/PFMEA, APQP/PPAP, and Lean Manufacturing.
  • Experience with ERP/MES/QMS systems and supplier quality is an advantage.
  • Experience in root cause analysis, using structured quality methodologies to resolve product design, manufacturing, assembly, and human relation deviations.
  • Experience working and leading cross-functional teams - solving complex manufacturing issues.

Experience from high-performance automotive, motorsport, aerospace, or low-volume manufacturing is highly valued. Experience with composites, EV technologies, prototype builds, or launch quality is considered a plus.

Koenigsegg is most known for building some of the fastest cars in the world; with almost all of our megacar technologies that are patented and made in-house by our almost 750 world-class technicians, engineers, sourcing experts, production craftsmen, and communicators.

What we’ve created is a unique proving ground of engineering creativity that makes use of our breakthrough megacar development and legacy to push the boundaries of sustainable mobility technology.

So, what’s next?

We are on a universe-denting mission to develop the next generation of breakthrough tech and products. We are looking for outstanding, impactful, and authentic individuals to grow with us. Our ambitions are inspiring but will push the limits of what is possible – requiring one to work efficiently amid our cross-functional teams to execute at high-quality levels.

The goal is clear: innovate and transform.

title: Operador CNC

Correct hazards within your control and capabilities. Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact. Engage in HSE Training. Follows all process documentation and quality procedures. Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures. Performs quality inspections. Delivery Ability to run all tool room equipment including Computer Numerical Controlled (CNC) machines, lathes, grinders, milling machines, drill presses and shapers. Ability to use measuring devices, layout work and set up of tool room machines to build or fabricate details and assemble as needed. Repairs and maintains manufacturing equipment . Performs and documents preventive, emergency, corrective and predictive maintenance activities. Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning tasks. Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

An AI‑first mindset with a passion for modern engineering practices, continuous improvement, and automation.

title: AIML - Senior Operations Program Manager - Responsible AI and Safety
description:
At Apple, we don't just build products — we build experiences fueled by world-class data. The Responsible AI team is looking for a senior operations program manager to own the partnerships, vendor relationships, and data operations behind our Safety Evaluation and Red Teaming programs, scaling the human-labeled data, workforce, and localizationinfrastructure that generative AI features across our Software ecosystem.

In this role, you will manage Apple's relationship with internal crowd as well as a portfolio of external vendorpartners spanning evaluation, red-teaming, and data generation. You will own how this work gets resourced, scoped, and executed — from statements of work and workforce calibration to quality audits and ongoing partner performance — ensuring these partnerships can scale reliably as safety evaluation needs grow across products, features, and markets.You will also own the feedback loop and establish the processes that connect Red-Teaming, Evaluation, and Post-Ship Insights groups. Findings surfaced through red-teaming and evaluation need to inform what we monitor once features ship, and post-ship signals need to flow back into how we prioritize and design future red-teaming and evaluation coverage. You will build and operate the mechanisms — shared reporting, recurring syncs, and closed-loop tracking — that keep these three functional areas working from a single, current picture of risk rather than in isolation. Ensuring compliant and timely reporting across Apple Intelligence features is a key element of this role.You will shape the tools and infrastructure roadmap needed to power these functions. This includes maintaining clear, current documentation of processes, systems, and data flows across these functional areas, and identifying and prioritizing the tooling and infrastructure investments needed to support them as they scale — partnering with engineering and technical stakeholders to translate operational needs into build requirements.Lastly, you will also drive the operational scaling of our data infrastructure: how we manage, store, and govern the human-labeled goldsets that underpin safety benchmarking and LLM-judge validation, and how those pipelines extend to new languages, markets, and cultural contexts.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field5+ years of experience in vendor/partner management, data operations, or program management, ideally supporting ML/AI evaluation, annotation, or data labeling programs
  • Demonstrated experience managing external vendor relationships and/or internal annotation operations partnerships at scale, including statements of work, budget, and performance management
  • Experience scaling human-labeled data pipelines, including dataset creation, quality calibration, storage, and governance
  • Experience standing up or scaling operations across multiple international markets, including working with multilingual and multicultural vendor workforces
  • Experience coordinating across functionally distinct but interdependent teams to close feedback loops and keep shared priorities aligned
  • Experience owning documentation and translating operational needs into tooling or infrastructure roadmaps, partnering with engineering to scope and prioritize build work
  • Strong ability to think strategically about operational tradeoffs while managing multiple concurrent initiatives in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Proven track record managing budgets and vendor relationships at scale
  • Proficiency with data tools (e.g., SQL, spreadsheets/BI tools) sufficient to track vendor performance, cost, and data quality metrics
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to translate operational risk and status for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing vendor or annotation partnerships specifically for AI safety evaluation, red-teaming, or Responsible AI programs
  • Familiarity with goldset design, labeling guidelines, or LLM-judge/evaluation workflows sufficient to partner effectively with technical teams
  • Experience building internationalization or localization operations for data labeling or evaluation programs
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to AI safety and content risk across international markets
  • Demonstrated success building operations or vendor programs from the ground up, including establishing new processes or partner relationships
  • Executive presence and experience presenting operational risk assessments and scaling plans to senior leadership

title: Authorization Specialist
description:
Authorization Specialist

Plymouth Physical Therapy Specialists is seeking a detail-oriented and organized Authorization Specialist to join our team. This position is responsible for obtaining and managing insurance authorizations across multiple clinic locations and all insurance types, helping ensure our patients receive timely access to care while supporting accurate and efficient clinic operations.

Responsibilities

  • Obtain, verify, and maintain insurance authorizations for physical therapy services across multiple locations.
  • Manage authorization requirements for a wide range of insurance plans, including commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, workers’ compensation, and other payers.

  • Help ensure compliance with insurance guidelines and company procedures.

  • Previous experience with insurance authorizations, medical billing, insurance verification, or healthcare administration preferred.
  • Strong understanding of insurance benefits and authorization processes.
  • Experience working with multiple insurance carriers and payer portals.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple locations, patients, payers, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a multi-location team.
  • Proficiency with computers and electronic medical record systems.
  • Physical therapy, medical office, or rehabilitation experience is a plus.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who is organized, proactive, dependable, and comfortable navigating the complexities of insurance authorization requirements. You should be able to prioritize a high volume of requests while maintaining accuracy and excellent communication with both insurance companies and our clinical teams.

Join Plymouth Physical Therapy Specialists and play an important role in helping our patients receive the care they need—when they need it.

  • Competitive pay and growth opportunities

Join the Linear and Non-Linear Optics (LNO) Section within CERN's Accelerator and Beam Physics (ABP) Group and help shape the future of the High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider (HL-LHC). Your work will play a key role in ensuring the safe, reliable, and high-performance operation of the HL-LHC, contributing directly to the successful delivery of its novel physics programme.

Your Responsibilities

  • Maintain and extend the core OMC framework and toolset used during LHC commissioning and operation.
  • Explore software solutions to improve the efficiency and capability of optics measurement and corrections in the LHC.
  • Update accelerator model creation and correction algorithms to utilise new simulation tools.
  • Explore the viability of automation for key measurement and analysis workflows, implementing solutions where possible.
  • Develop new GUIs and analysis tools to be used in the CERN Control Centre during optics commissioning.
  • Participate in, and contribute to the analysis of, optics measurements in the CERN accelerators.

Your profile

  • Background in programming and software design, with experience in Python.
  • Familiarity with version control systems and collaborative workflows (Github).
  • Experience of GUI development.
  • Knowledge of particle accelerator physics and operation would be an advantage.

Skills

  • Software development. in Python.
  • GUI development
  • Ability to test, diagnose and optimise existing software.
  • Structured approach towards work, good prioritisation skills to deliver results on required time-lines.
  • Ability and willingness to share knowledge and participate in knowledge transfer activities.
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills.
  • Interest in developing and maintaining software solutions for applied physics, particularly the field of accelerator physics.
  • Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Eligibility Criteria

  • You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
  • You have a professional background in Physics, Software Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
    • a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;
    • or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.
  • You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Additional Information

Job closing date: 30.09.2026 at 23:59 CEST.

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Job flexibility: Hybrid

Target start date: 01-January-2027

This Position Involves

  • Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Job reference: BE-ABP-LNO-2026-132-GRAP

Field of work: Applied Physics

Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

  • A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.
  • 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
  • Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
  • Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
  • A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
  • Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
  • On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!

title: VP, F&B Asset Management
description:
Department: Asset Management

Reports to: SVP, Asset Management

Location: Chicago, IL or Nashville, TN


This role will be performed onsite in the Chicago or Nashville office and requires property-side travel that can exceed 50% during opening and transition windows. Remote work considered for the right candidate outside these markets.


Adventurous Journeys Capital Partners (“AJCP”) is seeking a Vice President, F&B Asset Management to lead food and beverage as a portfolio discipline across its hospitality assets, including operator relationships, opening and transition execution, reconcept oversight, and ongoing F&B performance management across Graduate Hotels, independent properties, and joint venture restaurants.


ABOUT AJCP

Adventurous Journeys (“AJCP”) Capital Partners is a vertically integrated real estate investment manager founded in 2008. The firm repositions real estate to build timeless, scalable businesses and brand platforms. We deliver returns on transformative real estate by applying placemaking, inspired design, and hospitality principles to spaces overlooked or undervalued by traditional investment firms. The firm’s current portfolio includes $5.9 billion of assets across 100+ properties and 50+ geographic markets. With a mission to humanize hospitality through handcrafted projects made by people for people, AJCP delivers spaces that evoke emotional connections and become backdrops for enriching life experiences. Our headquarters are in Nashville, with offices in Chicago, London, and Miami. For more information on AJCP, please visit www.ajcpt.com.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Vice President, F&B Asset Management will own food and beverage as a portfolio discipline across AJCP’s hospitality assets. You’ll lead opening and transition execution, reconcept design, and ongoing F&B performance management. You’ll work directly with third-party restaurant operators as a peer counterparty representing ownership interests. AJCP has seven distinct third-party restaurant operating groups, along with outlets run by the properties’ hotel management companies. Expect operator transitions, handoffs, and new relationships as the portfolio evolves.

This is a strategic, principal-side role, close to the operators and the assets. You’ll be on-property during opening windows, transition periods, and post-opening refinement phases. As the portfolio evolves, this role will partner with senior AJCP leadership on F&B-related capital decisions, brand and concept strategy, and the integration of restaurant outlets within our lifestyle hospitality platform.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

Operator & Hotel Manager Relationships

  • Serve as ownership’s primary point of contact with restaurant operators across the portfolio.
  • Engage hotel management companies as F&B counterparties where outlets are hotel-operated, covering performance oversight, reconcept participation, and interim operating support during transitions.
  • Participate in commercial negotiations on lease terms, management agreements, joint venture structures, and operator handoffs.
  • Build and maintain operator relationships beyond the current roster to support future portfolio activity.
  • Hold operators accountable for opening readiness, performance commitments, and contractual obligations.

Openings & Transitions

  • Lead opening execution for new F&B concepts across the portfolio.
  • Manage operator transitions. Ensure operators meet critical deadlines. Provide insight on operational efficiencies throughout the transition.
  • Provide post-opening refinement and stabilization oversight.

Reconcept & Capital Strategy

  • Identify reconcept opportunities and develop investment cases for capital allocation.
  • Partner with hotel management companies on F&B renovation and reconcept execution where outlets operate under the hotel management agreement, including scope definition, construction phasing, interim operating plans, staffing ramp, and reopening readiness.
  • Review and challenge opening pro formas, reconcept budgets, and transition expense estimates.
  • Partner with Investments, Asset Management, and internal design and construction teams on F&B input into acquisitions, dispositions, and major capital projects.

Performance Oversight

  • Review F&B P&L performance across the portfolio; identify variance drivers and corrective actions.
  • Establish F&B benchmarking, KPIs, and reporting standards in coordination with Hospitality Finance.
  • Partner with operator leadership on performance improvement plans.

Strategic & Cross-Functional

  • Develop and maintain AJCP’s F&B strategy framework across brands and concepts.
  • Represent F&B in portfolio-level discussions with the senior leadership team.
  • Participate in and influence F&B concept direction across the Marine & Lawn Hotel collection, including concept development, outlet positioning, and reconcept input, working alongside the brand’s senior leadership. This is consultative influence rather than day-to-day operational oversight.
  • Provide F&B input into underwriting and due diligence for prospective acquisitions.
  • Partner closely with operations-side Asset Management leadership and build bridges across departments (operations, finance, design, marketing, and external operators) to ensure F&B execution is integrated with whole-property objectives.

At GoEngineer, we understand that our value comes from our employees, and we celebrate and respect their unique experiences. We are working to build a culture where both our employees and customers are centered in the work we do, and employees feel welcomed as they are from the first day.


Generous Benefits Include:

description:

Comprehensive Life Resources is looking for a qualified Shift Supervisor to join our Adult Residential Treatment Program in Tacoma Washington.

Scope:

Park Place Residential Center provides individual treatment and recovery services for adults with serious mental illness and who are in need of daily supportive services.

Park Place’s services include therapy, psychiatry, counseling groups, case management, peer support, transitional living services, independent living development, substance use support services, and community and life skill building.

Shift Supervisors are responsible for supervision and scheduling Residential Counselors and oversees the after-hours functioning of a 70-bed residential treatment facility. Residential counselors provide residential services to adults with serious mental illness. They facilitate the community adjustment of clients at high risk for institutionalization.

Responsibilities:

  8. Establish and maintain a therapeutic relationship with residents.

  10. Ensure the completion of all necessary documentation by the end of the shift.
  11. Actively participate in program meetings and activities as required.
  12. Ensure that employees maintain ethical and professional standards of practice.
  13. Provide services and activities for residential consumers that enhance self-care skills, independence, social skills, and self-reliance.
  14. Assist residential counselors to understand job duties and expectations.
  15. Train team members to complete assigned tasks.
  16. Remind team members to complete time sheets, incident reports, daily progress notes, and other assigned documentation.
  17. May be required to work evenings and/or weekends depending upon program needs.

Competencies:

  • Ability to work harmoniously with others.

  • Demonstrates appropriate boundaries and values.

  • Demonstrate empathy, hopefulness, and resourcefulness, in communicating with others.

  • Build trusted working relationships with consultants, managers, directors, and engagement leaders.

  • Partner with consulting professionals to understand scheduling preferences and career development interests while balancing business needs.

Collaboration

title: Node.js Developer/ Technical Account Manager for CPG brands in LATAM
description:
Position Overview

Join Veryfi as a Node.js Developer & Technical Account Manager (LATAM) and play a critical role in building, deploying, and supporting WhatsApp-based loyalty and promotional campaigns for leading CPG brands across Latin America.

This hybrid role combines hands-on backend development, customer-facing technical ownership, and campaign operations. You will design and build WhatsApp bots using Node.js, integrate with Veryfi’s OCR & data extraction APIs, and act as the technical lead for campaigns—from kickoff to post-campaign reporting.

You’ll work directly with brands, agencies, and internal teams to ensure campaigns launch smoothly, scale reliably, and deliver measurable business results.

Key Responsibilities

WhatsApp Bot Development (Node.js)

  • Bot Architecture & Development: Design, build, and maintain WhatsApp bots using Node.js for loyalty programs, promotions, and automated customer journeys
  • API Integrations: Integrate WhatsApp bots with Veryfi APIs (OCR, Lens, document processing), databases, CRM tools, and third-party services
  • Campaign Logic: Implement business rules for points accumulation, rewards redemption, fraud prevention, validations, and user segmentation
  • Scalable Backend Services: Build reliable, scalable backend services using Node.js, REST APIs, webhooks, and event-driven flows
  • Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices

Loyalty Campaign Execution (End-to-End)

  • Campaign Build-Out: Translate campaign mechanics into technical flows (receipt validation, product matching, points, rewards, rankings)
  • Go-Live Ownership: Own technical readiness for launches, including testing, validations, and production deployment
  • Fraud & Edge Cases: Implement safeguards against fraud, duplicate submissions, and abuse scenarios
  • Post-Launch Support: Monitor campaign performance, fix issues quickly, and iterate based on real user behavior
  • Reporting Support: Assist with technical reporting, data extraction, and campaign performance insights

Technical Account Management (LATAM)

  • Client Technical Lead: Act as the main technical point of contact for LATAM clients during onboarding and active campaigns
  • Solution Design: Advise customers on best technical approaches for their loyalty and promotional use cases
  • Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot production issues, API errors, WhatsApp flow problems, and data discrepancies
  • Clear Communication: Explain technical concepts in simple terms to non-technical stakeholders
  • Escalation Handling: Coordinate with internal engineering, product, and support teams when deeper intervention is needed

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Cross-Functional Work: Collaborate with Product, Sales, Support, and Marketing teams to improve campaign delivery
  • Process Improvement: Identify patterns and suggest improvements to campaign templates, bot flows, and backend architecture
  • Documentation: Create and maintain technical documentation for bots, integrations, and campaign flows
  • Product Feedback: Share real-world client feedback with product and engineering teams

Requirements

Experience & Background

  • 3+ years of experience as a Node.js / Backend Developer
  • Experience building chatbots, messaging platforms, or automation systems (WhatsApp preferred)
  • Startup or fast-paced environment experience strongly preferred
  • Experience working with LATAM customers or regional campaigns is a big plus

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in Node.js (ESM preferred)
  • Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, async flows, and background jobs
  • Familiarity with WhatsApp Cloud API or similar messaging APIs
  • Experience with databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar)
  • Understanding of authentication, security, and API best practices
  • Experience supporting production systems and live campaigns

Core Competencies

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication (Spanish required, English strongly preferred)
  • Customer-oriented mindset with the ability to balance engineering and client needs
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously
  • Ownership mentality — you build it, you support it, you improve it

Performance Standards

  • Successfully launch and support WhatsApp loyalty campaigns on schedule
  • Maintain high campaign stability and low incident rates
  • Resolve technical issues efficiently with minimal customer impact
  • Deliver clean, maintainable, and scalable Node.js code
  • Achieve high customer satisfaction from LATAM clients

Specialization Areas

  • Primary Focus: WhatsApp Bots, Loyalty Programs, and Promotional Campaigns for CPG brands
  • Secondary Focus: Technical Account Management and client-facing solution design

Growth Opportunities

This role offers a unique opportunity to become a subject matter expert in WhatsApp-based loyalty programs, CPG campaign execution, and Veryfi’s OCR and automation platform.

As Veryfi continues to scale across LATAM and globally, you’ll have:

  • Direct exposure to large regional brands and complex campaigns
  • Access to leadership and influence over product direction
  • Clear paths toward Technical Lead, or Solutions Architect roles
  • Exceptional performance - measured by campaign success, client satisfaction, and technical impact - will be a key factor in raises and promotions.

Why Join Veryfi?

  • High Impact Role: Build real products used by millions of consumers across LATAM
  • Y Combinator-Backed: Be part of a world-class startup ecosystem
  • Hybrid Engineering Role: Code, launch, support, and own real business outcomes
  • Fast Growth: Join at a stage where your work directly shapes the platform
  • Learning Environment: Work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers

The AI Operating System for Private Capital.

Capsa AI

Private capital funds have to find potential investments, research and analyse them thoroughly, monitor them over time, drive improvements, and decide when to buy and sell. They've got to see through the marketing. They've got to outbid the competition. And they've got to learn from every deal they do. Historically, these processes have run on people, we are building the AI Operating System that will run them in the future.

Own product features and take them from ideation to production and measure the impact. Work across all layers of the application to deliver value for our customers. Uphold the quality of our codebase and find ways to move faster.

  • Ownership: You'll own whole surfaces of the product end to end, not slices of someone else's design. You'll make the architecture calls, ship them, and operate them.

  • Document Authoring: Agent tooling and a document editor supporting advanced collaborative authoring across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and email.

Your track record

  • You’ve worked in a high performance environment. Four or more years building production software at a venture-backed startup or top tech firm, owning features end-to-end, not just one layer.

Project Expeditor

The Project Expeditor is responsible for managing and coordinating the project planning process to support successful proposal development and submission activities. This role serves as a central point of coordination across business development, pricing, contracts, technical contributors, and program stakeholders to ensure proposal efforts remain aligned with established schedules and delivery requirements. The position provides oversight of proposal execution activities, tracks progress against key milestones, and supports the review and validation of proposal content prior to submission. Working within a dynamic proposal environment, the Proposal Expeditor ensures standardized processes, templates, and workflows are effectively utilized throughout the proposal lifecycle.
