title: Senior Backend Java Developer – Digital Health
description:
Twoday is the leading digital transformation partner in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 specialists, we collaborate with some of the most admired private and public organisations to deliver cutting-edge digital solutions. Our expertise spans software engineering, Data & AI, cloud platforms, digital experiences and business applications.

We are now looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to help transform a large-scale development and deployment platform from traditional DevOps into a modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering setup.

Permanent position at Twoday | Copenhagen

Senior Backend Java Developer – Digital Health

Digital Engineering | Copenhagen

Do you want to build and evolve business-critical digital solutions that support Denmark’s healthcare sector?

Twoday is looking for experienced Backend Java Developers to join a major, long-term digital health delivery in Copenhagen. You will work with complex systems where reliability, security, maintainability and technical quality are essential – and where the solutions you help build and operate have a direct impact on critical public services.

This is a permanent position with Twoday, where this delivery would, if we win the tender, become your first assignment as a consultant with us.

The role

The customer is introducing a new delivery model in which several suppliers will collaborate closely on the development, maintenance and operation of a portfolio of business-critical healthcare applications.

Rather than operating as separate supplier organisations, developers from different companies will work together in shared teams. This makes technical expertise essential, but it also requires engineers who collaborate well, share knowledge and take responsibility for the overall delivery – not just their own code.

As a Senior Backend Java Developer, you will work hands-on throughout the software delivery lifecycle: from analysis and refinement through design and development to testing, deployment, maintenance and troubleshooting in production.

You will be expected to contribute to building robust solutions and to take technical ownership in close collaboration with other developers, Solution Architects, testers, DevOps specialists and product stakeholders.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing, developing and maintaining backend services and server-side components
  • Developing APIs and integrations across a complex application landscape
  • Contributing to application design, data modelling and technical decision-making
  • Working with microservices, distributed systems and event-driven architectures
  • Designing for resilience, scalability, high availability and operational stability
  • Working with messaging technologies and asynchronous communication
  • Building and maintaining automated build, test and deployment pipelines
  • Contributing to containerised deployment and modern infrastructure practices
  • Implementing appropriate logging, monitoring and observability
  • Applying secure coding practices and considering security and privacy throughout the development lifecycle
  • Writing automated tests and contributing to high standards for code quality and documentation
  • Diagnosing and resolving issues across release and production environments
  • Contributing to backlog refinement and translating requirements into technically sound solutions
  • Sharing knowledge and collaborating across teams and suppliers

The formal backend role covers both development and operation of server-side components in Linux-based environments as well as version control and automated pipelines.

What we are looking for

You are an experienced, hands-on backend engineer with a strong foundation in Java and a track record of developing complex, business-critical software.

You are comfortable looking beyond an individual feature or service and understand how architecture, integration, data, security, deployment and operations come together in a production environment.

We are particularly interested in experience with several of the following:

  • Java and modern Java-based backend development
  • Backend and server-side software development in Linux environments
  • REST APIs and systems integration
  • Microservices and distributed systems
  • Messaging and event-driven architectures, such as Kafka or comparable technologies
  • SQL, data modelling and transactional systems
  • Domain-driven design and modern software architecture principles
  • Docker, Kubernetes and containerised workloads
  • CI/CD and automated delivery pipelines
  • Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Automated testing and quality engineering
  • Observability, monitoring and production troubleshooting
  • Authentication, authorisation and secure software development
  • Resilience patterns and highly available systems
  • Agile software development

Experience from healthcare, Danish public-sector IT or other complex and regulated environments is a strong advantage.

Healthcare knowledge is not a prerequisite for every position on the team, but relevant experience from the healthcare domain will be particularly valuable.

Who you are

You are still close to the technology and enjoy solving difficult engineering problems.

You take ownership of your work from understanding the problem to seeing the solution perform reliably in production. At the same time, you recognise that seniority is not only about technical depth. You contribute constructively to technical discussions, challenge solutions when needed, support colleagues and help the team make sound engineering decisions.

The delivery will involve close collaboration across organisational boundaries, so you should be comfortable working transparently with colleagues from different companies and contributing to a shared engineering culture.

You must be fluent in spoken and written Danish and English.

The role is based in Copenhagen and requires a significant degree of onsite work at the customer.

Join Twoday

At Twoday, you will join a strong professional technology environment with colleagues working across software engineering, architecture, cloud, data and digital transformation.

This is a permanent position with Twoday, where this delivery would, if we win the tender, become your first assignment as a consultant with us. Your employment is with Twoday and is not limited to this particular customer or project.

For the right developer, this is an opportunity to combine deep backend engineering with a long-term assignment in an important and technically complex area of Danish digital infrastructure.

We look forward to hearing from you.

About Twoday

Twoday operates from modern offices across 30 locations in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and Lithuania. We have a strong and unique social environment with highly engaged employees. If you are the candidate we are looking for, you will play a central role with exciting opportunities to grow within an international and innovative group, working on cutting-edge technology and software solutions. You will also have the flexibility to occasionally work from one of our main offices in Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki or Vilnius.

Diversity & inclusion

Do you not meet all the requirements? Studies show that women and minorities are less likely to apply for a job if they don’t meet every qualification. At Twoday, we are committed to building a workplace and community where everyone is welcome. If you are excited about this role but your previous experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we still encourage you to apply.

title: Director of Finance
description:
AGENCY OVERVIEW:

Jewish Family and Children's Services (JFCS) has served the San Francisco Bay Area for 175 years. We offer world-class services to support individuals and families across all stages of life, including adoption, mental health, senior care, disability services, financial assistance, Holocaust education, and youth development. Our mission and work are rooted in Jewish values, and we serve people of all faiths and backgrounds.


POSITION SUMMARY:

Under the supervision of the Chief Financial Officer, the Director of Finance is responsible for assisting in the planning, organizing, and directing of the financial operations, information systems, compliance program, and overall fiscal management of assigned divisions of the Agency to enable JFCS to achieve its operational and strategic goals and initiatives in accordance with legal and regulatory requirements. This position will be highly visible within the Agency and will serve as an advisor to the CFO regarding the successful financial management and compliance activities of the Agency.


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

  • Salary Range: $200,000 - $225,000 (depending on experience)
  • Employment Type: full-time, exempt position with benefits
  • Employer 403(b) retirement match plus additional employer contribution (subject to eligibility)
  • Cafeteria benefits plan that lets you customize coverage to fit your needs, with options like health insurance, FSAs, retirement plans, and wellness programs
  • 16 holidays (10 federal and up to 6 Jewish holidays), annually
  • 3 weeks of vacation and 2 weeks of sick leave, annually

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Works with the CFO to develop financial goals and objectives for the organization and its individual programs and proactively helps manage, plan, and organize the financial operations of assigned areas of the organization, including financial planning, budgeting, financial analysis, accounting controls and procedures, risk management, treasury, compliance, resource allocation, and revenue cycle functions
  • Serves as the finance lead for the Agency’s Seniors At Home (SAH) and Rhoda Goldman Plaza (RGP) divisions, with combined annual revenue of ~$40M, nearly half of the total organizational revenue. This role will provide budgeting, planning, business operations, and financial guidance to the executives and program managers of these divisions
  • Works with leadership of various departments to develop and implement financial plans, benchmarks, and budgetary performance metrics to help monitor progress toward financial and strategic goals
  • Provides leadership in the development and implementation of an agency-wide Compliance Program, including policies and procedures, process improvement projects related to program contracts, and oversight of quality assurance functions
  • Formulates and directs internal compliance audit and monitoring activities; proactively identifies and resolves potential issues of non-compliance; and provides compliance updates to Executive Leadership, the Audit Committee, and the Board of Directors
  • Assists in developing, interpreting, coordinating, and communicating organizational policies on finance, accounting, budgeting, insurance, internal controls, compliance, and auditing
  • Establishes clear performance goals and expectations, drives shared accountability, and invests in staff development to strengthen team performance and succession planning


JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or related field required; MBA is a plus
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant financial and business operations experience, at least 5 of which are with a non-profit organization
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in compliance activities within a multidisciplinary agency. Ideally includes experience in implementing compliance programs in a non-profit agency
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in budgeting, planning, and financial analysis within a $25+ million multi-departmental entity
  • 5+ years leadership experience including supervision of multiple employees
  • Demonstrated knowledge of GAAP, particularly as it applies to non-profit organizations
  • Experience in conducting or responding to government or third-party audits and investigations
  • Intermediate to advanced skills with Microsoft Office 365 suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams) and familiarity with general ledger (Intacct) and budgeting (Adaptive) software applications
  • Ability to travel to all regions served by JFCS as needed to accomplish departmental and agency activities; If driving own vehicle, must have a valid CA Driver’s License and proof of automobile liability insurance

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, including minorities, women, veterans, and disabled individuals. Qualified applicants with arrest and/or conviction records will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with Federal, state and local laws, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran, or disability status. JFCS is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Billing and Collections
description:
Role Overview

Lofty is shifting its recovery model from a legacy one-month exit fee to recovering the full remaining contract value from churned customers. This change increases the total amount under collection by roughly 5x to 6x, with churned-customer contract value currently estimated at $300,000 to $400,000 per month.

The Collection Leader owns this area end-to-end and is directly accountable for the recovery rate of these assets — building the strategy, process, and outreach needed to collect against a materially larger and higher-stakes book than before.

Beyond direct collections impact, the Collection Leader also supports Customer Success Managers during retention negotiations, giving them the leverage they need to improve system value for clients and drive better renewal outcomes.


Key Responsibilities

Recovery Strategy & Ownership

• Own the transition from the one-month exit fee model to full remaining-contract-value recovery

• Directly own and report on the recovery rate for churned-customer contract value (~$300K–$400K/month)

• Design and implement collection strategy, workflows, and prioritization for recovery of remaining contract value

• Build the process and tooling needed to scale collections activity 5x–6x as the model rolls out

Churned Account Recovery

• Manage collections outreach and negotiation directly with churned and high-risk accounts

• Segment and prioritize churned accounts based on recoverable contract value and risk

• Pursue recovery through appropriate channels — outreach, negotiated payment plans, escalation, or legal referral where necessary

• Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all recovery actions and outcomes

Retention Partnership

• Partner with Customer Success Managers during retention negotiations, providing collections leverage to support renewal outcomes

• Give CSMs account-level financial context — contract value and exposure — to strengthen retention conversations

• Align with CS leadership on when to pursue retention versus recovery for at-risk accounts

Reporting & Process Improvement

• Report recovery rate, aging, and pipeline of churned-account value to Finance and CS leadership

• Flag process gaps and recommend improvements as the model scales

• Adhere to internal controls, compliance requirements, and finance SOPs


What Success Looks Like

• Successfully transitions the recovery motion from the exit-fee model to full remaining-contract-value recovery

• Delivers a strong, improving recovery rate against the $300K–$400K/month churned-contract-value base

• Becomes a trusted partner to CSMs, strengthening retention negotiation outcomes

• Builds collection processes that can scale as recovery volume grows

title: Engineer / Senior Engineer, Electrical
description:
At Cheniere, we provide the world with safe, reliable energy. But more than that, we provide opportunities for our talented employees to impact their communities every day. Our diversity is key to our continued success and forges a path where our culture supports greater equity and inclusion for our employees, customers and beyond.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Engineer or Senior Engineer reports to the Engineering Superintendent, Electrical and is a technical steward for electrical systems and is accountable for supporting, maintaining, and improving these systems including all associated documentation. This role will provide leadership and discipline expertise to less experienced support staff, Engineering Design, Maintenance, and Operations groups.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ESSENTIAL DUTIES

  • Guide and direct the development of operating philosophies and detailed procedures, practices and standards for the LNG terminal.

  • Provide electrical systems support to Maintenance and Operations to keep plant systems operational.

  • Responsible for the industrial electrical systems from the field devices (motors, switches, etc.) through the distribution from 120 V to 138 kV which includes lighting panels, power panels, UPS, motor control centers, distribution transformers, indoor/outdoor substations, switchgear, gas turbines and diesel generators.

  • Use sound engineering practices, plant standards, and specifications to ensure that documentation for the electrical systems is maintained properly.

  • Thoroughly understand the technical Management of Change (MOC) process and utilize it in support of capital projects and routine facility changes.

  • Participate in Pre-Startup Safety Reviews and Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA).

  • Participate in regulatory agency audits as required.

  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, assistance in planning and coordinating work for the Maintenance department. Work with Maintenance and Operations on electrical issues when they occur.

  • Develop design basis, preliminary estimates, and schedules for project design scopes.

  • Work with senior engineers to define problems, establish work scopes, prepare task budgets and schedules, plan work, provide technical direction, and report the work status to management.

  • Reinforce safety and environmental awareness through frequent job observations and by interfacing with plant personnel.

  • Work with Engineering and Construction department to assure O&M interests are represented on major projects.

  • Interact with and support Commercial Operations, Regulatory Affairs, and other departments as required.

  • The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

Knowledge:

Must have advanced knowledge of industrial electrical systems, equipment, codes, standards, and regulations and their implementation in operating facilities. Possesses working knowledge of how heavy industrial facilities operate including transportation, storage, and processing including health, safety, maintenance, operations, governmental regulations, and associated codes and standards. Must possess career discipline interest of working with low/medium/high voltage power systems such as distribution and transmission equipment including transformers, protective relays, switchgear, etc.

Skills:

  • Strong leadership and administrative abilities are required.

  • An acute sensitivity to safety issues in a hazardous environment.

  • Exceptional written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Ability to communicate effectively at all levels of an organization and with individuals and groups from different disciplines, industries, and governmental agencies.

  • Able to work with culturally diverse group of technical individuals whose skills cover the range required to engineer, operate and maintain the LNG terminal and Liquefaction production facilities.

  • Possess the personality and ability to relate to and to establish a mutually respectful relationship with 1) management, 2) peers and 3) the various facility level workers (Plant Manager, plant supervision and plant workers) whom are all responsible for ensuring good operations.

  • Organized, planning skills, able to manage multiple activities and programs in timely fashion and with a high degree of accuracy, able to meet work deadlines.

  • Exceptional problem solving and analytical skills.

  • Accomplished public speaker, able to create and deliver industry-specific presentations.

  • Computer savvy, including ESS, Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, Access, Project and PowerPoint.

  • Must maintain a Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC) card in good standing status.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Education and Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering.

Experience:

  • Engineer, Electrical: Minimum of three (3)+ years of relevant experience in an industrial setting in engineering, operations, maintenance or other related technical function. LNG facility experience is preferred; however, petrochemical, NGL, cryogenic natural gas processing or other hydrocarbon processing experience is acceptable.

  • Senior Engineer, Electrical: Minimum of five (5)+ years of relevant experience in an industrial setting in engineering, operations, maintenance or other related technical function. LNG facility experience is preferred; however, petrochemical, NGL, cryogenic natural gas processing or other hydrocarbon processing experience is acceptable.

DIRECT REPORTS

No direct reports.

FREEDOM TO ACT

The Engineer / Senior Electrical Engineer requires minimal supervision.

WORK CONDITIONS

  • Job is performed in an industrial plant environment.

  • Occasionally, work may be performed from home, after normal work hours or on weekends.

  • Limited travel required, as business conditions dictate.

  • Subject to drug and alcohol testing, per applicable federal regulations or as required by Cheniere.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is often required to stand, walk, sit, climb stairs, work at height above ground on stairs and catwalks, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, talk, hear, smell, type and write.

  • Must be able to board a ship via a gangway, climb to the top of a tank (200+ steps), scale vertical steel ladder up to forty feet or more in height and lift and move objects weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee will work indoors and outdoors, and be exposed to year-around weather conditions, ocean environment, and noise. There is a considerable number of outdoor activities involved.

  • Specific vision abilities required include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

  • Required to pass regularly scheduled physical examinations mandated by regulatory authorities.

  • Required to obtain mandated certification by attending Company-sponsored training in basic first aid and CPR.

  • Must maintain a Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC) card in good standing status.

ADA JOB REQUIREMENTS

Reasonable accommodations will be made to ensure that the essential functions of the job can be performed and not hinder the employee's performance due to physical, mental, or emotional disability.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Cheniere Energy is an equal opportunity workplace. All employment decisions are made without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, marital or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other legally protected categories. This includes providing reasonable accommodation if requested for disabilities or religious beliefs and practices.

title: Senior Software Engineer, C/FICCO Data
description:

The DRW C/FICCO Data Engineering team is essential to developing valuable datasets and scalable data infrastructure critical to our trading operations. We work closely with traders, researchers, and other engineering teams to ensure seamless data flow and accessibility, supporting data-driven decision-making. Our systems are designed to handle large volumes of data, maintain quality and integrity, and provide robust APIs for fast, ergonomic data retrieval.

About the Role

In this role you will:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver data solutions that support diverse trading activities.
  • Take full ownership of data products, guiding them from initial concept through to stable production.
  • Design, build, and maintain systems for both batch processing and real-time streaming of time series datasets, ensuring high data quality and reliability.
  • Develop APIs and data access methods for fast, intuitive retrieval of historical and live data, working with both new and existing systems.
  • Provide on-call support as needed.

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 2+ years’ experience using at least one of Python, Java, and C++, and can work comfortably in multiple programming languages
  • A track record of working directly with end customers, scoping and delivering production systems in fast-moving and ambiguous environments
  • Ability to dive deep into complex problems, develop intuitive understandings, spot risks early, and minimize complexity
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills - you communicate clearly with stakeholders as well as other engineers, fostering a collaborative, supportive working environment
  • Experience in the financial markets, especially in delta one, store of value, and/or FICC options trading
  • Experience with Linux-based, concurrent, high-throughput, low-latency software systems
  • Experience with pipeline orchestration frameworks (e.g. Airflow, Dagster)
  • Experience with streaming platforms (e.g. Kafka), data lake platforms (e.g. Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg), and relational databases
  • Have a Bachelor or advanced degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, or equivalent work experience

title: Network Administrator, Journeyman
description:
Torch Technologies

Thank you for your interest in employment with Torch Technologies. We are a 100% employee-owned, Certified Great Place To Work and named Best Places to Work in Huntsville/Madison County, headquartered in Huntsville, AL. Our team provides superior research, development, and engineering services to the Federal Government and Department of War. As one of the nation’s top 100 defense companies, the services we provide directly support the men and women who serve our country. Our corporate mission sums up the pride our employee-owners take in the work we do: “Lighting the Pathway of Freedom”. And, as a Certified Evergreen ESOP, we have made the commitment to grow and sustain our company for the next 100 years! Come grow with us!

Torch Technologies is seeking a Network Administrator, Journeyman to support the Training Division (AFLCMC/WNR) at Hill Air Force Base in Ogden, Utah. The WNR Division serves as the Air Force’s technical, acquisition, and sustainment authority, delivering comprehensive and mission-critical support to the warfighter. The division supports a broad portfolio of Air Force systems including Electronic Warfare, Range Systems, Air Combat Training, Command and Control Systems, Advanced Radar Threat Systems, and Combat Survivor Evader Locater systems. The division also provides ongoing support to depot-level sustainment efforts, Foreign Military Sales (FMS), and partners across the U.S. Army, Navy, PACAF, ACC, AFMC, and AETC. This role specifically supports the Live Mission Operations Capability (LMOC) program. LMOC enables real-time weapon modeling and automated data delivery for live training and debrief environments, enhancing training fidelity, density, and effectiveness across mission planning, execution, reconstruction, and review.

As a Network Administrator, Journeyman your duties include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Provide system administration support for LAN, WAN, web, and communication systems across classified and unclassified environments

  • Support network security for command and control systems

  • Provide classified communication venues for product teams to discuss sensitive requirements, designs, and system shortfalls

  • Resolve integration issues between new systems and existing infrastructure

  • Perform systems analysis for project tracking systems

  • Support IT and communications systems including network infrastructure, wireless systems, and voice systems

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in information systems technology and computer science

  • Background in business systems

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer

Location: London, Hybrid

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to help build Pubity Suite, the internal product platform behind one of the world’s largest social publishers.

This is a hands on engineering role with genuine end to end ownership. You’ll work alongside our existing build engineer and take products from problem and system design through to frontend, backend, data, deployment and adoption.

The opportunity

Pubity Suite is the operating system behind 22+ social first brands, 170M+ followers and more than 180 billion lifetime views.

It runs across editorial, social, commercial, finance and leadership, covering dashboards, automations, AI tooling, content pipelines, talent and creator systems.

The platform is live, it has real users and we’re continuing to expand what it can do.

We’re now looking for a second engineer who can take genuine ownership of the build.

This isn’t a role where you’ll be one engineer amongst a large development team. We need someone comfortable making decisions, solving ambiguous problems and carrying features from database through to frontend without separate QA, DevOps or specialist frontend and backend teams around them.

If you enjoy that level of ownership, you’ll have plenty of it here.

What you’ll do

Own features end to end

  • Build and ship new features across Pubity Suite.

  • Take ownership across frontend, backend, data and deployment.

  • Work through technical and system design decisions before turning them into production software.

  • Pick up increasingly complex workstreams and own them independently.

  • Work alongside our existing build engineer during a structured handover and as we increase our internal engineering capability.

  • Improve the architecture and engineering foundations of the Suite as it continues to grow.

Build AI native products

AI is already part of how Pubity works. You’ll help turn the best internal ideas and workflows into reliable products that people actually use.

  • Build AI powered tools, automations, agents and internal workflows.

  • Work hands on with Anthropic’s API and other LLM tooling.

  • Design systems that account for reliability, failure modes and real world usage.

  • Help us decide what should remain a lightweight automation and what deserves to become part of the core Pubity Suite.

Work close to the business

You’ll sit within Product and Delivery and work directly with the people using what you build.

That means understanding the problem rather than simply receiving a technical ticket.

You’ll work across editorial, commercial, audience, data and operations, turning business requirements into products and features that make a measurable difference.

Who we’re looking for

You’ve shipped real products in production and you’re comfortable owning the technical decisions behind them.

You think beyond your individual part of the stack and understand how frontend, backend, data and infrastructure fit together.

Most importantly, you’re comfortable operating with autonomy.

You can take a problem, understand the requirements, design an approach, build it, deploy it and own what happens next.

You’ll have

  • Strong experience building and shipping production web applications as a Full Stack or Product Engineer.

  • Strong React and TypeScript experience.

  • Strong backend development experience and a good understanding of APIs and application architecture.

  • Strong SQL and database knowledge, ideally including Postgres.

  • System design experience and the ability to explain the reasoning behind your architectural decisions.

  • Experience taking features from initial requirement through development, deployment and production.

  • Experience integrating AI or LLM APIs into real products.

  • Experience working with data warehouses, analytics platforms or data heavy applications.

  • The ability to work independently without relying on dedicated QA, DevOps, frontend or backend teams.

  • Strong communication skills. You’ll regularly need to explain technical decisions to people who aren’t engineers.

  • Good judgement around when to move quickly, when to refactor and when not to over engineer.

We’re completely comfortable with engineers using AI as part of their development workflow. What matters is that you understand what you’re building and can explain and defend the technical decisions behind it.

Our current stack

You’ll be working across:

  • React

  • TypeScript

  • Supabase

  • Postgres

  • n8n

  • BigQuery

  • Netlify

  • Anthropic API

You don’t necessarily need to have worked professionally with every technology on that list.

We’re more interested in strong engineering fundamentals and evidence that you can get across a stack quickly than somebody who simply matches every keyword.

Bonus points for

  • Experience in media, publishing, social or the creator economy.

  • Experience as a founding or early engineer within a startup.

  • Experience working in a small engineering team where you’ve had broad technical ownership.

  • Supabase experience.

  • BigQuery experience.

  • Experience with n8n or similar orchestration tools such as Temporal, Airflow or Prefect.

  • Experience replacing legacy or externally built systems with internal products.

  • Strong product and design instincts. You care about how something works for the person using it, not only how it’s engineered.

  • Side projects, open source contributions or products you’ve built that you can show us.

What success looks like

Within your first few months, you’ll understand the Pubity Suite architecture and be shipping features within our sprint cycle.

As you get further into the role, you’ll begin owning features independently and taking direct engineering load away from our existing build engineer.

Ultimately, we want you to be able to carry complete workstreams end to end, helping us increase how quickly we can build across Pubity Suite, AI and our wider data roadmap.

Why join us?

  • A high ownership engineering role at one of the world’s largest social publishers.

  • Direct ownership of products used across the business.

  • A small team with short decision cycles and very little process drag.

  • The opportunity to influence how our engineering function develops rather than joining something that’s already defined.

  • Hands on exposure across product, AI, data, editorial and commercial.

  • Genuine AI product work in a business already using the technology every day.

  • Full benefits package.

  • London HQ, hybrid working.

Please note: We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.

Pubity Group is committed to fostering equal opportunities within our organisation. We are dedicated to building a diverse workforce at every level, and we warmly invite all community members to pursue openings with us.

title: Provost and Senior Vice Chancellor of Academic Affairs, University of Tennessee at Chattanooga
description:
The Opportunity

The University of Tennessee at Chattanooga seeks an innovative, collaborative, and visionary academic leader to serve as its next Provost and Senior Vice Chancellor for Academic Affairs. Reporting directly to the Chancellor, the Provost serves as the University of Tennessee at Chattanooga's chief academic officer and provides strategic leadership for the university's academic enterprise. The Provost advances the university's mission by fostering excellence in teaching, research, scholarship, and creative activity while ensuring academic quality, innovation, integrity, and student success.

The Provost oversees all academic colleges, departments, and academic support units, working collaboratively with university and UT System leadership to implement the institution's strategic priorities, strengthen enrollment, expand academic opportunities, and prepare graduates to meet the workforce and societal needs of Tennessee and the region.

More than 200 specialized educational programs are administered by the deans of the College of Arts & Sciences, College of Engineering & Computer Science, College of Health, Education and Professional Studies, College of Nursing, Gary W. Rollins College of Business, UTC Honors College, UTC Library, and the UTC Graduate School. Additional units reporting to the Provost include the Center for Global Education, the Center for Professional Education, the Office of Accreditation & Assessment, the Office of Planning, Evaluation, & Institutional Research, and the Office of the University Registrar.

Strategic Leadership

  • Lead the development, implementation, and assessment of the university's academic strategic priorities in alignment with the institutional mission and strategic enrollment plan
  • Advise the Chancellor on academic policy, planning, and institutional priorities.
  • Advance innovative academic programs and initiatives that respond to workforce, economic, and societal needs.
  • Promote student access, success, retention, transfer pathways, and degree completion.
  • Represent the university in campus, community, state, and regional partnerships that strengthen UTC's academic mission.

Academic Excellence

  • Provide executive leadership for all academic programs, including undergraduate, graduate, continuing education, and extended campus initiatives.
  • Foster excellence in teaching, research, scholarship, and creative activity across all disciplines.
  • Strengthen the university's research enterprise, advance interdisciplinary collaboration, and support faculty success in research and innovation in partnership with the Vice Chancellor for Research.
  • Oversee academic program development, review, assessment, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure compliance with accreditation standards, including SACSCOC and program-specific accrediting bodies.
  • Lead institutional effectiveness, assessment, and institutional research efforts that informs improved academic quality and accountability.

Faculty Leadership

  • Recruit, develop, evaluate, and retain outstanding faculty and academic leaders.
  • Oversee faculty appointment, promotion, tenure, post-tenure review, and annual evaluation processes.
  • Support faculty development through professional growth opportunities that strengthen teaching, research, and student learning.
  • Foster a collaborative culture of innovation, accountability, and shared governance.

Collaboration and Student Success

  • Enhance the UTC student experience and improve academic outcomes in partnership with the Vice Chancellor for Enrollment Management and Student Affairs.
  • Build strong relationships with faculty, staff, students, alumni, community partners, the UT System, and state agencies.
  • Champion initiatives that promote academic innovation, student achievement, and organizational effectiveness across the university.
  • Collaborate with the Vice Chancellor for Research, academic colleges, and external partners to expand research, innovation, and experiential learning opportunities.

Resource Stewardship

  • Provide strategic oversight of Academic Affairs budgets in partnership with the Vice Chancellor for Finance & Administration.
  • Align academic resources with institutional priorities and enrollment demands.
  • Support sustainable funding for new academic initiatives and strategic faculty hiring.
  • Cultivate new revenue opportunities in partnerships with the Vice Chancellors for Research, Advancement, and Enrollment Management and Student Success.

Required Experience and Qualifications

Academic Leadership

  • Distinguished record of teaching, scholarship, research, and service appropriate for appointment as a full professor.
  • Significant senior academic leadership experience in progressively responsible roles at the level of the Office of the Dean, the Office of the Provost or comparable executive academic administrator.
  • Demonstrated success developing and leading undergraduate and graduate academic programs, including responsibility for personnel, budgets, and program assessment.

Strategic and Fiscal Leadership

  • Experience developing and implementing strategic academic initiatives aligned with institutional priorities.
  • Strong understanding of emerging trends, opportunities, and challenges in higher education and within the State of Tennessee.
  • Proven ability to manage complex budgets, allocate resources strategically, and support sustainable academic growth.

Faculty Leadership and Shared Governance

  • Demonstrated commitment to shared governance, academic freedom, and collaborative decision-making.
  • Record of recruiting, developing, evaluating, and retaining outstanding faculty and academic leaders.
  • Experience fostering faculty excellence through mentorship, professional development, and support for teaching, research, scholarship, and creative activity.
  • Experience leading accreditation, academic assessment, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Student Success and Innovation

  • Demonstrated commitment to student success, enrollment growth, retention, and academic achievement.
  • Experience advancing innovative academic programs, technology-enhanced learning, and lifelong learning initiatives.
  • Understanding of institutional effectiveness and assessment practices that strengthen academic quality.

External Engagement and Collaboration

  • Experience building partnerships with community, industry, government, and higher education stakeholders.
  • Success in fundraising, advancement, sponsored research, or other resource development initiatives.
  • Proven ability to build trust and collaborate effectively with faculty, staff, students, administrators, trustees, and external partners.

Leadership Attributes

  • Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
  • High standards of integrity, sound judgment, and ethical leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead with transparency, inspire and mentor others, build consensus, and foster an inclusive, collaborative culture grounded in shared governance and accountability.

NOMINATIONS AND APPLICATIONS

Qualified candidates should apply electronically using the link below. Applications should include a 1) current CV, 2) a letter of interest that addresses the responsibilities and qualifications described above, and 3) names and contact information for three to five professional references.

Review of applications will begin on September 30, 2026, and continue until an appointment is made. Applications received by this date will receive priority consideration.

Compensation for the position will be competitive and commensurate with qualifications and experience. The University offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare and tuition benefits for employees and their families, generous retirement benefits, a wide variety of professional development opportunities, supportive work and family benefits, and much more. Additionally, Tennessee residents do not pay state income tax.

Questions regarding the Provost search may be directed to Angela Wharton, Director of Recruitment & HR Operations, at angela-wharton@utc.edu or 423-425-4753.

title: Senior Data Engineer with Data Analytics
description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

Senior Data Engineer / Data Analytics

Job Description Summary

Be a part of transformational change where integrity matters, success inspires, and great teams collaborate and innovate. As the fifth-largest bank in the United States, U.S. Bank is one of the country’s most respected, innovative, ethical, and successful financial institutions. We’re looking for people who want more than just a job—they want to make a measurable difference. U.S. Bank is seeking a Senior Data Analytics / Software Developer to help deliver modern, secure, scalable analytics and reporting solutions using Azure, SQL Server, Power BI, OLAP modeling, and enterprise database reporting practices in an Agile, AI-enabled technology environment. This role is well-suited for a hands-on technologist who thrives in a small-team environment and is comfortable owning work across the full lifecycle—from requirements analysis and solution design through coding, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production support.

Job Description

Be a part of transformational change where integrity matters, success inspires, and great teams collaborate and innovate. U.S. Bank is seeking a Senior Data Analytics / Software Developer who will contribute to the success of technology initiatives by analyzing, designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting enterprise data analytics and reporting solutions.

This role will focus on building high-quality data products that enable trusted business insights, operational reporting, self-service analytics, and informed decision-making. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering discipline with deep experience in SQL Server, Azure data services, Power BI, OLAP/semantic modeling, data warehousing, and reporting methodologies. Because this role operates in a small-team environment, the candidate must be comfortable wearing multiple hats and taking practical ownership across all levels of the work: business analysis, technical analysis, database development, report development, testing, release coordination, troubleshooting, and production support. The candidate will work in an Agile delivery model, partner closely with business and technology stakeholders, and apply AI-enabled tools and practices to improve productivity, quality, automation, and speed to insight.

Essential Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, test, deploy, operate, and maintain scalable data analytics, business intelligence, and reporting solutions using Azure, SQL Server, Power BI, OLAP, and related database reporting tools.
- Own end-to-end delivery responsibilities in a small team setting, including requirements clarification, data analysis, solution design, coding, unit testing, implementation, user support, issue resolution, and ongoing production stability.
- Build and optimize SQL Server databases, stored procedures, views, queries, data models, and reporting structures with attention to performance, reliability, maintainability, and security.
- Develop and maintain Power BI semantic models, dashboards, reports, measures, and datasets that provide accurate, actionable, and user-friendly insights for business and technology stakeholders.
- Design and support OLAP, dimensional, and semantic models that enable trend analysis, historical reporting, self-service analytics, KPI tracking, and executive reporting.
- Translate business requirements into technical solutions by collaborating with product owners, analysts, engineers, architects, scrum masters, and business partners, while also being able to perform detailed analysis independently when dedicated analyst capacity is limited.
- Apply data engineering and reporting best practices, including data quality validation, reconciliation, lineage awareness, metadata documentation, performance tuning, and controlled release processes.
- Contribute to cloud-based analytics solutions using Azure capabilities such as Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Analysis Services, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Data Lake, or related services where applicable.
- Use AI-enabled development and analytics tools responsibly to accelerate requirements analysis, data profiling, code generation, test creation, documentation, anomaly detection, and continuous improvement.
- Follow Agile software development lifecycle practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, estimation, incremental delivery, demos, retrospectives, and proactive communication of risks or blockers.
- Take ownership of production-ready, testable, secure, and supportable data solutions that meet enterprise technology, risk, compliance, and software reliability standards.
- Conduct peer reviews of SQL, data models, reports, dashboards, and technical designs to promote engineering quality, consistency, governance, and maintainability.
- Troubleshoot data, reporting, performance, and production issues; perform root cause analysis; recommend design improvements; coordinate fixes; and support operational stability as part of regular team responsibilities.
- Balance project delivery with run-the-business support needs, including responding to questions, incidents, defects, data reconciliation issues, access concerns, refresh failures, and reporting discrepancies.
- Contribute to a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, automation, continuous learning, and responsible adoption of emerging technologies, including AI and advanced analytics.

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
- Five to six years of relevant experience in software development, data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, database reporting, or related technology roles.

Experience Should Include

- Hands-on experience with SQL Server, T-SQL, relational database design, query optimization, and production reporting or analytics solutions.
- Experience developing business intelligence reports, dashboards, data models, or analytics products using Power BI or comparable enterprise reporting tools.
- Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and modern software development lifecycle principles.
- Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a small-team environment where responsibilities may span business analysis, technical design, coding, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production support.
- Advanced proficiency with Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, Power Query, report optimization, workspace practices, refresh strategies, and role-based security concepts.
- Strong experience with SQL Server reporting, analytics, and data integration patterns, including dimensional modeling, star schemas, stored procedures, indexing, query tuning, SSIS package development/support, ETL/ELT workflows, SSRS, or comparable reporting frameworks.
- Experience designing, developing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and modernizing SSIS packages for data movement, transformation, scheduling, exception handling, logging, and production support.
- Experience designing OLAP, semantic, or analytical models for complex business reporting, trend analysis, KPI measurement, and self-service analytics.
- Familiarity with Azure data and analytics services such as Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Analysis Services, Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, Data Lake, Logic Apps, or related cloud-native capabilities.
